````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/driverSimulator.ts
 *
 * Driver ping intake, lane-snapping (within 300m), geofence arrival detection,
 * rate limiting (60 pings/min/driver), and simulation clock tick advancing.
 */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.GEOFENCE_RADIUS_M = void 0;
exports.snapPingToLane = snapPingToLane;
exports.checkRateLimit = checkRateLimit;
exports.intakeDriverPings = intakeDriverPings;
exports.advanceSimulation = advanceSimulation;
const driver_pings_js_1 = require("../models/driver-pings.js");
const transfer_lanes_js_1 = require("../models/transfer-lanes.js");
const warehouses_js_1 = require("../models/warehouses.js");
const suppliers_js_1 = require("../models/suppliers.js");
const shipments_js_1 = require("../models/shipments.js");
const shipment_events_js_1 = require("../models/shipment-events.js");
const users_js_1 = require("../models/users.js");
const simClock_js_1 = require("./simClock.js");
const websocket_js_1 = require("./websocket.js");
const nearestWarehouse_js_1 = require("./nearestWarehouse.js");
exports.GEOFENCE_RADIUS_M = 1000; // 1 km geofence around warehouse
const MAX_SNAP_METERS = 300; // 300 meters maximum road snapping
// In-memory sliding window rate limiter: driver_id -> array of timestamps
const rateLimitMap = new Map();
/**
 * Projects a point (lat, lng) onto segment (lat1, lng1)-(lat2, lng2).
 * Returns { distMeters, t (0..1) }.
 */
function projectPointToSegmentMeters(lat, lng, lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) {
    const midLat = (lat1 + lat2) / 2;
    const rad = (midLat * Math.PI) / 180;
    const mPerDegLat = 110540;
    const mPerDegLng = 111320 * Math.cos(rad);
    const x1 = 0;
    const y1 = 0;
    const x2 = (lng2 - lng1) * mPerDegLng;
    const y2 = (lat2 - lat1) * mPerDegLat;
    const xp = (lng - lng1) * mPerDegLng;
    const yp = (lat - lat1) * mPerDegLat;
    const lenSq = x2 * x2 + y2 * y2;
    if (lenSq === 0) {
        const dist = Math.sqrt(xp * xp + yp * yp);
        return { distMeters: dist, t: 0 };
    }
    const dot = xp * x2 + yp * y2;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, dot / lenSq));
    const projX = t * x2;
    const projY = t * y2;
    const dx = xp - projX;
    const dy = yp - projY;
    const distMeters = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    return { distMeters, t };
}
/**
 * Snaps (lat, lng) to the closest TransferLane within 300m.
 */
async function snapPingToLane(lat, lng) {
    const lanes = await transfer_lanes_js_1.TransferLane.find({}).lean();
    const warehouses = await warehouses_js_1.Warehouse.find({}).lean();
    const suppliers = await suppliers_js_1.Supplier.find({}).lean();
    const nodeMap = new Map();
    for (const w of warehouses) {
        if (w.lat !== undefined && w.lng !== undefined) {
            nodeMap.set(w._id.toString(), { lat: w.lat, lng: w.lng });
        }
    }
    for (const s of suppliers) {
        if (s.lat !== undefined && s.lng !== undefined) {
            nodeMap.set(s._id.toString(), { lat: s.lat, lng: s.lng });
        }
    }
    let bestLane = null;
    let bestDist = Infinity;
    let bestT = 0;
    for (const lane of lanes) {
        const fromNode = nodeMap.get(lane.from_warehouse_id.toString());
        const toNode = nodeMap.get(lane.to_warehouse_id.toString());
        if (!fromNode || !toNode)
            continue;
        const { distMeters, t } = projectPointToSegmentMeters(lat, lng, fromNode.lat, fromNode.lng, toNode.lat, toNode.lng);
        if (distMeters <= MAX_SNAP_METERS && distMeters < bestDist) {
            bestDist = distMeters;
            bestLane = lane;
            bestT = t;
        }
    }
    if (bestLane) {
        const kmOnLane = Math.round(bestT * bestLane.distance_km * 10) / 10;
        return {
            lane_id: bestLane._id.toString(),
            km_on_lane: kmOnLane,
        };
    }
    return { lane_id: null, km_on_lane: null };
}
/**
 * Checks rate limit (max 60 pings/min/driver).
 */
function checkRateLimit(driverId, pingCount = 1) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const windowMs = 60 * 1000;
    let timestamps = rateLimitMap.get(driverId) || [];
    // Prune older than 1 minute
    timestamps = timestamps.filter((t) => now - t < windowMs);
    if (timestamps.length + pingCount > 60) {
        rateLimitMap.set(driverId, timestamps);
        return false; // Rate limit exceeded
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < pingCount; i++) {
        timestamps.push(now);
    }
    rateLimitMap.set(driverId, timestamps);
    return true;
}
/**
 * Intakes an array of driver pings for a specific driver and truck.
 */
async function intakeDriverPings(driverId, truckId, inputPings) {
    // Sort incoming batch by seq
    const sorted = [...inputPings].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
    let acceptedCount = 0;
    let duplicateCount = 0;
    const processedDocs = [];
    // Look up shipment to detect geofence arrivals
    const shipment = await shipments_js_1.Shipment.findOne({ code: truckId }).populate('warehouse_id');
    const destWh = shipment?.warehouse_id;
    for (const item of sorted) {
        const existing = await driver_pings_js_1.DriverPing.findOne({
            driver_id: driverId,
            seq: item.seq,
        });
        if (existing) {
            duplicateCount++;
            processedDocs.push({
                driver_id: driverId,
                truck_id: truckId,
                seq: item.seq,
                status: 'DUPLICATE',
            });
            continue;
        }
        const { lane_id, km_on_lane } = await snapPingToLane(item.lat, item.lng);
        const doc = await driver_pings_js_1.DriverPing.create({
            driver_id: driverId,
            truck_id: truckId,
            seq: item.seq,
            ts: new Date(item.ts),
            lat: item.lat,
            lng: item.lng,
            lane_id,
            km_on_lane,
            speed_kmh: item.speed_kmh,
            source: item.source || 'DRIVER_DEVICE',
            created_at: new Date(),
        });
        acceptedCount++;
        processedDocs.push(doc);
        // Geofence check
        if (shipment && destWh && destWh.lat !== undefined && destWh.lng !== undefined) {
            const distKm = (0, nearestWarehouse_js_1.haversineDistanceKm)(item.lat, item.lng, destWh.lat, destWh.lng);
            const distM = distKm * 1000;
            if (distM <= exports.GEOFENCE_RADIUS_M) {
                // Write ARRIVED_GEOFENCE event once
                const existingEvent = await shipment_events_js_1.ShipmentEvent.findOne({
                    shipment_id: shipment._id,
                    event_type: 'ARRIVED_GEOFENCE',
                });
                if (!existingEvent) {
                    await shipment_events_js_1.ShipmentEvent.create({
                        shipment_id: shipment._id,
                        source: item.source === 'SIM' ? 'SIM' : 'DRIVER_DEVICE',
                        external_event_id: `GEOFENCE-${driverId}-${item.seq}`,
                        event_type: 'ARRIVED_GEOFENCE',
                        reported_eta: null,
                        quantity_affected: null,
                        confidence: 1.0,
                        raw_payload: {
                            truck_id: truckId,
                            driver_id: driverId,
                            lat: item.lat,
                            lng: item.lng,
                            seq: item.seq,
                            warehouse_code: destWh.code,
                        },
                        ingested_at: new Date(),
                    });
                    // Broadcast alert to warehouse operator
                    await (0, websocket_js_1.broadcastToTopic)('alerts', {
                        type: 'ARRIVED_GEOFENCE',
                        truck_id: truckId,
                        warehouse_id: destWh.code,
                        driver_id: driverId,
                        message: `Truck ${truckId} arrived inside geofence of ${destWh.code}`,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        // Broadcast position update
        await (0, websocket_js_1.broadcastToTopic)('tracking', {
            type: 'TRUCK_POSITION',
            driver_id: driverId,
            truck_id: truckId,
            seq: item.seq,
            ts: item.ts,
            lat: item.lat,
            lng: item.lng,
            lane_id,
            km_on_lane,
            speed_kmh: item.speed_kmh,
            warehouse_id: destWh ? destWh.code : null,

        accepted: acceptedCount,
        duplicates: duplicateCount,

}
/**
 * Advances the simulation by N minutes for all active trucks (DEMO_MODE).
 */
async function advanceSimulation(minutes = 5) {
    const current = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    const nextTime = new Date(current.getTime() + minutes * 60000);
    simClock_js_1.simClock.set(nextTime);
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    const driverUsers = await users_js_1.User.find({ role: 'DRIVER', truck_id: { $ne: null } }).lean();
    const results = [];
    const warehouses = await warehouses_js_1.Warehouse.find({}).lean();
    const suppliers = await suppliers_js_1.Supplier.find({}).lean();
    const whMap = new Map();
    for (const w of warehouses)
        whMap.set(w._id.toString(), w);
    for (const s of suppliers)
        whMap.set(s._id.toString(), s);
    for (const driver of driverUsers) {
        const driverId = driver.driver_id;
        const truckId = driver.truck_id;
        // Find latest ping
        const latestPing = await driver_pings_js_1.DriverPing.findOne({ driver_id: driverId }).sort({ seq: -1 }).lean();
        const nextSeq = latestPing ? latestPing.seq + 1 : 1;
        // Find shipment and associated route
        const shipment = await shipments_js_1.Shipment.findOne({ code: truckId }).lean();
        if (!shipment)
            continue;
        const fromNode = whMap.get(shipment.supplier_id.toString()) || whMap.get(shipment.warehouse_id.toString());
        const toNode = whMap.get(shipment.warehouse_id.toString());
        if (!fromNode || !toNode)
            continue;
        const speedKmh = 60; // 60 km/h = 1 km/min
        const distanceToMoveKm = (speedKmh * minutes) / 60;
        let newKm = 0;
        let totalLaneKm = 100;
        // Find lane
        const lane = await transfer_lanes_js_1.TransferLane.findOne({
            $or: [
                { from_warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id },
                { to_warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id },
            ],
        }).lean();
        if (lane) {
            totalLaneKm = lane.distance_km;
            const prevKm = latestPing?.km_on_lane ?? 0;
            newKm = Math.min(totalLaneKm, prevKm + distanceToMoveKm);
        }
        else {
            const prevKm = latestPing?.km_on_lane ?? 0;
            newKm = prevKm + distanceToMoveKm;
        }
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, newKm / totalLaneKm));
        const newLat = fromNode.lat + t * (toNode.lat - fromNode.lat);
        const newLng = fromNode.lng + t * (toNode.lng - fromNode.lng);
        const pingRes = await intakeDriverPings(driverId, truckId, [
            {
                seq: nextSeq,
                ts: now,
                lat: Math.round(newLat * 10000) / 10000,
                lng: Math.round(newLng * 10000) / 10000,
                speed_kmh: speedKmh,
                source: 'SIM',
            },
        ]);
        results.push({
            driver_id: driverId,
            truck_id: truckId,
            seq: nextSeq,
            lat: newLat,
            lng: newLng,
            km_on_lane: newKm,
            status: pingRes.accepted > 0 ? 'ACCEPTED' : 'DUPLICATE',
        });
    }
    return results;
}
````

````typescript
 * apps/api/src/services/extractor.ts
````

````javascript
    naangu: 4,
    anju: 5,

    aaru: 6,

    if (/^\d+$/.test(clean)) {
        return parseInt(clean, 10);
    }
    if (clean in TANGLISH_NUMBERS) {
        return TANGLISH_NUMBERS[clean];
    }
    return null;
}
function extractEventCardRules(text) {

    const shipment_code = shipmentMatch ? shipmentMatch[0].toUpperCase() : null;

    let warehouse_code = null;
    if (/hosur|wh-hos|\bhos\b/i.test(lower)) {
        warehouse_code = 'WH-HOS';
    }
    else if (/chennai|wh-chn|\bchn\b/i.test(lower)) {

    }
    else if (/bengaluru|bangalore|wh-blr|\bblr\b/i.test(lower)) {
        warehouse_code = 'WH-BLR';
    }
    // 3. Damaged units

        /(\w+|\d+)\s+(?:box|boxes|units|pieces|case|cases)\s+(?:damage|damaged|udanchu)/i,

    for (const regex of damageRegexes) {
        const m = lower.match(regex);
        if (m && m[1]) {
            const num = parseNumber(m[1]);
            if (num !== null && num > 0) {
                damaged_units = num;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    // 4. Delay hours
    let delay_hours = null;
    // Match Tanglish e.g. "rendu mani neram late", "2 hours late", "3 hrs delay", "oru mani neram"
    const delayRegexes = [
        /(\w+|\d+)\s+mani\s+neram(?:\s+late|\s+delay)?/i,
        /(\w+|\d+)\s+(?:hours?|hrs?)\s+(?:late|delay|delayed)/i,
        /delay(?:ed)?\s+(?:by\s+)?(\w+|\d+)\s+(?:hours?|hrs?|mani\s+neram)/i,
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/fingerprints.ts
 *
 * Step 11 Part A – Disruption Fingerprints (A10).
 *
 * Fingerprint key = (disruption_type, severity, sku_ids, warehouse_ids) → SHA-256 hex prefix.
 * Active after 3+ matching cases; new match = MATCH label; precursor event = PRE_WARNING.
 */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.listFingerprints = listFingerprints;
exports.getDisruptionFingerprints = getDisruptionFingerprints;
exports.recordFingerprintOnOpen = recordFingerprintOnOpen;
const fingerprints_js_1 = require("../models/fingerprints.js");
const disruption_fingerprints_js_1 = require("../models/disruption-fingerprints.js");
const historical_cases_js_1 = require("../models/historical-cases.js");
const playbook_js_1 = require("./playbook.js");
const disruptions_js_1 = require("../models/disruptions.js");
const shipments_js_1 = require("../models/shipments.js");
const shipment_lines_js_1 = require("../models/shipment-lines.js");
const ACTIVE_THRESHOLD = 3;
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// List all fingerprints with match counts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function listFingerprints() {
    const fps = await fingerprints_js_1.Fingerprint.find({}).lean();
    const results = await Promise.all(fps.map(async (fp) => {
        const matchCount = await historical_cases_js_1.HistoricalCase.countDocuments({ fingerprint_id: fp._id });
        return {
            fingerprint_id: fp._id,
            code: fp.code,
            pattern: fp.pattern,
            occurrence_count: fp.occurrence_count,
            match_count: matchCount,
            active: fp.occurrence_count >= ACTIVE_THRESHOLD,
            last_seen_at: fp.last_seen_at,
        };
    }));
    return { fingerprints: results, method: 'rule-based' };
}
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Get fingerprints for a specific disruption
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function getDisruptionFingerprints(disruptionId) {
    const disruption = await disruptions_js_1.Disruption.findById(disruptionId).lean();
    if (!disruption)
        return { fingerprints: [], method: 'rule-based' };
    const shipment = await shipments_js_1.Shipment.findById(disruption.shipment_id).lean();
    const lines = await shipment_lines_js_1.ShipmentLine.find({ shipment_id: disruption.shipment_id }).lean();
    const skuIds = lines.map((l) => l.sku_id.toString());
    // Compute code for this disruption
    const fpCode = (0, playbook_js_1.computeFingerprintCode)(disruption.disruption_type, disruption.severity, skuIds, shipment ? [shipment.warehouse_id.toString()] : []);
    const fp = await fingerprints_js_1.Fingerprint.findOne({ code: fpCode }).lean();
    if (!fp)
        return { fingerprints: [], method: 'rule-based' };
    const matchCount = await historical_cases_js_1.HistoricalCase.countDocuments({ fingerprint_id: fp._id });
    let label;
    if (fp.occurrence_count >= ACTIVE_THRESHOLD) {
        label = 'MATCH';
    }
    // Also check linked fingerprints from disruption_fingerprints collection
    const links = await disruption_fingerprints_js_1.DisruptionFingerprint.find({ disruption_id: disruptionId })
        .populate('fingerprint_id')
        .lean();
    return {
        fingerprints: [
            {
                fingerprint_id: fp._id,
                code: fp.code,
                pattern: fp.pattern,
                occurrence_count: fp.occurrence_count,
                match_count: matchCount,
                active: fp.occurrence_count >= ACTIVE_THRESHOLD,
                label: label || null,
                last_seen_at: fp.last_seen_at,
            },
            ...links
                .filter((l) => l.fingerprint_id?._id?.toString() !== fp._id.toString())
                .map((l) => ({
                fingerprint_id: l.fingerprint_id._id,
                code: l.fingerprint_id.code,
                similarity_score: l.similarity_score,
            })),
        ],
        label,
        method: 'rule-based',
    };
}
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Upsert fingerprint on disruption open (call from disruption creation)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function recordFingerprintOnOpen(disruptionId, disruption_type, severity, skuIds, warehouseIds, now) {
    const fpCode = (0, playbook_js_1.computeFingerprintCode)(disruption_type, severity, skuIds, warehouseIds);
    const fp = await fingerprints_js_1.Fingerprint.findOneAndUpdate({ code: fpCode }, {
        $set: {
            pattern: { disruption_type, severity, sku_ids: skuIds, warehouse_ids: warehouseIds },
            last_seen_at: now,
        },
        $inc: { occurrence_count: 1 },
    }, { upsert: true, new: true });
    const matchCount = await historical_cases_js_1.HistoricalCase.countDocuments({ fingerprint_id: fp._id });
    let label;
    if (fp.occurrence_count >= ACTIVE_THRESHOLD) {
        label = 'MATCH';
    }
    // Link to disruption
    await disruption_fingerprints_js_1.DisruptionFingerprint.findOneAndUpdate({ disruption_id: disruptionId }, { fingerprint_id: fp._id, similarity_score: 1.0 }, { upsert: true, new: true });
    return { code: fpCode, label };
}
//# sourceMappingURL=fingerprints.js.map
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/guardrails.ts
 *
 * Budget and Operational Guardrails Engine (Step 9, A9).
````

````javascript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/guardrails.ts
 *
 * Budget and Operational Guardrails Engine (Step 9, A9).
 * Checks 4 policies on every plan version:
 *   1. EXPEDITE_SPEND (max ₹6,000)
 *   2. SERVICE_DAMAGE_RESIDUAL (max ₹2,500)

const recovery_plans_js_1 = require("../models/recovery-plans.js");
const plan_actions_js_1 = require("../models/plan-actions.js");
const transfer_lanes_js_1 = require("../models/transfer-lanes.js");

async function runGuardrailChecks(planId, version) {

    const actions = await plan_actions_js_1.PlanAction.find({ plan_id: pId });
    const policies = await guardrail_policies_js_1.GuardrailPolicy.find({ is_active: true });
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    const results = [];
    let anyBreached = false;
    for (const pol of policies) {
        let actualValue = 0;
        let details = '';
        switch (pol.code) {
            case 'EXPEDITE_SPEND': {
                // Spend on expedite and alt suppliers
                const expediteActions = actions.filter((a) => a.action_type === 'EXPEDITE' || a.action_type === 'RESERVE');
                actualValue = expediteActions.reduce((s, a) => s + a.cost, 0);
                details = `Expedite + alternate supplier spend: ₹${actualValue}`;
                break;
            }
            case 'SERVICE_DAMAGE_RESIDUAL': {
                // Residual penalty cost
                const actionCost = actions.reduce((s, a) => s + a.cost, 0);
                actualValue = Math.max(0, plan.total_cost - actionCost);
                details = `Residual service penalty: ₹${actualValue}`;
                break;
            }
            case 'SUPPLIER_RISK': {
                // Supplier risk score of alt suppliers used
                let maxRisk = 0;
                const reserveActions = actions.filter((a) => a.action_type === 'RESERVE');
                for (const act of reserveActions) {
                    const ss = await supplier_skus_js_1.SupplierSku.findOne({ sku_id: act.sku_id, warehouse_id: act.to_warehouse_id });
                    if (ss) {
                        const sup = await suppliers_js_1.Supplier.findById(ss.supplier_id);
                        if (sup && sup.risk_score) {
                            maxRisk = Math.max(maxRisk, sup.risk_score);
                        }
                    }
                }
                actualValue = maxRisk;
                details = `Max supplier risk score: ${actualValue}`;
                break;
            }
            case 'TRANSFER_DISTANCE': {
                // Max transfer lane distance
                let maxDist = 0;

                        to_warehouse_id: act.to_warehouse_id,

        results.push({
            code: pol.code,
            description: pol.description,
            actual_value: actualValue,
            threshold_value: pol.threshold_value,
            passed,
            details,

    }
    const addedRoles = [];
    let isEscalated = false;
    if (anyBreached) {
        // If only one role currently required, add the missing role
        const currentRoles = plan.decision_contract?.required_approver_roles || ['Manager'];
        if (!currentRoles.includes('Manager')) {
            addedRoles.push('Manager');
            currentRoles.push('Manager');
        }
        if (!currentRoles.includes('Procurement_Approver')) {
            addedRoles.push('Procurement_Approver');
            currentRoles.push('Procurement_Approver');

        if (addedRoles.length === 0) {

            }

        allPassed: !anyBreached,
        escalated: isEscalated,
        addedRoles,
        checks: results,
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/importParser.ts
 *
 * Robust CSV and JSON parser for import files, with SHA-256 hash calculation.
 * Preserves raw input string untouched.
 */
export interface ParsedImportData {
    fileHash: string;
    rawContent: string;
    rows: Record<string, unknown>[];
}
/**
 * Computes SHA-256 hash of a buffer or string.
 */
export declare function computeFileHash(content: Buffer | string): string;
/**
 * Parses raw CSV text into array of object records.
 * Handles quoted cells with commas, trimmed column names, and empty rows.
 */
export declare function parseCsv(csvText: string): Record<string, unknown>[];
/**
 * Parses buffer or string according to format (CSV or JSON).
 */
export declare function parseImportBuffer(buffer: Buffer, filename: string): ParsedImportData;
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/importService.ts
 *
 * Core service for the import pipeline (M1, B11):
 * - Batch creation with SHA-256 deduplication (FILE_ALREADY_IMPORTED)
 * - Row validation, quarantine, repair, discard
 * - Transactional commit of VALID and REPAIRED rows (governed inventory corrections)
 * - Quality reports and domain bus notification (IMPORT_COMMITTED)
 */

}

    filename: string;
    file_hash: string;
    entity_type: string;
    status: string;
    created_at: Date;
    committed_at: Date | null;
    counts: {
        valid: number;
        repaired: number;
        quarantined: number;
        duplicate: number;
        conflict: number;
        discarded: number;
        total: number;
    };

        count: number;
    }>;

/**
 * Creates and validates an import batch from raw file buffer.
 */

    report?: ImportBatchReport;
}>;
/**
 * Returns quarantined and conflicting rows for human review.

/**
 * Repairs or discards an individual import row.

    rowId: string;

    repairedData?: Record<string, unknown>;
````

## File: apps/api/dist/services/importValidation.d.ts
````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/importValidation.ts
 *
 * Entity schemas, foreign-key checks, edit-distance suggestions (B11),
 * and natural-key duplicate / conflict classification.
 */
export interface RowValidationError {
    field?: string;
    code: string;
    message: string;
    suggestion?: string;
}
export interface ValidatedRowResult {
    rowNumber: number;
    entityType: string;
    naturalKey: string | null;
    rawData: Record<string, unknown>;
    repairedData?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    status: 'VALID' | 'REPAIRED' | 'QUARANTINED' | 'DISCARDED' | 'DUPLICATE' | 'CONFLICT';
    errors: RowValidationError[];
}
export interface EntityReferenceCodes {
    warehouses: string[];
    suppliers: string[];
    skus: string[];
}
/**
 * Computes Levenshtein edit distance between two strings.
 */
export declare function levenshteinDistance(a: string, b: string): number;
/**
 * Finds the nearest valid code using edit distance.
 */
export declare function findNearestCode(input: string, validCodes: string[]): string | undefined;
/**
 * Loads current database codes for foreign key validation.
 */
export declare function loadReferenceCodes(): Promise<EntityReferenceCodes>;
/**
 * Extracts natural key from row data based on entity type.
 */
export declare function extractNaturalKey(entityType: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): string | null;
/**
 * Validates a single row against schema and foreign keys.
 */
export declare function validateSingleRow(entityType: string, data: Record<string, unknown>, refs: EntityReferenceCodes): {
    errors: RowValidationError[];
    naturalKey: string | null;
};
/**
 * Validates an entire batch of raw rows, categorizing into VALID, QUARANTINED,
 * DUPLICATE, and CONFLICT according to B11 rules.
 */
export declare function validateBatchRows(entityType: string, rawRows: Record<string, unknown>[], refs: EntityReferenceCodes): ValidatedRowResult[];
//# sourceMappingURL=importValidation.d.ts.map
````

## File: apps/api/dist/services/inventoryCorrection.d.ts
````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/inventoryCorrection.ts
 *
 * Governed inventory adjustment service.
 * Inventory modifications never directly mutate on_hand:
 * they record audited INVENTORY_CORRECTION entries in the execution_ledger
 * and audit_logs, preserving the cryptographic hash chains and enforcing
 * invariants (on_hand cannot drop below reserved).
 */
import mongoose, { ClientSession } from 'mongoose';
import { IInventoryBalance } from '../models/inventory-balances.js';
export interface InventoryCorrectionParams {
    warehouseId: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string;
    skuId: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string;
    newOnHand: number;
    reason: string;
    actor: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string;
    correlationId?: string;
}
export interface InventoryCorrectionResult {
    balance: IInventoryBalance;
    previousOnHand: number;
    newOnHand: number;
    deltaOnHand: number;
}
/**
 * Applies a governed inventory correction inside a transaction.
 */
export declare function applyInventoryCorrection(params: InventoryCorrectionParams, session?: ClientSession): Promise<InventoryCorrectionResult>;
//# sourceMappingURL=inventoryCorrection.d.ts.map
````

````javascript
const shipments_js_1 = require("../models/shipments.js");
const shipment_lines_js_1 = require("../models/shipment-lines.js");

async function buildOrderLineage(orderId, disruptionId) {

        disruption = await disruptions_js_1.Disruption.findById(disruptionId);

    else {
        disruption = await disruptions_js_1.Disruption.findOne({ status: { $in: ['OPEN', 'IN_RECOVERY'] } });
    }
    const edges = [];
    if (disruption) {
        const shipment = await shipments_js_1.Shipment.findById(disruption.shipment_id);
        if (shipment) {
            const supplier = await suppliers_js_1.Supplier.findById(shipment.supplier_id);
            const shpLines = await shipment_lines_js_1.ShipmentLine.find({ shipment_id: shipment._id });
            const skuId = shpLines[0]?.sku_id;
            // Edge 1: Supplier -> Shipment (Delay / Damage)
            const supCode = supplier ? supplier.code : 'SUPPLIER';
            const delayHours = disruption.delay_hours || 0;

                    calculation: calc1,

                    observed_at: disruption.detected_at,
                    disruption_id: disruption._id,

            edges.push(edge1);
            // Edge 2: Shipment -> Destination Warehouse (Inbound Shortage)
            const bal = await inventory_balances_js_1.InventoryBalance.findOne({
                warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id,
                sku_id: skuId,

                    calculation: calc2,
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/nearestWarehouse.ts
 *
 * Graph Dijkstra for road-network nearest warehouse calculations and
 * straight-line fallback for off-network telemetry.
 */

exports.haversineDistanceKm = haversineDistanceKm;

const warehouses_js_1 = require("../models/warehouses.js");
const transfer_lanes_js_1 = require("../models/transfer-lanes.js");
function haversineDistanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
    const R = 6371; // Earth radius in km
    const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
        Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
            Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
            Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
            Math.sin(dLon / 2);
    const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
    return Math.round(R * c * 10) / 10;
}
async function findNearestWarehouse(params) {
    const warehouses = await warehouses_js_1.Warehouse.find({}).lean();
    if (warehouses.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No warehouses configured in system');
    }
    // 1. OFF_NETWORK or Missing Lane Data -> STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE
    if (!params.lane_id ||
        params.km_on_lane === null ||
        params.km_on_lane === undefined ||
        params.lat === undefined ||
        params.lng === undefined) {
        // If lane_id is provided, check if valid lane
        let laneDoc = null;
        if (params.lane_id && mongoose_1.default.Types.ObjectId.isValid(params.lane_id)) {
            laneDoc = await transfer_lanes_js_1.TransferLane.findById(params.lane_id).lean();
        }
        if (!laneDoc || params.km_on_lane === null || params.km_on_lane === undefined) {
            // Must use straight-line haversine
            const truckLat = params.lat ?? 12.7409;
            const truckLng = params.lng ?? 77.8253;
            const distances = {};
            let bestWh = warehouses[0];
            let minKm = Infinity;
            for (const wh of warehouses) {
                const d = haversineDistanceKm(truckLat, truckLng, wh.lat ?? 12.0, wh.lng ?? 77.0);
                distances[wh.code] = d;
                if (d < minKm || (d === minKm && wh.code.localeCompare(bestWh.code) < 0)) {
                    minKm = d;
                    bestWh = wh;
                }
            }
            return {
                nearest_warehouse_id: bestWh._id.toString(),
                nearest_warehouse_code: bestWh.code,
                road_km: minKm,
                path: [], // No road route proposed for off-network
                method: 'STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE',
                distances,
            };
        }
    }
    // 2. ROAD_GRAPH Dijkstra Calculation
    const laneDoc = await transfer_lanes_js_1.TransferLane.findById(params.lane_id).lean();
    if (!laneDoc) {
        throw new Error(`Lane not found: ${params.lane_id}`);
    }
    const allLanes = await transfer_lanes_js_1.TransferLane.find({}).lean();
    // Build undirected adjacency graph
    // Node IDs are strings
    const adj = new Map();
    const addEdge = (u, v, dist) => {
        if (!adj.has(u))
            adj.set(u, []);
        adj.get(u).push({ to: v, dist });
    };
    for (const l of allLanes) {
        const u = l.from_warehouse_id.toString();
        const v = l.to_warehouse_id.toString();
        addEdge(u, v, l.distance_km);
        addEdge(v, u, l.distance_km);
    }
    const nodeA = laneDoc.from_warehouse_id.toString();
    const nodeB = laneDoc.to_warehouse_id.toString();
    const totalLaneDist = laneDoc.distance_km;
    const kmFromA = Math.max(0, Math.min(params.km_on_lane, totalLaneDist));
    const kmFromB = totalLaneDist - kmFromA;
    // Dijkstra from virtual truck position T
    // T connects to nodeA with weight kmFromA, and nodeB with weight kmFromB
    const distMap = new Map();
    const prevMap = new Map();
    const visited = new Set();
    // Populate all known nodes
    for (const wh of warehouses) {
        distMap.set(wh._id.toString(), Infinity);
    }
    for (const [node] of adj) {
        if (!distMap.has(node))
            distMap.set(node, Infinity);
    }
    distMap.set(nodeA, kmFromA);
    prevMap.set(nodeA, null);
    distMap.set(nodeB, kmFromB);
    prevMap.set(nodeB, null);
    while (true) {
        // Find unvisited node with smallest distance
        let u = null;
        let uDist = Infinity;
        for (const [node, d] of distMap) {
            if (!visited.has(node) && d < uDist) {
                uDist = d;
                u = node;
            }
        }
        if (!u || uDist === Infinity)
            break;
        visited.add(u);
        const neighbors = adj.get(u) || [];
        for (const edge of neighbors) {
            if (visited.has(edge.to))
                continue;
            const alt = uDist + edge.dist;
            if (alt < (distMap.get(edge.to) ?? Infinity)) {
                distMap.set(edge.to, alt);
                prevMap.set(edge.to, u);
            }
        }
    }
    // Find nearest warehouse
    const distancesByCode = {};
    let bestWh = warehouses[0];
    let minDistance = Infinity;
    for (const wh of warehouses) {
        const whId = wh._id.toString();
        const d = distMap.get(whId) ?? Infinity;
        distancesByCode[wh.code] = d;
        if (d < minDistance || (d === minDistance && wh.code.localeCompare(bestWh.code) < 0)) {
            minDistance = d;
            bestWh = wh;
        }
    }
    // Reconstruct path to best warehouse
    const path = [];
    let curr = bestWh._id.toString();
    const idToCode = new Map();
    for (const wh of warehouses)
        idToCode.set(wh._id.toString(), wh.code);
    while (curr) {
        const code = idToCode.get(curr) || curr;
        path.unshift(code);
        curr = prevMap.get(curr) || null;
    }
    return {
        nearest_warehouse_id: bestWh._id.toString(),
        nearest_warehouse_code: bestWh.code,
        road_km: minDistance,
        path,
        method: 'ROAD_GRAPH',
        distances: distancesByCode,
    };
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/notifications.ts
 *
 * Notification dispatch and outbox engine (Step 10, A1).
 * Channels: IN_APP, EMAIL_SIM, WHATSAPP_SIM.
 * Triggers:
 *   - DISRUPTION_OPENED
 *   - PLAN_SUBMITTED
 *   - APPROVAL_DECIDED
 *   - GUARDRAIL_ESCALATION
 *   - RECOVERY_STATUS_CHANGED (PLAN_EXECUTED, PLAN_ROLLED_BACK)
 */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.dispatchNotification = dispatchNotification;
exports.initNotificationSubscribers = initNotificationSubscribers;
const notifications_js_1 = require("../models/notifications.js");
const users_js_1 = require("../models/users.js");
const simClock_js_1 = require("./simClock.js");
const bus_js_1 = require("./bus.js");
async function dispatchNotification(params) {
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    let users = [];
    if (params.target_user_ids && params.target_user_ids.length > 0) {
        users = await users_js_1.User.find({ _id: { $in: params.target_user_ids } }).lean();
    }
    else if (params.target_roles && params.target_roles.length > 0) {
        users = await users_js_1.User.find({ role: { $in: params.target_roles } }).lean();
    }
    else {
        // Default fan-out to analysts and managers
        users = await users_js_1.User.find({ role: { $in: ['Analyst', 'Manager', 'Procurement_Approver'] } }).lean();
    }
    const channels = ['IN_APP', 'EMAIL_SIM', 'WHATSAPP_SIM'];
    const createdDocs = [];
    for (const user of users) {
        for (const channel of channels) {
            const dedupKey = `${params.trigger}|${params.entity_id}|${user._id.toString()}|${channel}`;
            // Check if already dispatched (strictly exactly once per trigger)
            const existing = await notifications_js_1.Notification.findOne({ dedup_key: dedupKey });
            if (existing)
                continue;
            const doc = await notifications_js_1.Notification.create({
                user_id: user._id,
                channel,
                trigger: params.trigger,
                template_key: params.template_key,
                title: params.title,
                body: params.body,
                link_type: params.link_type,
                link_id: params.link_id,
                entity_type: params.entity_type,
                entity_id: params.entity_id,
                dedup_key: dedupKey,
                read: false,
                created_at: now,
            });
            createdDocs.push(doc);
        }
    }
    return createdDocs;
}
/**
 * Connect domain bus subscribers to notification fanout.
 */
function initNotificationSubscribers() {
    (0, bus_js_1.subscribe)('DISRUPTION_OPENED', async (payload) => {
        await dispatchNotification({
            trigger: 'DISRUPTION_OPENED',
            template_key: 'disruption_opened_tpl',
            title: 'Disruption Opened',
            body: `A new disruption of type ${payload.type} was detected.`,
            link_type: 'disruption',
            link_id: payload.disruptionId,
            entity_type: 'Disruption',
            entity_id: payload.disruptionId,
        });
    });
    (0, bus_js_1.subscribe)('PLAN_SUBMITTED', async (payload) => {
        await dispatchNotification({
            trigger: 'PLAN_SUBMITTED',
            template_key: 'plan_submitted_tpl',
            title: 'Recovery Plan Submitted',
            body: `Recovery plan ${payload.planId} is awaiting approval.`,
            link_type: 'plan',
            link_id: payload.planId,
            entity_type: 'RecoveryPlan',
            entity_id: payload.planId,
            target_roles: ['Manager', 'Procurement_Approver'],
        });
    });
    (0, bus_js_1.subscribe)('APPROVAL_DECIDED', async (payload) => {
        await dispatchNotification({
            trigger: 'APPROVAL_DECIDED',
            template_key: 'approval_decided_tpl',
            title: `Approval Decided: ${payload.decision}`,
            body: `Role ${payload.role} decided ${payload.decision} on plan ${payload.planId}.`,
            link_type: 'plan',
            link_id: payload.planId,
            entity_type: 'RecoveryPlan',
            entity_id: payload.planId,
        });
    });
    (0, bus_js_1.subscribe)('PLAN_EXECUTED', async (payload) => {
        await dispatchNotification({
            trigger: 'RECOVERY_STATUS_CHANGED',
            template_key: 'plan_executed_tpl',
            title: 'Recovery Plan Executed',
            body: `Recovery plan ${payload.planId} has been successfully executed.`,
            link_type: 'plan',
            link_id: payload.planId,
            entity_type: 'RecoveryPlan',
            entity_id: payload.planId,
        });
    });
}
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/playbook.ts
 *
 * Step 11 Part A – Playbook memory (A6).
 *
 * Similarity scoring formula:
 *   0.35 same disruption_type
 *   0.25 same supplier or warehouse
 *   0.20 same SKU overlap
 *   0.20 (1 - |shortage_ratio_difference|)
 *
 * Stores LIVE historical_cases rows after each disruption is closed.
 */
var __importDefault = (this && this.__importDefault) || function (mod) {
    return (mod && mod.__esModule) ? mod : { "default": mod };

Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.computeFingerprintCode = computeFingerprintCode;
exports.getSimilarCases = getSimilarCases;
exports.closeDisruptionAndSaveCase = closeDisruptionAndSaveCase;
const node_crypto_1 = __importDefault(require("node:crypto"));
const historical_cases_js_1 = require("../models/historical-cases.js");
const fingerprints_js_1 = require("../models/fingerprints.js");
const disruption_fingerprints_js_1 = require("../models/disruption-fingerprints.js");
const disruptions_js_1 = require("../models/disruptions.js");
const shipments_js_1 = require("../models/shipments.js");
const shipment_lines_js_1 = require("../models/shipment-lines.js");
const recovery_plans_js_1 = require("../models/recovery-plans.js");
const execution_ledger_js_1 = require("../models/execution-ledger.js");
const audit_js_1 = require("./audit.js");
const simClock_js_1 = require("./simClock.js");
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fingerprint key derivation (A10 helper)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function computeFingerprintCode(disruption_type, severity, sku_ids, warehouse_ids) {
    const sortedSkus = [...sku_ids].sort().join(',');
    const sortedWhs = [...warehouse_ids].sort().join(',');
    const raw = `${disruption_type}|${severity}|${sortedSkus}|${sortedWhs}`;
    return node_crypto_1.default.createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex').substring(0, 32);
}
function computeSimilarity(a, b) {
    let score = 0;
    // 0.35 same disruption type
    if (a.disruption_type === b.disruption_type)
        score += 0.35;
    // 0.25 same supplier or warehouse
    if ((a.supplier_id && b.supplier_id && a.supplier_id === b.supplier_id) ||
        (a.warehouse_id && b.warehouse_id && a.warehouse_id === b.warehouse_id)) {
        score += 0.25;
    }
    // 0.20 SKU overlap (Jaccard)
    const setA = new Set(a.sku_ids);
    const setB = new Set(b.sku_ids);
    const intersection = [...setA].filter((x) => setB.has(x)).length;
    const union = new Set([...setA, ...setB]).size;
    if (union > 0)
        score += 0.20 * (intersection / union);
    // 0.20 shortage ratio proximity
    const ratioDiff = Math.abs(a.shortage_ratio - b.shortage_ratio);
    score += 0.20 * (1 - Math.min(ratioDiff, 1));
    return Math.round(score * 1000) / 1000;
}
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Get similar cases for a disruption (GET /disruptions/:id/playbook)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function getSimilarCases(disruptionId) {
    const disruption = await disruptions_js_1.Disruption.findById(disruptionId).lean();
    if (!disruption)
        return { cases: [], method: 'rule-based' };
    const shipment = await shipments_js_1.Shipment.findById(disruption.shipment_id).lean();
    const lines = await shipment_lines_js_1.ShipmentLine.find({ shipment_id: disruption.shipment_id }).lean();
    const skuIds = lines.map((l) => l.sku_id.toString());
    const queryCtx = {
        disruption_type: disruption.disruption_type,
        supplier_id: shipment?.supplier_id.toString(),
        warehouse_id: shipment?.warehouse_id.toString(),
        sku_ids: skuIds,
        shortage_ratio: disruption.original_quantity > 0
            ? (disruption.original_quantity - disruption.usable_quantity) / disruption.original_quantity
            : 0,
    };
    // Load all historical cases
    const cases = await historical_cases_js_1.HistoricalCase.find({}).lean();
    const scored = cases
        .map((c) => {
        const ctx = {
            disruption_type: c.disruption_type,
            supplier_id: c.supplier_id,
            warehouse_id: c.warehouse_id,
            sku_ids: c.sku_ids || [],
            shortage_ratio: c.shortage_ratio || 0,
        };
        const similarity = computeSimilarity(queryCtx, ctx);
        const insight = buildInsightText(c);
        return {
            case_id: c._id,
            similarity,
            insight,
            disruption_type: c.disruption_type,
            strategy_used: c.strategy_used,
            outcome: c.outcome,
            cost: c.cost,
            resolution_hours: c.resolution_hours,
            what_tried: c.what_tried,
            what_worked: c.what_worked,
            what_failed: c.what_failed,
            why: c.why,
            created_at: c.created_at,
        };
    })
        .sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity)
        .slice(0, 3);
    return { cases: scored, method: 'rule-based' };
}
function buildInsightText(c) {
    const outcome = c.outcome === 'SUCCESS' ? 'resolved successfully' : 'resolved with partial/no recovery';
    return (`A similar ${c.disruption_type} disruption ${outcome} using "${c.strategy_used}". ` +
        `Resolution took ${c.resolution_hours}h at cost ₹${c.cost}. ` +
        `Late orders: ${c.late_orders || 0}.`);
}
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Close disruption and write historical_cases row (POST /disruptions/:id/close)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function closeDisruptionAndSaveCase(disruptionId, actorId, options) {
    const disruption = await disruptions_js_1.Disruption.findById(disruptionId);
    if (!disruption) {
        const error = new Error('Disruption not found');
        error.statusCode = 404;
        error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
        throw error;
    }
    if (disruption.status === 'RESOLVED') {
        const error = new Error('Disruption already resolved');
        error.statusCode = 409;
        error.code = 'ALREADY_RESOLVED';
        throw error;
    }
    // Find executed plan for this disruption
    const executedPlan = await recovery_plans_js_1.RecoveryPlan.findOne({
        disruption_id: disruption._id,
        status: { $in: ['EXECUTED', 'COMPLETED'] },
    }).lean();
    if (!executedPlan && !options?.no_action) {
        const error = new Error('Disruption requires an EXECUTED recovery plan, or explicit no_action=true to close');
        error.statusCode = 409;
        error.code = 'PLAN_NOT_EXECUTED';
        throw error;
    }
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    const shipment = await shipments_js_1.Shipment.findById(disruption.shipment_id).lean();
    const lines = await shipment_lines_js_1.ShipmentLine.find({ shipment_id: disruption.shipment_id }).lean();
    const skuIds = lines.map((l) => l.sku_id.toString());
    // Compute real freight cost from ledger
    let freightCost = 0;
    let lateOrders = 0;
    let whatTried = options?.no_action ? 'No action taken' : 'Recovery plan execution';
    let whatWorked = options?.no_action ? 'None' : 'Reallocation and expedites completed';
    let whatFailed = 'None';
    let why = options?.reason || (options?.no_action ? 'Explicitly marked no-action' : 'Normal resolution via recovery plan');
    if (executedPlan) {
        const ledgerRows = await execution_ledger_js_1.ExecutionLedger.find({ plan_id: executedPlan._id }).lean();
        freightCost = executedPlan.total_cost || 0;
        lateOrders = ledgerRows.filter((r) => r.step_type === 'EXPEDITE').length;
        whatTried = `Strategy: ${executedPlan.strategy}`;
        whatWorked = `Ledger actions executed: ${ledgerRows.length}`;
    }
    const resolutionHours = Math.round(((now.getTime() - disruption.detected_at.getTime()) / 3_600_000) * 10) / 10;
    const shortageRatio = disruption.original_quantity > 0
        ? (disruption.original_quantity - disruption.usable_quantity) / disruption.original_quantity
        : 0;
    // Compute/upsert fingerprint
    const fpCode = computeFingerprintCode(disruption.disruption_type, disruption.severity, skuIds, shipment ? [shipment.warehouse_id.toString()] : []);
    const fp = await fingerprints_js_1.Fingerprint.findOneAndUpdate({ code: fpCode }, {
        $set: {
            pattern: {
                disruption_type: disruption.disruption_type,
                severity: disruption.severity,
                sku_ids: skuIds,
                warehouse_ids: shipment ? [shipment.warehouse_id.toString()] : [],
            },
            last_seen_at: now,
        },
        $inc: { occurrence_count: 1 },
    }, { upsert: true, new: true });
    // Write disruption_fingerprints link
    await disruption_fingerprints_js_1.DisruptionFingerprint.findOneAndUpdate({ disruption_id: disruption._id }, { fingerprint_id: fp._id, similarity_score: 1.0 }, { upsert: true, new: true });
    // Write LIVE historical case
    const histCase = await historical_cases_js_1.HistoricalCase.create({
        fingerprint_id: fp._id,
        disruption_type: disruption.disruption_type,
        strategy_used: executedPlan ? executedPlan.strategy : 'NO_ACTION',
        outcome: executedPlan ? 'SUCCESS' : 'NO_ACTION',
        cost: freightCost,
        resolution_hours: resolutionHours,
        supplier_id: shipment?.supplier_id.toString() || null,
        warehouse_id: shipment?.warehouse_id.toString() || null,
        sku_ids: skuIds,
        shortage_ratio: shortageRatio,
        late_orders: lateOrders,
        what_tried: whatTried,
        what_worked: whatWorked,
        what_failed: whatFailed,
        why: why,
        is_seeded: false,
        created_at: now,
    });
    // Mark disruption RESOLVED
    const beforeStatus = disruption.status;
    disruption.status = 'RESOLVED';
    disruption.resolved_at = now;
    await disruption.save();
    // Audit log
    await (0, audit_js_1.writeAudit)({
        actor: actorId,
        action: 'DISRUPTION_CLOSED',
        entityType: 'Disruption',
        entityId: disruption._id.toString(),
        before: { status: beforeStatus },
        after: {
            status: 'RESOLVED',
            resolved_at: now,
            historical_case_id: histCase._id.toString(),
            resolution_hours: resolutionHours,
        },
    });
    return {
        disruption_id: disruption._id,
        status: 'RESOLVED',
        historical_case_id: histCase._id,
        fingerprint_code: fpCode,
        resolution_hours: resolutionHours,
        strategy_used: executedPlan ? executedPlan.strategy : 'NO_ACTION',
    };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/promiseDates.ts
 *
 * Promise-Date Repair Engine (Step 9, A7).
 * For each affected order:
 *   - original = order.due_at
 *   - best recoverable = earliest time FULL quantity can be on hand
 *     (latest of sources needed: free stock now, transfer arrival, supplier lead time)
 *     + fulfilment warehouse processing hours (2 hours)
 *   - committed = proposed in plan (defaults to best recoverable)
 */
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
export interface PromiseDateInfo {
    order_id: string;
    order_code: string;
    original_promise: string;
    best_recoverable: string;
    current_promise: string;
    delay_hours: number;
    basis: string;
    evidence_ids: string[];
}
export declare function computePromiseDatesForPlan(planId: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string): Promise<PromiseDateInfo[]>;
//# sourceMappingURL=promiseDates.d.ts.map
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/promiseDates.ts
 *
 * Promise-Date Repair Engine (Step 9, A7).
 * For each affected order:
 *   - original = order.due_at
 *   - best recoverable = earliest time FULL quantity can be on hand
 *     (latest of sources needed: free stock now, transfer arrival, supplier lead time)
 *     + fulfilment warehouse processing hours (2 hours)
 *   - committed = proposed in plan (defaults to best recoverable)
 */
var __importDefault = (this && this.__importDefault) || function (mod) {
    return (mod && mod.__esModule) ? mod : { "default": mod };

Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.computePromiseDatesForPlan = computePromiseDatesForPlan;
const mongoose_1 = __importDefault(require("mongoose"));
const orders_js_1 = require("../models/orders.js");
const order_promise_dates_js_1 = require("../models/order-promise-dates.js");
const plan_actions_js_1 = require("../models/plan-actions.js");
const recovery_plans_js_1 = require("../models/recovery-plans.js");
const simClock_js_1 = require("./simClock.js");
async function computePromiseDatesForPlan(planId) {
    const pId = typeof planId === 'string' ? new mongoose_1.default.Types.ObjectId(planId) : planId;
    const plan = await recovery_plans_js_1.RecoveryPlan.findById(pId);
    if (!plan)
        throw new Error('Recovery plan not found');
    const actions = await plan_actions_js_1.PlanAction.find({ plan_id: pId });
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    // Find all affected open orders for this plan
    const destWarehouseIds = Array.from(new Set(actions.map((a) => a.to_warehouse_id)));
    const orders = await orders_js_1.Order.find({
        warehouse_id: { $in: destWarehouseIds },
        status: { $in: ['OPEN', 'RECOVERING'] },
    });
    const maxActionDuration = actions.reduce((max, a) => Math.max(max, a.duration_hours || 0), 0);
    const processingHours = 2; // warehouse processing time
    const results = [];
    for (const ord of orders) {
        const originalPromise = ord.due_at;
        // Earliest time full quantity is available = now + max duration needed + 2h processing
        const bestRecoverableMs = now.getTime() + (maxActionDuration + processingHours) * 3600 * 1000;
        const bestRecoverable = new Date(Math.max(originalPromise.getTime(), bestRecoverableMs));
        const delayHours = Math.max(0, Math.round((bestRecoverable.getTime() - originalPromise.getTime()) / 3600000));
        // Upsert or retrieve existing OrderPromiseDate
        const opd = await order_promise_dates_js_1.OrderPromiseDate.findOneAndUpdate({ order_id: ord._id }, {
            $set: {
                original_promise: originalPromise,
                current_promise: bestRecoverable,
                delay_hours: delayHours,
                reason: `Recovery plan ${pId} (v${plan.version}): max action transit ${maxActionDuration}h + ${processingHours}h processing`,
                updated_at: now,
            },
        }, { upsert: true, new: true });
        results.push({
            order_id: ord._id.toString(),
            order_code: ord.code,
            original_promise: originalPromise.toISOString(),
            best_recoverable: bestRecoverable.toISOString(),
            current_promise: opd.current_promise.toISOString(),
            delay_hours: delayHours,
            basis: `Action transit: ${maxActionDuration}h, Processing: ${processingHours}h`,
            evidence_ids: [ord._id.toString(), ...(actions.map((a) => a._id.toString()))],
        });
    }
    // Save committed promise dates into plan's decision contract
    if (plan.decision_contract) {
        plan.decision_contract.committed_promise_dates = results.map((r) => ({
            order_code: r.order_code,
            promised_at: r.current_promise,
        }));
````

````typescript
/**

 *
 * "The AI proposes. The code proves."

import mongoose from 'mongoose';

        description: string;
        expected: any;
        actual: any;
        evidence_ids: string[];
    }>;
    contract_hash: string;
    decision_contract: DecisionContract;
    failing_claims: string[];
}
export interface DecisionContract {
    plan_id: string;
    version: number;
    contract_hash: string;
    required_approver_roles: string[];
    verification_status: 'VERIFIED' | 'BLOCKED';
    reservation_ids: string[];
    reservation_expiry: string | null;
    rollback_eligibility: boolean;
    expected_impact: {
        total_cost: number;
        residual_risk: number;
        objective: number;
        baseline: number;
    };
    guardrail_results: any[];
    committed_promise_dates: any[];
    escalation_approvals_required: boolean;
}
/**
 * Pure check function for Ask the Desk answer facts (B4).
 */
export declare function checkAnswerFact(answerFacts: Array<{
    label: string;
    value: any;
}>, queryResultRows: any[]): {
    pass: boolean;
    expected: any;
    actual: any;
    evidence_ids: string[];
};
/**
 * Pure check function for Customer Notice dates (B18).
 */
export declare function checkNoticeDateMatches(noticeDateIso: string, committedDateIso: string): {
    pass: boolean;
    expected: string;
    actual: string;
};
/**
 * Computes canonical SHA-256 hash of a plan's actions.
 */
export declare function computeContractHash(actions: IPlanAction[]): string;
/**
 * Derives required approval roles from plan actions.
 * REALLOCATE/SPLIT -> Manager; EXPEDITE/ALT_SUPPLIER -> Procurement_Approver
 */
export declare function deriveRequiredApproverRoles(actions: IPlanAction[]): string[];
/**
 * Generates mandatory SYSTEM claims for every action in a recovery plan.
 */
export declare function generateMandatoryClaims(plan: IRecoveryPlan, actions: IPlanAction[]): Promise<void>;
/**
 * Executes Proof Checker against live database state.
 */
export declare function verifyPlan(planId: mongoose.Types.ObjectId | string): Promise<VerificationResult>;
/**

 */
````

## File: apps/api/dist/services/reconciler.d.ts
````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/reconciler.ts
 *
 * Belief-ETA Reconciler: evaluates incoming shipment events against current state.
 *
 * Decision order:
 *  a. Unknown shipment → REJECTED
 *  b. Same (source, external_event_id) → DUPLICATE (catch dup key error 11000)
 *  c. event_time older than basis event from equal/higher trust → STALE
 *  d. Two trusted sources differ by > tolerance → CONFLICT
 *  e. Sources agree within tolerance → APPLIED (higher-trust value wins)
 *  f. Newer trusted event → APPLIED, update resolved_eta + eta_basis_event_id
 */
import { ClientSession } from 'mongoose';
export interface IncomingEvent {
    source: string;
    external_event_id: string;
    event_type: string;
    shipment_code: string;
    reported_eta?: Date;
    event_time?: Date;
    quantity_affected?: number;
    raw_payload: Record<string, unknown>;
    correlation_id: string;
}
export interface ReconcileResult {
    status: 'APPLIED' | 'DUPLICATE' | 'STALE' | 'CONFLICT' | 'REJECTED';
    eventId?: string;
    reason: string;
    shipment_code: string;
}
/**
 * Main reconcile function. If session is provided, runs inside caller's transaction.
 * Otherwise wraps in its own transaction.
 */
export declare function reconcile(event: IncomingEvent, session?: ClientSession): Promise<ReconcileResult>;
//# sourceMappingURL=reconciler.d.ts.map
````

````javascript
/**

 *

 *
 * Decision order:
 *  a. Unknown shipment → REJECTED

 *  c. event_time older than basis event from equal/higher trust → STALE

 * Otherwise wraps in its own transaction.

async function reconcile(event, session) {

}

            action: 'WEBHOOK_RECEIVED',
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
````
````typescript
 * apps/api/src/services/replay.ts
 *
 * Decision Replay Service (Step 10, A5).
 * Reconstructs chronological timeline of events and audit logs for a disruption.
 * When `upTo` step is specified, reconstructs past system state from audit before/after values.
 */
````

````javascript
const audit_logs_js_1 = require("../models/audit-logs.js");
const disruptions_js_1 = require("../models/disruptions.js");
async function getDecisionReplay(disruptionId, upToStep) {
    const dId = typeof disruptionId === 'string' ? new mongoose_1.default.Types.ObjectId(disruptionId) : disruptionId;
    const disruption = await disruptions_js_1.Disruption.findById(dId);
    if (!disruption)
        throw new Error('Disruption not found');
    const correlationId = disruption.correlation_id || disruption._id.toString();
    // Find audit logs matching correlationId, disruption_id, or shipment_id
    const auditLogs = await audit_logs_js_1.AuditLog.find({
        $or: [
            { correlationId },
            { 'after.disruption_id': disruption._id.toString() },
            { entityId: disruption._id.toString() },
            { entityId: disruption.shipment_id.toString() },
        ],
    })
        .sort({ seq: 1 })
        .lean();
    const steps = auditLogs.map((log, index) => {
        const after = log.after;
        const before = log.before;

            step_number: index + 1,
            step_type: log.action || log.step_type || 'AUDIT_STEP',
            source: log.actor ? log.actor.toString() : 'SYSTEM',
            timestamp: log.created_at ? new Date(log.created_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
            audit_id: log._id.toString(),
            reason: after?.reason || before?.reason || log.action || 'Audit log event recorded',
            details: after || before || {},

        disruption_id: disruption._id.toString(),
        correlation_id: correlationId,
        total_steps: steps.length,
        steps,

        const clampedStep = Math.min(upToStep, steps.length);
        response.active_step = clampedStep;
        response.steps = steps.slice(0, clampedStep);
        // Reconstruct state at that step from audit logs
        let resolvedEta = null;
        let riskScore = null;
        let planStatus = null;
        for (let i = 0; i < clampedStep; i++) {
            const details = steps[i].details;
            if (details.resolved_eta)
                resolvedEta = details.resolved_eta;
            if (details.risk_score !== undefined)
                riskScore = details.risk_score;
            if (details.plan_status)
                planStatus = details.plan_status;
            if (details.status)
                planStatus = details.status;
        }

            resolved_eta: resolvedEta,
            risk_score: riskScore,
            plan_status: planStatus,

    };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/reservations.ts
 *
 * Double-Booking Shield and Stock Reservation Management (Step 9, S1, S2, A4).
 * Enforces atomic conditional updates on MongoDB replica set transactions.
````

````javascript
const inventory_balances_js_1 = require("../models/inventory-balances.js");
const allocation_conflicts_js_1 = require("../models/allocation-conflicts.js");

    if (!plan)
        return { success: false, reservationIds: [], conflictReason: 'Plan not found' };

    const existingConflict = await allocation_conflicts_js_1.AllocationConflict.findOne({
        status: 'OPEN',
    }).session(session || null);
    if (existingConflict) {
        const claims = await allocation_claims_js_1.AllocationClaim.find({ conflict_id: existingConflict._id }).session(session || null);
        const isPlanInConflict = claims.some((c) => c.plan_id.toString() === pId.toString());
        if (isPlanInConflict) {
            return {
                success: false,

                conflictReason: 'Plan has an OPEN allocation conflict case. Resolve in Allocation Conflict Court first.',

    }
    const actions = await plan_actions_js_1.PlanAction.find({ plan_id: pId }).session(session || null);
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();

    // Group demand by (warehouse_id, sku_id)
    const demandMap = new Map();
    for (const act of actions) {
        if (act.action_type === 'TRANSFER' && act.from_warehouse_id) {
            const key = `${act.from_warehouse_id.toString()}|${act.sku_id.toString()}`;
            if (!demandMap.has(key)) {
                demandMap.set(key, {
                    warehouse_id: act.from_warehouse_id,
                    sku_id: act.sku_id,
                    qty: 0,
                    action_ids: [],
                });
            }
            const entry = demandMap.get(key);
            entry.qty += act.quantity;
            entry.action_ids.push(act._id);
        }
    }
    // Sort entries deterministically by (warehouse_id, sku_id) to avoid deadlock
    const sortedDemands = Array.from(demandMap.values()).sort((a, b) => {
        const cmpWh = a.warehouse_id.toString().localeCompare(b.warehouse_id.toString());
        if (cmpWh !== 0)
            return cmpWh;
        return a.sku_id.toString().localeCompare(b.sku_id.toString());

            const currentBal = await inventory_balances_js_1.InventoryBalance.findOne({
                warehouse_id: demand.warehouse_id,
                sku_id: demand.sku_id,

            const free = currentBal ? Math.max(0, currentBal.on_hand - currentBal.reserved) : 0;

            const competingHolds = await stock_reservations_js_1.StockReservation.find({

                sku_id: demand.sku_id,
                status: 'HELD',

            const holdingPlanIds = Array.from(new Set(competingHolds.map((h) => h.plan_id.toString())));
            // Allocation Conflict Court (A4): Create exactly ONE case if competing plan exists
            if (holdingPlanIds.length > 0) {
                const otherPlanId = holdingPlanIds[0];
                const existingCase = await allocation_conflicts_js_1.AllocationConflict.findOne({
                    sku_id: demand.sku_id,
                    warehouse_id: demand.warehouse_id,
                    status: 'OPEN',

                if (!existingCase) {

                            sku_id: demand.sku_id,
                            warehouse_id: demand.warehouse_id,
                            total_requested: demand.qty,
                            available: free,
                            status: 'OPEN',

                            plan_id: pId,
                            order_id: actions[0]?.to_warehouse_id || demand.warehouse_id,
                            requested_qty: demand.qty,
                            granted_qty: 0,
                            priority_score: 80,
                            reason: `Proposed recovery plan ${pId} requires ${demand.qty} units`,
                        },
                        {
                            conflict_id: newCase._id,
                            plan_id: new mongoose_1.default.Types.ObjectId(otherPlanId),
                            order_id: actions[0]?.to_warehouse_id || demand.warehouse_id,
                            requested_qty: competingHolds.reduce((s, h) => s + h.quantity, 0),
                            granted_qty: 0,
                            priority_score: 75,
                            reason: `Active held reservation for plan ${otherPlanId}`,
                        },
                    ], { session });
                }
            }
            return {
                success: false,
                reservationIds: [],
                conflictReason: `Stock reservation conflict: Warehouse ${demand.warehouse_id} has insufficient free stock for SKU ${demand.sku_id}. Needed ${demand.qty}, available ${free}.`,
                conflictCard: {
                    warehouse_id: demand.warehouse_id.toString(),
                    sku_id: demand.sku_id.toString(),
                    needed: demand.qty,
                    free,
                    holding_plans: holdingPlanIds,
                },
            };
        }
        // Reservation succeeded: record individual actions
        for (const actionId of demand.action_ids) {
            const act = actions.find((a) => a._id.toString() === actionId.toString());
            if (act) {
                const [resDoc] = await stock_reservations_js_1.StockReservation.create([
                    {
                        plan_id: pId,
                        action_id: act._id,
                        warehouse_id: demand.warehouse_id,
                        sku_id: demand.sku_id,
                        quantity: act.quantity,
                        status: 'HELD',
                        reserved_at: now,
                        expires_at: expiresAt,
                        released_at: null,
                    },
                ], { session });
                reservationIds.push(resDoc._id.toString());
            }
        }
    }
    return { success: true, reservationIds };
}
/**
 * Release all HELD reservations for a plan and restore reserved counts.
 */
async function releaseStock(planId, session) {
    const pId = typeof planId === 'string' ? new mongoose_1.default.Types.ObjectId(planId) : planId;
    const reservations = await stock_reservations_js_1.StockReservation.find({
        plan_id: pId,
        status: 'HELD',

    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    let count = 0;
    for (const res of reservations) {
        await inventory_balances_js_1.InventoryBalance.updateOne({ warehouse_id: res.warehouse_id, sku_id: res.sku_id }, {
            $inc: { reserved: -res.quantity },
            $set: { updated_at: now },

        res.status = 'RELEASED';
        res.released_at = now;
        await res.save({ session });

}
/**
 * Convert HELD reservations to CONSUMED upon execution.
 */
async function commitStock(planId, session) {
    const pId = typeof planId === 'string' ? new mongoose_1.default.Types.ObjectId(planId) : planId;

/**
 * Reaper: sweep and release any expired HELD reservations.
 */
async function reapExpiredReservations() {
    const now = await simClock_js_1.simClock.now();
    const expired = await stock_reservations_js_1.StockReservation.find({
        status: 'HELD',
        expires_at: { $lte: now },

    let count = 0;
    for (const res of expired) {
        await inventory_balances_js_1.InventoryBalance.updateOne({ warehouse_id: res.warehouse_id, sku_id: res.sku_id }, {
            $inc: { reserved: -res.quantity },
            $set: { updated_at: now },
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/scenarioB.ts
 *
 * Scenario B generator for the "Send duplicate storm" demo:
 * - Sends EVT-2001 for SHP-310 five times → 1 APPLIED + 4 DUPLICATE
 * - Sends EVT-1999 (older event_time) → STALE
 * - Sends EVT-CONFLICT from SUPPLIER_PORTAL differing by 9 hours → CONFLICT
 *
 * Returns counts from real DB results.
 */
export interface ScenarioBResult {
    sent: number;
    applied: number;
    duplicates: number;
    stale: number;
    conflicts: number;
}
export declare function runScenarioB(shipmentCode?: string): Promise<ScenarioBResult>;
````

````javascript
"use strict";
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/scenarioB.ts
 *
 * Scenario B generator for the "Send duplicate storm" demo:
 * - Sends EVT-2001 for SHP-310 five times → 1 APPLIED + 4 DUPLICATE
 * - Sends EVT-1999 (older event_time) → STALE
 * - Sends EVT-CONFLICT from SUPPLIER_PORTAL differing by 9 hours → CONFLICT
 *
 * Returns counts from real DB results.
 */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.runScenarioB = runScenarioB;
const reconciler_js_1 = require("./reconciler.js");
const shipment_events_js_1 = require("../models/shipment-events.js");
const withTransaction_js_1 = require("../db/withTransaction.js");
async function runScenarioB(shipmentCode = 'SHP-310') {
    const results = [];
    // Step 1: Send EVT-2001 five times (should be 1 APPLIED + 4 DUPLICATE)
    const baseEvent = {
        source: 'CARRIER_API',
        external_event_id: 'EVT-2001',
        event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
        shipment_code: shipmentCode,
        reported_eta: new Date('2026-11-03T06:00:00Z'),
        event_time: new Date('2026-11-01T10:00:00Z'),
        raw_payload: {
            external_event_id: 'EVT-2001',
            shipment_code: shipmentCode,
            event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
            reported_eta: '2026-11-03T06:00:00Z',
            event_time: '2026-11-01T10:00:00Z',
        },
        correlation_id: 'scenario-b-dup-storm',
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const r = await (0, withTransaction_js_1.withTransaction)((session) => (0, reconciler_js_1.reconcile)(baseEvent, session));
        results.push(r);
    }
    // Step 2: Send EVT-1999 with older event_time → STALE
    const staleEvent = {
        source: 'CARRIER_API',
        external_event_id: 'EVT-1999',
        event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
        shipment_code: shipmentCode,
        reported_eta: new Date('2026-11-02T06:00:00Z'),
        event_time: new Date('2026-10-31T08:00:00Z'), // older than EVT-2001's event_time
        raw_payload: {
            external_event_id: 'EVT-1999',
            shipment_code: shipmentCode,
            event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
            reported_eta: '2026-11-02T06:00:00Z',
            event_time: '2026-10-31T08:00:00Z',
        },
        correlation_id: 'scenario-b-stale',
    };
    const staleResult = await (0, withTransaction_js_1.withTransaction)((session) => (0, reconciler_js_1.reconcile)(staleEvent, session));
    results.push(staleResult);
    // Step 3: Send EVT-CONFLICT from SUPPLIER_PORTAL with ETA differing by 9 hours → CONFLICT
    // CARRIER_API applied ETA is 2026-11-03T06:00:00Z
    // SUPPLIER_PORTAL sends 2026-11-03T15:00:00Z (+9h > 4h tolerance)
    const conflictEvent = {
        source: 'SUPPLIER_PORTAL',
        external_event_id: 'EVT-CONFLICT',
        event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
        shipment_code: shipmentCode,
        reported_eta: new Date('2026-11-03T15:00:00Z'),
        event_time: new Date('2026-11-01T11:00:00Z'),
        raw_payload: {
            external_event_id: 'EVT-CONFLICT',
            shipment_code: shipmentCode,
            event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
            reported_eta: '2026-11-03T15:00:00Z',
            event_time: '2026-11-01T11:00:00Z',
        },
        correlation_id: 'scenario-b-conflict',
    };
    const conflictResult = await (0, withTransaction_js_1.withTransaction)((session) => (0, reconciler_js_1.reconcile)(conflictEvent, session));
    results.push(conflictResult);
    // Count from real DB (authoritative)
    const externalIds = ['EVT-2001', 'EVT-1999', 'EVT-CONFLICT'];
    const dbEvents = await shipment_events_js_1.ShipmentEvent.find({
        external_event_id: { $in: externalIds },
        shipment_id: { $exists: true },
    }).lean();
    const dbApplied = dbEvents.filter((e) => e.reconcile_status === 'APPLIED').length;
    const dbStale = dbEvents.filter((e) => e.reconcile_status === 'STALE').length;
    const dbConflict = dbEvents.filter((e) => e.reconcile_status === 'CONFLICT').length;
    // DUPLICATE is detected before DB insert, so count from results array
    const dupCount = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'DUPLICATE').length;
    return {
        sent: results.length,
        applied: dbApplied,
        duplicates: dupCount,
        stale: dbStale,
        conflicts: dbConflict,
    };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/scenarioC.ts
 *
 * Scenario C (Demo Day Synthetic Flow):
 * 1. SEVERE crush event on a parcel of SHP-310 at WH-CHN:
 *    - Creates an OPEN supplier claim.
 *    - Reconciler applies a 48-hour delay to SHP-310 ETA.
 *    - Writes a quarantine ledger row in execution_ledger.
 * 2. Inbound planning triggers over-capacity at WH-CHN:
 *    - Zone ZN-CHN-REC (capacity: 30 slots) receives an inbound plan of 35 slots.
 *    - Zone goes RED (>100% utilisation), generating a ZONE_OVER_CAPACITY alert.
 * 3. Driver incident & governed reroute:
 *    - DRV-2 reports a BREAKDOWN between BLR and CHN on lane BLR-CHN.
 *    - Dijkstra identifies the nearest warehouse (WH-BLR / WH-CHN).
 *    - A RerouteProposal is generated.
 *    - A non-reporting Manager approves the proposal -> EXECUTED_SIMULATED.
 *    - Destination updated without modifying inventory balances.
 */
export interface ScenarioCResult {
    damage_event: {
        clip_id: string;
        event_id: string;
        claim_id: string;
        shipment_code: string;
        previous_eta: Date;
        new_eta: Date;
        delay_hours: number;
        quarantine_ledger_id: string;
    };
    capacity_event: {
        warehouse_id: string;
        zone_id: string;
        plan_id: string;
        capacity_slots: number;
        reserved_slots: number;
        utilisation_pct: number;
        colour: string;
        alert_opened: boolean;
    };
    reroute_event: {
        driver_id: string;
        incident_id: string;
        proposal_id: string;
        nearest_warehouse_id: string;
        status: string;
        approved_by: string;
    };
}
export declare function runScenarioC(): Promise<ScenarioCResult>;
//# sourceMappingURL=scenarioC.d.ts.map
````
