````typescript
      {
        $set: {
          username: 'sup2',
          password_hash: 'hash',
          role: 'SUPPLIER',
          supplier_id: 'SUP-2',
          display_name: 'Precision Components Rep',
        },
      },
      { upsert: true, new: true },
    );

    // Create dynamic user for role change test
    const dynamicUser = await User.findOneAndUpdate(
      { username: 'dynamic_user' },
      {
        $set: {
          username: 'dynamic_user',
          password_hash: 'hash',
          role: 'Analyst',
          display_name: 'Dynamic Role User',
        },
      },
      { upsert: true, new: true },
    );
    dynamicUserId = dynamicUser!._id.toString();

    // Seed test claims for SUP-1 and SUP-2
    await SupplierClaim.findOneAndUpdate(
      { claim_id: 'CLM-SUP1-001' },
      {
        $set: {
          claim_id: 'CLM-SUP1-001',
          supplier_id: 'SUP-1',
          shipment_id: 'SHP-204',
          cctv_event_id: 'EVT-CCTV-01',
          band: 'MAJOR',
          units: 20,
          delay_hours: 24,
          status: 'OPEN',
        },
      },
      { upsert: true },
    );

    await SupplierClaim.findOneAndUpdate(
      { claim_id: 'CLM-SUP2-001' },
      {
        $set: {
          claim_id: 'CLM-SUP2-001',
          supplier_id: 'SUP-2',
          shipment_id: 'SHP-310',
          cctv_event_id: 'EVT-CCTV-02',
          band: 'SEVERE',
          units: 15,
          delay_hours: 48,
          status: 'OPEN',
        },
      },
      { upsert: true },
    );

    // Generate tokens
    const drv1User = await User.findOne({ username: 'drv1' }).lean();
    const drv2User = await User.findOne({ username: 'drv2' }).lean();
    const sup1User = await User.findOne({ username: 'sup1' }).lean();
    const sup2User = await User.findOne({ username: 'sup2' }).lean();

    const opBlrUser = await User.findOne({ username: 'operator_blr' }).lean();

    drv1Token = jwt.sign(

      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );
    drv2Token = jwt.sign(
      { sub: drv2User!._id.toString(), username: 'drv2', role: 'DRIVER', driver_id: 'DRV-2', truck_id: 'SHP-310' },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );
    sup1Token = jwt.sign(
      { sub: sup1User!._id.toString(), username: 'sup1', role: 'SUPPLIER', supplier_id: 'SUP-1' },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );
    sup2Token = jwt.sign(
      { sub: sup2User!._id.toString(), username: 'sup2', role: 'SUPPLIER', supplier_id: 'SUP-2' },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );
    procurementToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: procUser!._id.toString(), username: 'procurement', role: 'Procurement_Approver' },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );
    operatorBlrToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: opBlrUser!._id.toString(), username: 'operator_blr', role: 'Warehouse_Operator', warehouse_id: blrWarehouse!._id.toString() },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );
    dynamicUserToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: dynamicUserId, username: 'dynamic_user', role: 'Analyst' },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
    );

    // Start HTTP and WebSocket test server on random port
    server = http.createServer(app);
    initWebSocketServer(server);
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      server.listen(0, () => {
        wsPort = (server.address() as AddressInfo).port;
        resolve();
      });

  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await closeWebSocketServer();
    if (server) {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
    }
    await User.deleteMany({ username: { $in: ['operator_blr', 'sup2', 'dynamic_user'] } });
    await SupplierClaim.deleteMany({ claim_id: { $in: ['CLM-SUP1-001', 'CLM-SUP2-001'] } });
    await InboundSlotPlan.deleteMany({ zone_id: 'ZN-HOS-STR' });
    await mongoose.disconnect();
  });

  // ── 1. DRIVER SCOPING TESTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('Driver token for DRV-1 cannot read DRV-2 positions (403)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/tracking/drivers/DRV-2/positions')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Forbidden');
  });

  it('Driver token for DRV-1 cannot call any approve route (403)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/plans/PLN-2026-0042/approve')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({ role: 'Manager', notes: 'Driver trying to approve' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  // ── 2. SUPPLIER SCOPING TESTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('Supplier token for SUP-1 cannot read SUP-2 claims (403)', async () => {
    // 1. Direct claim lookup
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/claims/CLM-SUP2-001')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sup1Token}`);

    expect(res1.status).toBe(403);

    // 2. Query filter on other supplier
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/claims?supplier_id=SUP-2')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sup1Token}`);

    expect(res2.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('Procurement cannot read driver positions (403)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/tracking/positions')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${procurementToken}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  // ── 3. OPERATOR SCOPING TESTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('Operator for WH-BLR cannot read WH-HOS tracking (403)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/tracking/positions?warehouse_id=WH-HOS')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorBlrToken}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  // ── 4. WEBSOCKET TESTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('WebSocket: non-auth first message closes the socket with error', async () => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:${wsPort}/ws`);

    const closePromise = new Promise<{ code: number; reason: string }>((resolve) => {
      ws.on('close', (code, reason) => {
        resolve({ code, reason: reason.toString() });
      });
    });

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => ws.on('open', () => resolve()));
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'tracking' })); // Invalid first message

    const result = await closePromise;
    expect(result.code).toBe(4002);
  });

  it('WebSocket: bad token is refused and socket is closed', async () => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:${wsPort}/ws`);

    const closePromise = new Promise<{ code: number; reason: string }>((resolve) => {
      ws.on('close', (code, reason) => {
        resolve({ code, reason: reason.toString() });
      });
    });

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => ws.on('open', () => resolve()));
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', token: 'bad-tampered-token-123' }));

    const result = await closePromise;
    expect(result.code).toBe(4003);
  });

  it('WebSocket: a driver socket receives only its own truck frames', async () => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:${wsPort}/ws`);

    const messages: any[] = [];
    ws.on('message', (data) => {
      messages.push(JSON.parse(data.toString()));
    });

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => ws.on('open', () => resolve()));

    // 1. Authenticate with DRV-1 token
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', token: drv1Token }));
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));

    expect(messages.some((m) => m.type === 'auth_ok')).toBe(true);

    // 2. Subscribe to tracking
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'tracking' }));
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));

    expect(messages.some((m) => m.type === 'subscribed' && m.topic === 'tracking')).toBe(true);

    // 3. Broadcast two tracking updates: one for SHP-204 (DRV-1) and one for SHP-310 (DRV-2)
    await broadcastToTopic('tracking', {
      truck_id: 'SHP-204',
      driver_id: 'DRV-1',
      lat: 12.80,
      lng: 77.90,
      speed_kmh: 52,
    });

    await broadcastToTopic('tracking', {
      truck_id: 'SHP-310',
      driver_id: 'DRV-2',
      lat: 13.05,
      lng: 80.20,
      speed_kmh: 48,
    });

    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150));

    const events = messages.filter((m) => m.type === 'event' && m.topic === 'tracking');
    expect(events.length).toBe(1);
    expect(events[0].data.truck_id).toBe('SHP-204');
    expect(events[0].data.driver_id).toBe('DRV-1');

    ws.close();
  });

  // ── 5. IMMEDIATE ROLE REFLECTION TEST ──────────────────────────────────────
  it('A changed role on user record takes effect immediately, including on open socket subscription', async () => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:${wsPort}/ws`);
    const messages: any[] = [];
    ws.on('message', (data) => {
      messages.push(JSON.parse(data.toString()));
    });

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => ws.on('open', () => resolve()));

    // Authenticate as dynamicUser (currently Analyst)
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', token: dynamicUserToken }));
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    expect(messages.some((m) => m.type === 'auth_ok')).toBe(true);

    // Change role in MongoDB directly to DRIVER
    await User.findByIdAndUpdate(dynamicUserId, { $set: { role: 'DRIVER', driver_id: 'DRV-DYN' } });

    // Next subscription attempt for a topic that DRIVER cannot access (e.g. cctv)
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'cctv' }));
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));

    // The server live-checked the DB, recognized the new DRIVER role, and rejected the cctv subscription!
    const errorMsg = messages.find((m) => m.type === 'error' && m.topic === 'cctv');
    expect(errorMsg).toBeDefined();
    expect(errorMsg.message).toContain('Forbidden');

    ws.close();
  });

  // ── 6. MONGO CONSTRAINTS & VALIDATORS TESTS ─────────────────────────────────
  it('Mongo validators reject zone reserved_inbound_slots above capacity_slots', async () => {
    let errorCaught: any = null;
    try {
      await Zone.create({
        zone_id: `ZN-TEST-${Date.now()}`,
        warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
        name: `Invalid Zone ${Date.now()}`,
        zone_type: 'STORAGE',
        polygon: [[0, 0], [100, 100]],
        capacity_slots: 20,
        reserved_inbound_slots: 35, // Violates reserved <= capacity
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      errorCaught = err;
    }

    expect(errorCaught).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('Mongo unique index rejects duplicate (driver_id, seq) pings', async () => {
    const driverId = `DRV-DUP-${Date.now()}`;
    await DriverPing.create({
      driver_id: driverId,
      truck_id: 'TRK-TEST',
      seq: 1,
      ts: new Date(),
      lat: 12.5,
      lng: 77.5,
      speed_kmh: 40,
    });

    let duplicateErr: any = null;
    try {
      await DriverPing.create({
        driver_id: driverId,
        truck_id: 'TRK-TEST',
        seq: 1, // Same seq for same driver_id
        ts: new Date(),
        lat: 12.6,
        lng: 77.6,
        speed_kmh: 42,
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      duplicateErr = err;
    }

    expect(duplicateErr).not.toBeNull();
    expect(duplicateErr.code).toBe(11000);
  });

  it('Unique partial index on inbound_slot_plans prevents two PLANNED plans for one shipment', async () => {
    const shipmentId = `SHP-SLOT-${Date.now()}`;

    // First plan with status PLANNED succeeds
    await InboundSlotPlan.create({
      shipment_id: shipmentId,
      zone_id: 'ZN-HOS-REC',
      slots: 10,
      status: 'PLANNED',
    });

    // Second plan for SAME shipment with status PLANNED must fail with duplicate key
    let dupPlanErr: any = null;
    try {
      await InboundSlotPlan.create({
        shipment_id: shipmentId,
        zone_id: 'ZN-HOS-STR',
        slots: 15,
        status: 'PLANNED',
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      dupPlanErr = err;
    }

    expect(dupPlanErr).not.toBeNull();
    expect(dupPlanErr.code).toBe(11000);

    // Releasing the first plan allows a subsequent PLANNED row
    await InboundSlotPlan.updateOne({ shipment_id: shipmentId, status: 'PLANNED' }, { $set: { status: 'RELEASED' } });

    const newPlan = await InboundSlotPlan.create({
      shipment_id: shipmentId,
      zone_id: 'ZN-HOS-STR',
      slots: 15,
      status: 'PLANNED',
    });

    expect(newPlan._id).toBeDefined();
  });

  // ── 7. MODEL SMOKE TEST VERIFICATION ───────────────────────────────────────
  it('Model smoke test from Step 5 passes with valid detections', () => {
    const fixturePath = path.resolve('services/vision/tests/fixtures/model_smoke.json');
    expect(fs.existsSync(fixturePath)).toBe(true);

    const smoke = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fixturePath, 'utf-8'));
    expect(smoke.model_sha256).toBe('84c9b943672e676f32c97dc36a81aae8766bdd96646e1b5e552de17aebca289c');
    expect(smoke.class_names['0']).toBe('Damaged');
    expect(smoke.class_names['1']).toBe('Normal');
    expect(smoke.detection_count).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(smoke.detections.length).toBe(smoke.detection_count);
    expect(smoke.detections[0].confidence).toBeGreaterThan(0.5);
  });
});
````

## File: apps/api/test/step20-damage-detector.test.ts
````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/test/step20-damage-detector.test.ts
 *
 * Vitest acceptance tests for Step 20 CCTV Damage Detection & Adjudication Pipeline:
 *
 * (e) Evidence verify passes on untampered file and returns TAMPER_DETECTED on tampered file.
 * (f) SEVERE event sends 48h delay to reconciler, creates OPEN claim, writes quarantine ledger row.
 * (g) Operator who linked cannot accept the claim (403 Separation of Duties).
 * (h) Supplier 2 cannot view or respond to Supplier 1's claim (403 Supplier Isolation).
 *
 * Every test states expected numbers and arithmetic in a comment.
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

import { app } from '../src/app.js';
import { config } from '../src/config.js';
import { seed } from '../src/services/seedData.js';
import { ensureIndexes } from '../src/models/index.js';
import { User } from '../src/models/users.js';
import { Shipment } from '../src/models/shipments.js';
import { CctvClip } from '../src/models/cctv-clips.js';
import { CctvEvent } from '../src/models/cctv-events.js';
import { EvidenceItem } from '../src/models/evidence-items.js';
import { SupplierClaim } from '../src/models/supplier-claims.js';
import { ExecutionLedger } from '../src/models/execution-ledger.js';

const MONGODB_URI =
  process.env.MONGODB_URI || 'mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/disruptioniq_test?replicaSet=rs0';

describe('Step 20 — CCTV Damage Detection & Adjudication Acceptance', () => {
  let operatorToken: string;
  let procurementToken: string;
  let sup1Token: string;
  let sup2Token: string;
  let adminToken: string;
  let initialShp204Eta: Date | null = null;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    if (mongoose.connection.readyState !== 1) {
      await mongoose.connect(MONGODB_URI);
    }
    await ensureIndexes();
    await seed(MONGODB_URI, false);

    // Create a second supplier user for SUP-2 to test supplier isolation
    await User.findOneAndUpdate(
      { username: 'sup2' },
      {
        $set: {
          username: 'sup2',
          password_hash: 'hash',
          role: 'SUPPLIER',
          warehouse_id: null,
          driver_id: null,
          truck_id: null,
          supplier_id: 'SUP-2',
          display_name: 'Supplier Rep 2 (Kanchi)',
        },
      },
      { upsert: true, new: true },
    );

    const operatorUser = await User.findOne({ username: 'operator' }).lean();
    const procurementUser = await User.findOne({ username: 'procurement' }).lean();
    const sup1User = await User.findOne({ username: 'sup1' }).lean();
    const sup2User = await User.findOne({ username: 'sup2' }).lean();
    const adminUser = await User.findOne({ username: 'admin' }).lean();

    expect(operatorUser).toBeDefined();
    expect(procurementUser).toBeDefined();
    expect(sup1User).toBeDefined();
    expect(sup2User).toBeDefined();

    function makeToken(user: any) {
      return jwt.sign(
        {
          sub: user._id.toString(),
          username: user.username,
          role: user.role,
          warehouse_id: user.warehouse_id ? user.warehouse_id.toString() : null,
          driver_id: user.driver_id || null,
          truck_id: user.truck_id || null,
          supplier_id: user.supplier_id || null,
        },
        config.JWT_SECRET,
        { expiresIn: '12h' },
      );
    }

    operatorToken = makeToken(operatorUser);
    procurementToken = makeToken(procurementUser);
    sup1Token = makeToken(sup1User);
    sup2Token = makeToken(sup2User);
    adminToken = makeToken(adminUser);

    const shp204 = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' }).lean();
    initialShp204Eta = shp204?.resolved_eta || null;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (initialShp204Eta) {
      await Shipment.updateOne(
        { code: 'SHP-204' },
        {
          $set: {
            resolved_eta: initialShp204Eta,
            review_status: 'NORMAL',
          },
        },
      );
    }
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Test (e): Evidence Verification and Tamper Detection
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('(e) evidence verify passes on untampered file and returns TAMPER_DETECTED on tampered one', async () => {
    /**
     * Arithmetic & Cryptographic Proof:
     * Raw payload string: "UNMODIFIED_EVIDENCE_FRAME_SNAPSHOT_BYTES_42"
     * Expected SHA-256 = sha256("UNMODIFIED_EVIDENCE_FRAME_SNAPSHOT_BYTES_42")
     * On verify: recompute hash over bytes. If hash == expected_sha256 -> status: 'VERIFIED', match: true.
     * On tamper: file bytes overwritten with "TAMPERED_DEMO_CORRUPT_PAYLOAD_..."
     * Resulting recomputed SHA-256 != original expected hash -> status: 'TAMPER_DETECTED', match: false.
     */
    const evidenceDir = path.resolve(config.CCTV_EVIDENCE_DIR);
    fs.mkdirSync(evidenceDir, { recursive: true });

    const evidenceId = `EVT-TEST-EVIDENCE-${Date.now()}`;
    const filePath = path.join(evidenceDir, `${evidenceId}.jpg`);
    const initialContent = Buffer.from('UNMODIFIED_EVIDENCE_FRAME_SNAPSHOT_BYTES_42');
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, initialContent);

    const initialSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(initialContent).digest('hex');

    await EvidenceItem.create({
      evidence_id: evidenceId,
      kind: 'FRAME_SNAPSHOT',
      path: filePath,
      sha256: initialSha,
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    // 1. Verify untampered file
    const verifyRes1 = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/v1/evidence/${evidenceId}/verify`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`);

    expect(verifyRes1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(verifyRes1.body.evidence_id).toBe(evidenceId);
    expect(verifyRes1.body.status).toBe('VERIFIED');
    expect(verifyRes1.body.match).toBe(true);
    expect(verifyRes1.body.expected_sha256).toBe(initialSha);
    expect(verifyRes1.body.actual_sha256).toBe(initialSha);

    // 2. Tamper with file via demo tamper endpoint
    const tamperRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/evidence/${evidenceId}/tamper`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`)
      .send({});

    expect(tamperRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(tamperRes.body.tampered).toBe(true);

    // 3. Verify tampered file -> must return TAMPER_DETECTED
    const verifyRes2 = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/v1/evidence/${evidenceId}/verify`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`);

    expect(verifyRes2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(verifyRes2.body.status).toBe('TAMPER_DETECTED');
    expect(verifyRes2.body.match).toBe(false);
    expect(verifyRes2.body.expected_sha256).toBe(initialSha);
    expect(verifyRes2.body.actual_sha256).not.toBe(initialSha);
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Test (f): SEVERE Event Processing through Damage-to-Delay Rules
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it(
    '(f) SEVERE event sends 48h delay to reconciler, creates OPEN claim, writes quarantine ledger row',
    async () => {
      /**
       * Arithmetic & State Transitions:
       * Shipment: SHP-204
       * Initial Resolved ETA = T_0
       * Lead time delay for SEVERE from damage_policies: lead_time_hours = 48 hours = 172,800,000 ms.
       * Expected New Resolved ETA = T_0 + 48 hours = T_0 + 172,800,000 ms.
       * Damaged units: 20 units.
       * Supplier claim: status == 'OPEN', units == 20, delay_hours == 48.
       * Ledger row: step_type == 'QUARANTINE', delta_on_hand == 0 (Never mutate on_hand directly).
       */
      const shipmentBefore = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' });
      expect(shipmentBefore).toBeDefined();

      const initialEta = new Date(shipmentBefore!.resolved_eta || shipmentBefore!.current_eta || shipmentBefore!.promised_eta).getTime();

      // Synthesize clip with a SEVERE CRUSH on track 1
      const synthRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/v1/cctv/clips/synthesize')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`)
        .send({
          warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
          camera_id: 'CAM-01',
          fps: 15,
          seconds: 4,
          parcel_count: 2,
          injected_events: [
            {
              track_id: 1,
              kind: 'CRUSH',
              severity: 'SEVERE',
              frame_start: 15,
              frame_end: 35,
            },
          ],
          seed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 80000) + 10000,
        });

      expect(synthRes.status).toBe(201);
      const clipId = synthRes.body.clip.clip_id;

      // Analyze clip with parcel mapping track 1 -> SHP-204
      const analyzeRes = await request(app)
        .post(`/api/v1/cctv/clips/${clipId}/analyze`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`)
        .send({
          parcel_to_shipment_map: {
            '1': 'SHP-204',
          },
        });

      expect(analyzeRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(analyzeRes.body.clip_id).toBe(clipId);

      // 1. Reconciler 48h delay check:
      const shipmentAfter = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' });
      expect(shipmentAfter).toBeDefined();
      const finalEta = new Date(shipmentAfter!.resolved_eta!).getTime();

      // Difference between final and initial ETA must be 48 hours (172,800,000 ms)
      const expectedDiffMs = 48 * 3600 * 1000;
      const actualDiffMs = finalEta - initialEta;
      expect(Math.abs(actualDiffMs - expectedDiffMs)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5000);

      // 2. Supplier Claim check:
      const severeEvent = analyzeRes.body.events.find((e: any) => e.band === 'SEVERE');
      expect(severeEvent).toBeDefined();

      const claim = await SupplierClaim.findOne({ cctv_event_id: severeEvent.event_id });
      expect(claim).toBeDefined();
      expect(claim!.status).toBe('OPEN');
      expect(claim!.delay_hours).toBe(48);
      expect(claim!.units).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);

      // 3. Ledger Quarantine row check:
      const ledgerRow = await ExecutionLedger.findOne({ step_type: 'QUARANTINE' }).sort({ seq: -1 });
      expect(ledgerRow).toBeDefined();
      expect(ledgerRow!.step_type).toBe('QUARANTINE');
      expect(ledgerRow!.delta_on_hand).toBe(0); // Zero mutation to live on_hand
      expect(ledgerRow!.after_state.quarantined_units).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);
    },
    30000,
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Test (g): Separation of Duties (Linking Operator cannot accept claim)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('(g) Operator who linked cannot accept the claim (403)', async () => {
    /**
     * Separation of Duties Rule:
     * An operator who confirms/links a CCTV damage event (e.g. operator 'operator')
     * cannot approve or accept the supplier financial claim resulting from that event.
     *
     * Attempt by linking user -> HTTP 403 Forbidden with SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES_VIOLATION.
     * Attempt by independent Procurement Approver -> HTTP 200 OK.
     */
    const eventId = `EVT-LINK-TEST-${Date.now()}`;
    const claimId = `CLM-${eventId}`;

    await CctvEvent.create({
      event_id: eventId,
      clip_id: `CLP-TEST-${Date.now()}`,
      track_id: 1,
      shipment_id: 'SHP-204',
      warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      camera_id: 'CAM-01',
      band: 'SEVERE',
      damage_score: 85,
      units_damaged: 20,
      frame_start: 10,
      frame_end: 25,
      status: 'DETECTED',
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    await SupplierClaim.create({
      claim_id: claimId,
      supplier_id: 'SUP-1',
      shipment_id: 'SHP-204',
      cctv_event_id: eventId,
      band: 'SEVERE',
      units: 20,
      delay_hours: 48,
      status: 'OPEN',
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    // 1. Warehouse Operator confirms and links the event
    const linkRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/cctv/events/${eventId}/link`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`)
      .send({ shipment_id: 'SHP-204' });

    expect(linkRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(linkRes.body.status).toBe('LINKED');
    expect(linkRes.body.linked_by).toBe('operator');

    // 2. Linking operator tries to accept the claim (operator lacks claim.decide -> 403)
    const operatorAttemptRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}/accept`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorToken}`)
      .send({});

    expect(operatorAttemptRes.status).toBe(403);

    // 3. User with claim.decide (procurement) who is recorded as the linking user attempts to accept:
    // Update claim and event to be linked by 'procurement'
    await CctvEvent.updateOne({ event_id: eventId }, { $set: { linked_by: 'procurement' } });
    await SupplierClaim.updateOne({ claim_id: claimId }, { $set: { linked_by: 'procurement' } });

    const conflictRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}/accept`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${procurementToken}`)
      .send({});

    expect(conflictRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(conflictRes.body.code).toBe('SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES_VIOLATION');

    // 4. Independent Admin or second procurement user (adminToken) accepts the claim
    const approverRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}/accept`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`)
      .send({});

    expect(approverRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(approverRes.body.status).toBe('ACCEPTED');
    expect(approverRes.body.decided_by).toBe('admin');
    expect(approverRes.body.version).toBe(2); // Version incremented 1 -> 2
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Test (h): Supplier Isolation (SUP-2 cannot view or respond to SUP-1's claim)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('(h) Supplier 2 cannot view or respond to Supplier 1\'s claim (403)', async () => {
    /**
     * Multi-Tenant Supplier Isolation Rule:
     * Supplier 1 has supplier_id: 'SUP-1'
     * Supplier 2 has supplier_id: 'SUP-2'
     *
     * A claim created for SUP-1:
     * - Supplier 2 GET /claims/:id -> HTTP 403 Forbidden
     * - Supplier 2 POST /claims/:id/respond -> HTTP 403 Forbidden
     * - Supplier 1 GET /claims/:id -> HTTP 200 OK
     * - Supplier 1 POST /claims/:id/respond -> HTTP 200 OK, status: 'RESPONDED', version += 1
     */
    const claimId = `CLM-SUP1-ISOLATION-${Date.now()}`;

    await SupplierClaim.create({
      claim_id: claimId,
      supplier_id: 'SUP-1',
      shipment_id: 'SHP-204',
      cctv_event_id: `EVT-SUP-${Date.now()}`,
      band: 'MAJOR',
      units: 15,
      delay_hours: 24,
      status: 'OPEN',
      supplier_response: null,
      decided_by: null,
      version: 1,
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    // 1. Supplier 2 attempts to view Supplier 1's claim -> 403 Forbidden
    const viewAttemptRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sup2Token}`);

    expect(viewAttemptRes.status).toBe(403);

    // 2. Supplier 2 attempts to respond to Supplier 1's claim -> 403 Forbidden
    const respondAttemptRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}/respond`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sup2Token}`)
      .send({ response: 'This was not our fault!' });

    expect(respondAttemptRes.status).toBe(403);

    // 3. Supplier 1 views its own claim -> 200 OK
    const sup1ViewRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sup1Token}`);

    expect(sup1ViewRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(sup1ViewRes.body.claim_id).toBe(claimId);
    expect(sup1ViewRes.body.supplier_id).toBe('SUP-1');

    // 4. Supplier 1 submits formal response to its own claim -> 200 OK
    const sup1RespondRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/claims/${claimId}/respond`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sup1Token}`)
      .send({ response: 'Box packaging verified under ISO-9001. Requesting joint survey.' });

    expect(sup1RespondRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(sup1RespondRes.body.status).toBe('RESPONDED');
    expect(sup1RespondRes.body.supplier_response).toBe('Box packaging verified under ISO-9001. Requesting joint survey.');
    expect(sup1RespondRes.body.version).toBe(2); // Version incremented 1 -> 2
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Hotspots Analytics endpoint test
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('aggregates damage counts and hotspots ranked descending', async () => {
    const hotspotsRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/cctv/hotspots')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);

    expect(hotspotsRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(Array.isArray(hotspotsRes.body)).toBe(true);
  });
});
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/test/step21-driver-tracking.test.ts
 *
 * Vitest Acceptance Suite for Step 21 — Live Driver Tracking, Graph Dijkstra,
 * Incident Proposals, Manager Approval & Geofencing.
 *
 * Test Requirements:
 * 1. Nearest warehouse equals hand-computed Dijkstra values:
 *    truck on lane BLR to CHN, 100 km from BLR -> WH-BLR 100km, WH-HOS 140km, WH-CHN 250km.
 *    Expected nearest: WH-BLR, 100 km.
 * 2. OFF_NETWORK gives STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE and no proposal.
 * 3. Ten pings sent shuffled and then resent: exactly ten stored in seq order, duplicates reported.
 * 4. Driver posting for another truck: 403. Driver socket never receives another truck's frame.
 * 5. Incident creates one PENDING proposal and does not change the destination.
 * 6. Reporter approving their own proposal: 403. Administrator: 403. Operator: 403.
 * 7. Manager approval: EXECUTED_SIMULATED, destination changed, one ledger entry, inventory_balances unchanged (deep-equal).
 * 8. Moved truck: proposal STALE, approval 409.
 * 9. Ten pings inside the radius: exactly one ARRIVED_GEOFENCE.
 * 10. Five parallel incidents with the same idempotency_key: exactly one proposal.
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import http from 'node:http';
import { AddressInfo } from 'node:net';
import WebSocket from 'ws';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

import { ensureIndexes } from '../src/models/index.js';

describe('Step 21 — Live Driver Tracking, Dijkstra Graph & Governed Reroutes', () => {
  let server: http.Server;

    drv1Token = jwt.sign(

  afterAll(async () => {

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  it('1. Nearest warehouse equals hand-computed values (truck on lane BLR to CHN, 100 km from BLR)', async () => {
    /**
     * Hand-computed proof:
     * Nodes: WH-BLR, WH-CHN, WH-HOS
     * Lanes:
     *   BLR <-> HOS = 40 km
     *   CHN <-> HOS = 300 km
     *   BLR <-> CHN = 350 km
     * Truck position: on lane BLR->CHN, 100 km from BLR.
     * Distance to BLR end = 100 km
     * Distance to CHN end = 350 - 100 = 250 km
     * Paths from truck to warehouses:
     *   WH-BLR: 100 km (direct to BLR node)
     *   WH-HOS: 100 km + 40 km (via BLR) = 140 km
     *   WH-CHN: 250 km (direct to CHN node)
     * Expected nearest: WH-BLR with road_km = 100.
     */
    const blr = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: 'WH-BLR' });
    const chn = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: 'WH-CHN' });

    expect(result.distances['WH-CHN']).toBe(250);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  it('2. OFF_NETWORK gives STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE and no route proposal', async () => {
    /**
     * Truck far off the highway network:
     * Lat: 12.0000, Lng: 79.0000 (Tiruvannamalai area, > 50km from any lane)
     * Result must use method: 'STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE'
     * path must be empty (no road route proposed)

    const result = await findNearestWarehouse({
      lat: 12.0,

      lane_id: null,

    expect(result.method).toBe('STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE');

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  it('3. Ten pings sent shuffled and then resent: exactly ten stored in seq order', async () => {
    // Clear any test pings for DRV-1
    await DriverPing.deleteMany({ driver_id: 'DRV-1' });

    // Generate 10 pings with seq 1..10 near WH-HOS
    const pings = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
      seq: i + 1,
      ts: new Date(Date.now() + i * 1000).toISOString(),
      lat: 12.7409 + i * 0.001,
      lng: 77.8253 + i * 0.001,
      speed_kmh: 55,
    }));

    // Shuffle pings
    const shuffled = [...pings].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

    // Send shuffled batch
    const postRes1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/driver/pings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({ pings: shuffled });

    expect(postRes1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(postRes1.body.accepted).toBe(10);
    expect(postRes1.body.duplicates).toBe(0);

    // Resend the exact same pings: must report duplicates and not error
    const postRes2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/driver/pings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({ pings });

    expect(postRes2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(postRes2.body.accepted).toBe(0);
    expect(postRes2.body.duplicates).toBe(10);

    // Query Mongo: exactly 10 stored, strictly ascending by seq
    const storedPings = await DriverPing.find({ driver_id: 'DRV-1' }).sort({ seq: 1 }).lean();
    expect(storedPings).toHaveLength(10);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      expect(storedPings[i].seq).toBe(i + 1);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. Driver Scoping & WebSocket Isolation
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('4. Driver posting for another truck returns 403; driver socket never receives another truck frame', async () => {
    // DRV-1 attempts to submit ping for truck SHP-310 (DRV-2's truck)
    const badPingRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/driver/pings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({
        truck_id: 'SHP-310',
        pings: [{ seq: 999, ts: new Date().toISOString(), lat: 13.0, lng: 80.0, speed_kmh: 40 }],
      });

    expect(badPingRes.status).toBe(403);

    // WebSocket Test: Connect DRV-1 socket, broadcast SHP-310 position, verify DRV-1 does not receive it
    const wsUrl = `ws://127.0.0.1:${wsPort}/ws`;
    const client = new WebSocket(wsUrl);

    const receivedMessages: any[] = [];
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      client.on('open', () => {
        client.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', token: drv1Token }));
      });

      client.on('message', (data) => {
        const msg = JSON.parse(data.toString());
        receivedMessages.push(msg);
        if (msg.type === 'auth_ok') {
          client.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'tracking' }));
        }
        if (msg.type === 'subscribed') {
          resolve();
        }
      });
      client.on('error', reject);
    });

    // Broadcast frame for SHP-310 (DRV-2's truck)
    await broadcastToTopic('tracking', {
      type: 'TRUCK_POSITION',
      driver_id: 'DRV-2',
      truck_id: 'SHP-310',
      lat: 13.0827,
      lng: 80.2707,
      speed_kmh: 45,
    });

    // Small delay to ensure no packet arrives
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));

    const leakedMessage = receivedMessages.find(
      (m) => m.type === 'event' && m.data?.truck_id === 'SHP-310',
    );
    expect(leakedMessage).toBeUndefined();

    client.close();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. Incident Reporting & Pending Proposal
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('5. Incident creates one PENDING proposal and does not change the destination', async () => {
    const shipmentBefore = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' }).lean();
    const initialDest = shipmentBefore!.warehouse_id.toString();

    // Ensure truck has at least one latest ping near Hosur
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/driver/pings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({
        pings: [{ seq: 100, ts: new Date().toISOString(), lat: 12.75, lng: 77.83, speed_kmh: 0 }],
      });

    const idempotencyKey = `INCIDENT-TEST-${Date.now()}`;
    const incidentRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/driver/incidents')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({
        kind: 'BREAKDOWN',
        idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
        ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

    expect(incidentRes.status).toBe(201);
    expect(incidentRes.body.incident).toBeDefined();
    expect(incidentRes.body.proposal).toBeDefined();
    expect(incidentRes.body.proposal.status).toBe('PENDING');

    // Verify destination was NOT modified
    const shipmentAfter = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' }).lean();
    expect(shipmentAfter!.warehouse_id.toString()).toBe(initialDest);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6. Separation of Duties on Reroute Approval
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('6. Reporter approving own proposal returns 403; Admin returns 403; Operator returns 403', async () => {
    // Create a fresh proposal for testing approvals
    const proposal = await RerouteProposal.create({
      proposal_id: `PROP-${Date.now()}`,
      truck_id: 'SHP-204',
      from_position: { seq: 100, lat: 12.75, lng: 77.83, lane_id: 'LANE-1', km_on_lane: 20 },
      nearest_warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      road_km: 15,
      method: 'ROAD_GRAPH',
      status: 'PENDING',
      proposed_by: 'drv1',
      reason: 'BREAKDOWN',
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    // 1. Reporter (drv1) attempts to approve
    const reporterRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/reroutes/${proposal.proposal_id}/approve`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`);
    expect(reporterRes.status).toBe(403);

    // 2. Administrator attempts to approve (only Supply Chain Manager can approve)
    const adminRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/reroutes/${proposal.proposal_id}/approve`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);
    expect(adminRes.status).toBe(403);

    // 3. Warehouse Operator attempts to approve
    const opRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/reroutes/${proposal.proposal_id}/approve`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorHosToken}`);
    expect(opRes.status).toBe(403);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 7. Manager Approval & Zero Inventory Change
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('7. Manager approval: EXECUTED_SIMULATED, destination changed, ledger entry, inventory_balances unchanged', async () => {
    const balancesBefore = await InventoryBalance.find({}).lean();

    // Create proposal to reroute SHP-204 to WH-BLR
    const blr = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: 'WH-BLR' });
    const proposal = await RerouteProposal.create({
      proposal_id: `PROP-APPR-${Date.now()}`,
      truck_id: 'SHP-204',
      from_position: { seq: 100, lat: 12.75, lng: 77.83, lane_id: 'LANE-1', km_on_lane: 20 },
      nearest_warehouse_id: 'WH-BLR',
      road_km: 35,
      method: 'ROAD_GRAPH',
      status: 'PENDING',
      proposed_by: 'system',
      reason: 'ACCIDENT',
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    const approveRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/reroutes/${proposal.proposal_id}/approve`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`);

    expect(approveRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(approveRes.body.proposal.status).toBe('EXECUTED_SIMULATED');

    // Verify shipment destination changed to WH-BLR
    const shipmentAfter = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' });
    expect(shipmentAfter!.warehouse_id.toString()).toBe(blr!._id.toString());

    // Verify execution_ledger entry
    const ledgerEntry = await ExecutionLedger.findOne({ step_type: 'REROUTE_SIMULATED' }).sort({ seq: -1 });
    expect(ledgerEntry).toBeDefined();
    expect(ledgerEntry!.before_state.destination).toBeDefined();
    expect(ledgerEntry!.after_state.destination).toBe(blr!._id.toString());

    // Verify inventory balances remain untouched (deep equal)
    const balancesAfter = await InventoryBalance.find({}).lean();
    expect(balancesAfter.map((b) => ({ id: b._id.toString(), on_hand: b.on_hand })))
      .toEqual(balancesBefore.map((b) => ({ id: b._id.toString(), on_hand: b.on_hand })));
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 8. Moved Truck Makes Proposal STALE (409)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('8. Moved truck: proposal becomes STALE, approval returns 409', async () => {
    // Create proposal at seq 100
    const proposal = await RerouteProposal.create({
      proposal_id: `PROP-MOVE-${Date.now()}`,
      truck_id: 'SHP-204',
      from_position: { seq: 100, lat: 12.75, lng: 77.83, lane_id: 'LANE-1', km_on_lane: 20 },
      nearest_warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      road_km: 15,
      method: 'ROAD_GRAPH',
      status: 'PENDING',
      proposed_by: 'system',
      reason: 'BREAKDOWN',
      created_at: new Date(),
    });

    // Driver moves! Post ping seq 105
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/driver/pings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
      .send({
        pings: [{ seq: 105, ts: new Date().toISOString(), lat: 12.80, lng: 77.85, speed_kmh: 50 }],
      });

    // Manager attempts to approve outdated proposal
    const approveRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/v1/reroutes/${proposal.proposal_id}/approve`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`);

    expect(approveRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(approveRes.body.status).toBe('STALE');

    // Confirm proposal in DB is marked STALE
    const updatedProp = await RerouteProposal.findOne({ proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id });
    expect(updatedProp!.status).toBe('STALE');
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 9. Geofence Arrival Event
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('9. Ten pings inside the geofence radius: exactly one ARRIVED_GEOFENCE event', async () => {
    const shipment = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' }).populate('warehouse_id');
    const wh = shipment!.warehouse_id as any;

    // Send 10 pings strictly inside WH-HOS coordinates (within 50 meters)
    const insidePings = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
      seq: 200 + i,
      ts: new Date(Date.now() + i * 1000).toISOString(),
      lat: wh.lat + 0.0001 * i, // ~11 meters per 0.0001 deg
      lng: wh.lng + 0.0001 * i,
      speed_kmh: 10,
    }));

    for (const p of insidePings) {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/v1/driver/pings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
        .send({ pings: [p] });
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    }

    // Exactly one ARRIVED_GEOFENCE event written for SHP-204
    const arrivedEvents = await ShipmentEvent.find({
      shipment_id: shipment!._id,
      event_type: 'ARRIVED_GEOFENCE',
    });

    expect(arrivedEvents).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(arrivedEvents[0].event_type).toBe('ARRIVED_GEOFENCE');
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 10. Idempotent Incidents
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('10. Five parallel incidents with the same idempotency_key create exactly one proposal', async () => {
    const idempotencyKey = `CONCURRENT-KEY-${Date.now()}`;

    const requests = Array.from({ length: 5 }, () =>
      request(app)
        .post('/api/v1/driver/incidents')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${drv1Token}`)
        .send({
          kind: 'ACCIDENT',
          idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
          ts: new Date().toISOString(),
        }),
    );

    const responses = await Promise.all(requests);

    // All return success (either 201 or 200/201 idempotent)
    for (const res of responses) {
      expect([200, 201]).toContain(res.status);
    }

    // Exactly one DriverIncident document
    const incidents = await DriverIncident.find({ idempotency_key: idempotencyKey });
    expect(incidents).toHaveLength(1);

    // Exactly one proposal created for this incident
    const proposals = await RerouteProposal.find({ reason: { $regex: idempotencyKey } });
    expect(proposals).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
````

## File: apps/api/test/step22-capacity-mapper.test.ts
````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/test/step22-capacity-mapper.test.ts
 *
 * Vitest Acceptance Suite for Step 22 — Warehouse Zone Capacity Mapper,
 * Deterministic Occupancy, Inbound Slot Reservations, Alert Governance & RBAC.
 *
 * Test Specifications:
 * 1. Colour boundaries with capacity 100 and occupied 70:
 *    - adding 9 slots gives GREEN at 79% (projected 79 of 100)
 *    - adding 10 gives AMBER at 80% (projected 80 of 100)
 *    - adding 30 gives AMBER at 100% (projected 100 of 100)
 *    - adding 31 gives RED at 101% (projected 101 of 100, over capacity by 1)
 * 2. Two SKUs with 5 units each and units_per_slot 10 use 2 slots, not 1.
 * 3. Assignment above on_hand returns 409; on_hand and reserved are unchanged after assignments.
 * 4. Five free slots with two parallel inbound plans of 5 each: exactly one 201 and one 409.
 * 5. Alert ZONE_OVER_CAPACITY opens once, a repeat recompute adds no duplicate, releasing the plan clears it.
 * 6. Operator cannot PATCH zones (403); Procurement cannot see capacity (403).
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { app } from '../src/app.js';
import { config } from '../src/config.js';
import { seed } from '../src/services/seedData.js';
import { ensureIndexes } from '../src/models/index.js';
import { User } from '../src/models/users.js';
import { Warehouse } from '../src/models/warehouses.js';
import { Sku } from '../src/models/skus.js';
import { Zone } from '../src/models/zones.js';
import { ZoneStockAssignment } from '../src/models/zone-stock-assignments.js';
import { InboundSlotPlan } from '../src/models/inbound-slot-plans.js';
import { InventoryBalance } from '../src/models/inventory-balances.js';
import { Alert } from '../src/models/alerts.js';
import { computeZoneOccupancy, getZoneColour } from '../src/services/capacityService.js';

const MONGODB_URI =
  process.env.MONGODB_URI || 'mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/disruptioniq_test?replicaSet=rs0';

describe('Step 22 — Capacity Mapper, Inbound Planning & Zone Governance Acceptance', () => {
  let managerToken: string;
  let adminToken: string;
  let operatorHosToken: string;
  let procurementToken: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    if (mongoose.connection.readyState !== 1) {
      await mongoose.connect(MONGODB_URI);
    }
    await ensureIndexes();
    await seed(MONGODB_URI, false);
    await ZoneStockAssignment.deleteMany({});
    await InboundSlotPlan.deleteMany({});

    const manager = await User.findOne({ username: 'manager' });
    const admin = await User.findOne({ username: 'admin' });
    const operator = await User.findOne({ username: 'operator' });
    const procurement = await User.findOne({ username: 'procurement' });

    managerToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: manager!._id, username: manager!.username, role: manager!.role },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '1h' },
    );
    adminToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: admin!._id, username: admin!.username, role: admin!.role },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '1h' },
    );
    operatorHosToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: operator!._id, username: operator!.username, role: operator!.role, warehouse_id: operator!.warehouse_id },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '1h' },
    );
    procurementToken = jwt.sign(
      { sub: procurement!._id, username: procurement!.username, role: procurement!.role },
      config.JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '1h' },
    );
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. Colour Boundaries Test
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('1. Colour boundaries with capacity 100 and occupied 70: +9 GREEN (79), +10 AMBER (80), +30 AMBER (100), +31 RED (101)', () => {
    const capacity = 100;
    const occupied = 70;

    // +9 slots: 79/100 = 79% -> GREEN
    const res79 = getZoneColour(capacity, occupied, 9);
    expect(res79.colour).toBe('GREEN');
    expect(res79.projected_slots).toBe(79);
    expect(res79.utilization_pct).toBe(79);
    expect(res79.explanation).toContain('Projected 79 of 100 slots');

    // +10 slots: 80/100 = 80% -> AMBER
    const res80 = getZoneColour(capacity, occupied, 10);
    expect(res80.colour).toBe('AMBER');
    expect(res80.projected_slots).toBe(80);
    expect(res80.utilization_pct).toBe(80);

    // +30 slots: 100/100 = 100% -> AMBER
    const res100 = getZoneColour(capacity, occupied, 30);
    expect(res100.colour).toBe('AMBER');
    expect(res100.projected_slots).toBe(100);
    expect(res100.utilization_pct).toBe(100);

    // +31 slots: 101/100 = 101% -> RED (over capacity by 1)
    const res101 = getZoneColour(capacity, occupied, 31);
    expect(res101.colour).toBe('RED');
    expect(res101.projected_slots).toBe(101);
    expect(res101.utilization_pct).toBe(101);
    expect(res101.explanation).toBe('Projected 101 of 100 slots, over capacity by 1.');
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. Ceil Calculation for Discrete Slots
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('2. Two SKUs with 5 units each and units_per_slot 10 use 2 slots, not 1', async () => {
    // Math: ceil(5 / 10) + ceil(5 / 10) = 1 + 1 = 2 slots
    const sku1 = await Sku.findOne({ code: 'SKU-101' });
    const sku2 = await Sku.findOne({ code: 'SKU-205' });
    expect(sku1!.units_per_slot).toBe(10);
    expect(sku2!.units_per_slot).toBe(10);

    const testZoneId = `ZN-CEIL-${Date.now()}`;
    await Zone.create({
      zone_id: testZoneId,
      warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      name: `Ceil Test Zone ${Date.now()}`,
      zone_type: 'STORAGE',
      polygon: [[0, 0], [100, 0], [100, 100], [0, 100]],
      capacity_slots: 50,
      reserved_inbound_slots: 0,
    });

    await ZoneStockAssignment.create([
      { warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS', sku_id: sku1!.code, zone_id: testZoneId, units: 5 },
      { warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS', sku_id: sku2!.code, zone_id: testZoneId, units: 5 },
    ]);

    const occupancy = await computeZoneOccupancy(testZoneId);
    expect(occupancy.occupied_slots).toBe(2);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. Assignment Exceeding On-Hand Returns 409 & Zero Direct Mutation
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('3. Assignment above on_hand returns 409; on_hand and reserved are unchanged after assignments', async () => {
    const hos = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: 'WH-HOS' });
    const sku = await Sku.findOne({ code: 'SKU-101' });
    const balanceBefore = await InventoryBalance.findOne({
      warehouse_id: hos!._id,
      sku_id: sku!._id,
    });
    expect(balanceBefore).toBeDefined();

    const onHand = balanceBefore!.on_hand;
    const reserved = balanceBefore!.reserved;

    // Attempt assignment of onHand + 50 units (exceeds on_hand)
    const assignRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/zones/ZN-HOS-STR/assignments')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        sku_id: sku!.code,
        units: onHand + 50,
      });

    expect(assignRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(assignRes.body.error).toBe('Conflict');

    // Valid assignment within on_hand
    const validAssignRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/zones/ZN-HOS-STR/assignments')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        sku_id: sku!.code,
        units: Math.floor(onHand / 2),
      });

    expect(validAssignRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Verify on_hand and reserved on InventoryBalance are UNCHANGED
    const balanceAfter = await InventoryBalance.findOne({
      warehouse_id: hos!._id,
      sku_id: sku!._id,
    });

    expect(balanceAfter!.on_hand).toBe(onHand);
    expect(balanceAfter!.reserved).toBe(reserved);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. Parallel Inbound Plan Atomicity (1 Accepted, 1 Rejected)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('4. Five free slots with two parallel inbound plans of 5 each: exactly one 201 and one 409', async () => {
    const testZoneId = `ZN-RACE-${Date.now()}`;
    await Zone.create({
      zone_id: testZoneId,
      warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      name: `Race Zone ${Date.now()}`,
      zone_type: 'RECEIVING',
      polygon: [[10, 10], [50, 10], [50, 50], [10, 50]],
      capacity_slots: 10,
      reserved_inbound_slots: 5, // 5 slots remaining free (10 - 5 = 5)
    });

    // Fire two parallel inbound plan requests for 5 slots each
    const req1 = request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/capacity/inbound-plans')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        shipment_id: `SHP-TEST-RACE-A-${Date.now()}`,
        zone_id: testZoneId,
        slots: 5,
      });

    const req2 = request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/capacity/inbound-plans')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        shipment_id: `SHP-TEST-RACE-B-${Date.now()}`,
        zone_id: testZoneId,
        slots: 5,
      });

    const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([req1, req2]);
    const statuses = [res1.status, res2.status].sort();

    // Exactly one 201 Created and one 409 Conflict
    expect(statuses).toEqual([201, 409]);

    const updatedZone = await Zone.findOne({ zone_id: testZoneId });
    expect(updatedZone!.reserved_inbound_slots).toBe(10);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. Alert Lifecycle: Opens Once, No Duplicate, Releasing Plan Clears Alert
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  it('5. Alert ZONE_OVER_CAPACITY opens once, repeat recompute adds no duplicate, releasing plan clears it', async () => {
    const testZoneId = `ZN-ALERT-${Date.now()}`;
    await Zone.create({
      zone_id: testZoneId,
      warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      name: `Alert Lifecycle Zone ${Date.now()}`,
      zone_type: 'STORAGE',
      polygon: [[0, 0], [200, 0], [200, 200], [0, 200]],
      capacity_slots: 10,
      reserved_inbound_slots: 0,
    });

    // 70 units of SKU-101 (units_per_slot=10) = 7 occupied slots
    const sku = await Sku.findOne({ code: 'SKU-101' });
    await ZoneStockAssignment.create({
      warehouse_id: 'WH-HOS',
      sku_id: sku!.code,
      zone_id: testZoneId,
      units: 70,
    });

    const shipmentId = `SHP-ALERT-${Date.now()}`;

    // Over capacity: 7 occupied + 5 inbound = 12 > 10 slots (RED) with plan_over_capacity=true by Manager
    const planRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/v1/capacity/inbound-plans')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        shipment_id: shipmentId,
        zone_id: testZoneId,
        slots: 5,
        plan_over_capacity: true,
      });

    expect(planRes.status).toBe(201);
    const planId = planRes.body.plan._id;

    // Verify exactly one active alert created for this zone
    const alerts1 = await Alert.find({
      type: 'ZONE_OVER_CAPACITY',
      entity_id: testZoneId,
      status: 'OPEN',
    });
    expect(alerts1).toHaveLength(1);

    // Repeat recompute: ensure no duplicate alert is opened
    await request(app)
      .get(`/api/v1/zones/${testZoneId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`);

    const alerts2 = await Alert.find({
      type: 'ZONE_OVER_CAPACITY',
      entity_id: testZoneId,
      status: 'OPEN',
    });
    expect(alerts2).toHaveLength(1);

    // Release plan (DELETE /capacity/inbound-plans/:id)
    const releaseRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/v1/capacity/inbound-plans/${planId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`);

    expect(releaseRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Alert must now be resolved / cleared
    const alerts3 = await Alert.find({
      type: 'ZONE_OVER_CAPACITY',
      entity_id: testZoneId,
      status: 'OPEN',
    });
    expect(alerts3).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
````

````typescript
    expect(report.counts.total).toBe(13);
    expect(report.counts.valid).toBe(3);

    // Verify error reasons exist

    expect(errors.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);

    // Test row repair
    const badWarehouseRow = qRes.body.rows.find((r: any) =>
      r.errors.some((e: any) => e.code === 'UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE')
    );
    expect(badWarehouseRow).toBeDefined();

    // Repair the warehouse code

    const repairRes = await request(app)

      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)

    expect(repairRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(repairRes.body.status).toBe('REPAIRED');

    // Confirm raw_data is untouched
    const fetchedRow = await ImportRow.findById(badWarehouseRow.id);
    expect(fetchedRow?.raw_data).toEqual(badWarehouseRow.raw_data);
    expect(fetchedRow?.repaired_data).toEqual(repairedData);

    // Commit batch
    let busEventFired = false;
    const unsub = domainBus.subscribe('IMPORT_COMMITTED', (payload) => {
      if (payload.batchId === batchId) busEventFired = true;
    });

    const commitRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/imports/${batchId}/commit`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);

    unsub();

    expect(commitRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(commitRes.body.status).toBe('COMMITTED');
    // 3 valid + 1 repaired = 4 loaded rows
    expect(commitRes.body.loaded_count).toBe(4);
    expect(busEventFired).toBe(true);

    // Calling commit again is idempotent
    const repeatCommit = await request(app)
      .post(`/imports/${batchId}/commit`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);
    expect(repeatCommit.body.status).toBe('ALREADY_COMMITTED');

    // Test Re-uploading the identical file returns FILE_ALREADY_IMPORTED (no-op)
    const reuploadRes = await request(app)
      .post('/imports')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .field('entity_type', 'shipments')
      .attach('file', filePath);

    expect(reuploadRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(reuploadRes.body.status).toBe('FILE_ALREADY_IMPORTED');
  });

  it('acceptance test 34: duplicate and conflict natural key handling and quality report adds up', async () => {
    // 1. Duplicate natural key file
    const dupPath = path.join(FIXTURES_DIR, 'duplicate-key.csv');
    const dupRes = await request(app)
      .post('/imports')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`)
      .field('entity_type', 'shipments')
      .attach('file', dupPath);

    expect(dupRes.status).toBe(201);
    const dupReport = dupRes.body.report;
    expect(dupReport.counts.total).toBe(2);
    expect(dupReport.counts.valid).toBe(1);
    expect(dupReport.counts.duplicate).toBe(1);

    // 2. Conflict natural key file
    const confPath = path.join(FIXTURES_DIR, 'conflict-key.csv');
    const confRes = await request(app)
      .post('/imports')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`)
      .field('entity_type', 'shipments')
      .attach('file', confPath);

    expect(confRes.status).toBe(201);
    const confReport = confRes.body.report;
    expect(confReport.counts.total).toBe(2);
    expect(confReport.counts.valid).toBe(0);
    expect(confReport.counts.conflict).toBe(2);

    // 3. Quality report adds up to total rows
    const repRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/imports/${confRes.body.batch_id}/report`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);

    expect(repRes.status).toBe(200);
    const c = repRes.body.counts;
    const sum = c.valid + c.repaired + c.quarantined + c.duplicate + c.conflict + c.discarded;
    expect(sum).toBe(c.total);
    expect(Array.isArray(repRes.body.error_reasons)).toBe(true);
  });
});
````

````typescript
  'EVT-STEP5B-CONFLICT',
  'EVT-STEP5B-PARALLEL',
];

function makeHmacSignature(body: string): string {
  return crypto.createHmac('sha256', config.WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(body).digest('hex');
}

async function cleanupTestEvents(): Promise<void> {
  await ShipmentEvent.deleteMany({ external_event_id: { $in: TEST_EXT_IDS } });
  // Reset the test shipment's reconciler fields

    { code: TEST_SHIPMENT_CODE },

  );

    const baseEvent: IncomingEvent = {
      source: 'CARRIER_API',

      raw_payload: { source: 'test' },

    };

    const results: any[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

      results.push(r);

    const applied = results.filter((s) => s.status === 'APPLIED').length;
    const duplicates = results.filter((s) => s.status === 'DUPLICATE').length;

    expect(applied).toBe(1);

      event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',

      raw_payload: { source: 'test' },
      correlation_id: 'test-stale',
    };
    const staleResult = await withTransaction((session) => reconcile(staleEvent, session));
    expect(staleResult.status).toBe('STALE');

    // ETA must not change
    const shipmentAfterStale = await Shipment.findOne({ code: TEST_SHIPMENT_CODE }).lean();
    expect(shipmentAfterStale?.resolved_eta?.toISOString()).toBe(resolvedEtaAfterNewer?.toISOString());

  // --- Test 3: Conflict ---

      external_event_id: 'EVT-STEP5B-2001',

    expect(conflictResult.status).toBe('CONFLICT');

    expect(shipment?.review_status).toBe('UNDER_REVIEW');

  it('parallel webhooks: 5 identical in parallel → exactly 1 APPLIED', async () => {
    const parallelEvent: IncomingEvent = {

      ),

    const fulfilled = results

      .map((r) => (r as PromiseFulfilledResult<any>).value.status);

    expect(applied).toBe(1);

  }, 15000);

  it('conflict resolution: POST /events/conflicts/:id/resolve applies chosen ETA and sets review_status=NORMAL', async () => {
    // Setup: Apply a carrier event, then create a conflict

    const conflictEvent: IncomingEvent = {

      external_event_id: 'EVT-STEP5B-CONFLICT',
      event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
      shipment_code: TEST_SHIPMENT_CODE,
      reported_eta: new Date('2026-11-03T15:00:00Z'),

    expect(conflictResult.status).toBe('CONFLICT');
````

````typescript
describe('Step 6 Part A: Field Report Ingestion (Voice & Text)', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    await mongoose.connect(MONGODB_URI, { serverSelectionTimeoutMS: 8000 });
    await ensureIndexes();
    await seed(MONGODB_URI, false);

    const aLogin = await request(app)
      .post('/auth/login')
      .send({ username: 'analyst', password: DEMO_PASSWORD });
    analystToken = aLogin.body.token;

    const mLogin = await request(app)
      .post('/auth/login')
      .send({ username: 'manager', password: DEMO_PASSWORD });
    managerToken = mLogin.body.token;

    const opLogin = await request(app)
      .post('/auth/login')
      .send({ username: 'operator', password: DEMO_PASSWORD });
    operatorHosurToken = opLogin.body.token;
  });

  // 1. 20+ Extractor variants
  it('rule-based extractor handles 20+ English and Tanglish variants', () => {
    const variants: Array<{
      input: string;
      expected: {
        shipment: string | null;
        warehouse: string | null;
        damaged?: number | null;
        delay?: number | null;
      };
    }> = [
      { input: 'SHP-204 Hosur warehouse-la 70 box damage, lorry rendu mani neram late', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-204', warehouse: 'WH-HOS', damaged: 70, delay: 2 } },
      { input: 'SHP-101 Chennai warehouse 20 boxes damaged oru mani neram late', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-101', warehouse: 'WH-CHN', damaged: 20, delay: 1 } },
      { input: 'SHP-302 Bangalore facility 15 units damaged moonu mani neram delay', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-302', warehouse: 'WH-BLR', damaged: 15, delay: 3 } },
      { input: 'SHP-205 Hosur-la naalu mani neram delay aachu', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-205', warehouse: 'WH-HOS', delay: 4 } },
      { input: 'SHP-102 Chennai facility anju mani neram late', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-102', warehouse: 'WH-CHN', delay: 5 } },
      { input: 'SHP-305 BLR warehouse aaru mani neram late, 10 box damage', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-305', warehouse: 'WH-BLR', damaged: 10, delay: 6 } },
      { input: 'SHP-206 Hosur ezhu mani neram delay', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-206', warehouse: 'WH-HOS', delay: 7 } },
      { input: 'SHP-105 Chennai ettu mani neram late', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-105', warehouse: 'WH-CHN', delay: 8 } },
      { input: 'SHP-301 Bangalore onbadhu mani neram delay', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-301', warehouse: 'WH-BLR', delay: 9 } },
      { input: 'SHP-208 Hosur pathu box damage', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-208', warehouse: 'WH-HOS', damaged: 10 } },
      { input: 'SHP-204 70 box damage', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-204', warehouse: null, damaged: 70 } },
      { input: 'SHP-310 2 hours delay', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-310', warehouse: null, delay: 2 } },
      { input: 'SHP-204 Hosur 5 hours late', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-204', warehouse: 'WH-HOS', delay: 5 } },
      { input: 'SHP-101 Chennai 100 units damaged', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-101', warehouse: 'WH-CHN', damaged: 100 } },

      { input: 'SHP-204 rendu box damage', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-204', warehouse: null, damaged: 2 } },
      { input: 'SHP-204 moonu box damage', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-204', warehouse: null, damaged: 3 } },
      { input: 'SHP-204 naalu box damage', expected: { shipment: 'SHP-204', warehouse: null, damaged: 4 } },

    ];

    for (const v of variants) {
      const card = extractEventCardRules(v.input);
      if (v.expected.shipment !== undefined) {
        expect(card.shipment_code).toBe(v.expected.shipment);

  // 2. Acceptance test 11: Voice path completes offline using sample transcript
  it('acceptance test 11: voice path completes offline using sample transcript', async () => {
    // 1. Fetch sample transcript
    const sampleRes = await request(app).get('/fixtures/sample-transcripts');
    expect(sampleRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(sampleRes.body.voice_sample.raw_transcript).toBe(SAMPLE_VOICE_TRANSCRIPT.raw_transcript);

    // 2. Submit to /voice/parse
    const parseRes = await request(app)
      .post('/voice/parse')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({ transcript: sampleRes.body.voice_sample.raw_transcript, channel: 'VOICE' });

    expect(parseRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(parseRes.body.card.shipment_code).toBe('SHP-204');
    expect(parseRes.body.card.warehouse_code).toBe('WH-HOS');
    expect(parseRes.body.card.damaged_units).toBe(70);
    expect(parseRes.body.card.delay_hours).toBe(2);
    expect(parseRes.body.tamil_labels).toBeDefined();

    // Verify raw text stored untouched in field_reports with status DRAFT
    const report = await FieldReport.findById(parseRes.body.report_id).lean();
    expect(report?.status).toBe('DRAFT');
    expect(report?.raw_text).toBe(sampleRes.body.voice_sample.raw_transcript);

    // 3. Confirm card moves resolved ETA and updates usable quantity to 100
    const confirmRes = await request(app)
      .post('/events')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({
        field_report_id: parseRes.body.report_id,
        shipment_code: 'SHP-204',

      });

    expect(confirmRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Verify shipment was updated
    const shipment = await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' }).lean();
    expect(shipment?.usable_quantity).toBe(100); // 170 total - 70 damaged = 100 usable
    expect(shipment?.is_disrupted).toBe(true);

    // Field report status moved to CONFIRMED
    const updatedReport = await FieldReport.findById(parseRes.body.report_id).lean();
    expect(updatedReport?.status).toBe('CONFIRMED');
    expect(updatedReport?.event_id).toBeDefined();
  });

  // 3. Acceptance test 38: Three sample messages
  it('acceptance test 38: sample messages give CONFLICT, DUPLICATE, and REJECTED', async () => {
    // Message 1: Supplier email conflicting with carrier on SHP-310
    const emailRes = await request(app)
      .post('/ingest/text')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({ text: SAMPLE_MESSAGES[0].body, channel: 'EMAIL_TEXT' });
    expect(emailRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Confirm message 1 with ETA differing by 9h from carrier
    // CARRIER_API for SHP-310 is 16:00 (2026-11-01T16:00:00Z)
    // Supplier portal says 01:00 next day (2026-11-02T01:00:00Z) -> 9h diff
    const conf1 = await request(app)
      .post('/events')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({
        field_report_id: emailRes.body.report_id,
        shipment_code: 'SHP-310',
        event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
        reported_eta: '2026-11-02T01:00:00Z',
      });
    // Either APPLIED or CONFLICT depending on prior events
    expect(['APPLIED', 'CONFLICT']).toContain(conf1.body.status);

    // Message 2: Exact duplicate
    const dupRes = await request(app)
      .post('/ingest/text')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({ text: SAMPLE_MESSAGES[1].body, channel: 'EMAIL_TEXT' });
    expect(dupRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Confirm duplicate with same payload
    const conf2 = await request(app)
      .post('/events')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({
        field_report_id: emailRes.body.report_id, // reuse same external key
        shipment_code: 'SHP-310',
        event_type: 'ETA_UPDATE',
        reported_eta: '2026-11-02T01:00:00Z',
      });
    expect(conf2.body.status).toBe('DUPLICATE');

    // Message 3: Unknown shipment SHP-999
    const unkRes = await request(app)
      .post('/ingest/text')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({ text: SAMPLE_MESSAGES[2].body, channel: 'SMS_TEXT' });
    expect(unkRes.status).toBe(200);

    const conf3 = await request(app)
      .post('/events')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`)
      .send({
        field_report_id: unkRes.body.report_id,
        shipment_code: 'SHP-999',
        event_type: 'DELAY_REPORT',
        delay_hours: 6,
      });
    expect(conf3.body.status).toBe('REJECTED');
  });

  // 4. Operator scoping
  it('Operator for another warehouse returns 403', async () => {
    // operator_hosur attempts to confirm for Chennai warehouse shipment SHP-310
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/events')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${operatorHosurToken}`)
      .send({
        shipment_code: 'SHP-310', // WH-CHN shipment
        event_type: 'DELAY_REPORT',
        delay_hours: 2,

});

describe('Step 6 Part B: Impact Engine and Risk Bands', () => {
  // Acceptance test 5: Impact lists exactly ORD-1042, ORD-1047, ORD-1051 for Scenario A
  it('acceptance test 5: impact lists exactly ORD-1042, ORD-1047, and ORD-1051 for Scenario A', async () => {
    const impactResult = await processShipmentImpact('SHP-204', 'test-impact-scenario-a');
    expect(impactResult).not.toBeNull();

    const orderCodes = impactResult!.affected_orders.map((o) => o.order_code).sort();
    expect(orderCodes).toEqual(['ORD-1042', 'ORD-1047', 'ORD-1051'].sort());

    // Verify disruption exists and is queryable
    const disruptionRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/disruptions/${impactResult!.disruption._id}/impact`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);

    expect(disruptionRes.status).toBe(200);
    const apiOrderCodes = disruptionRes.body.affected_orders.map((x: any) => x.order.code).sort();
    expect(apiOrderCodes).toEqual(['ORD-1042', 'ORD-1047', 'ORD-1051'].sort());
  });

  // Hand-calculated risk scores
  it('hand-calculated risk scores match exact blueprint values', async () => {
    const impactResult = await processShipmentImpact('SHP-204', 'test-hand-calc');
    expect(impactResult).not.toBeNull();

    const ord1042 = impactResult!.affected_orders.find((o) => o.order_code === 'ORD-1042')!;
    const ord1047 = impactResult!.affected_orders.find((o) => o.order_code === 'ORD-1047')!;
    const ord1051 = impactResult!.affected_orders.find((o) => o.order_code === 'ORD-1051')!;

    /**
     * Hand calculations:
     * Formula: Risk = 100 * (0.35 * U + 0.30 * S + 0.20 * D + 0.15 * P)
     *
     * Ready time = 12:00 ETA + 2h processing = 14:00 (Nov 2)
     *
     * ORD-1042:
     *   due_at: 14:00 -> slack = 0 -> U = 1.0
     *   shortage: allocated 80/80 -> S = 0.0
     *   delay: 2 / (0 + 24) = 0.08333...
     *   priority: CRITICAL (5) -> (5-1)/4 = 1.0
     *   Risk = 100 * (0.35*1.0 + 0.30*0.0 + 0.20*0.08333 + 0.15*1.0)
     *        = 100 * (0.35 + 0.016667 + 0.15) = 51.67
     *
     * ORD-1047:
     *   due_at: 18:00 -> slack = 4 -> U = 1 - 4/72 = 68/72 = 0.9444...
     *   shortage: allocated 40 of 60 -> short 20/60 -> S = 0.3333...
     *   delay: 2 / (4 + 24) = 2/28 = 0.071428...
     *   priority: HIGH (4) -> (4-1)/4 = 0.75
     *   Risk = 100 * (0.35*0.9444 + 0.30*0.3333 + 0.20*0.0714 + 0.15*0.75)
     *        = 100 * (0.330556 + 0.100000 + 0.014286 + 0.112500) = 55.73
     *
     * ORD-1051:
     *   due_at: IN_48H (Nov 3 00:30) -> slack = 10.5 -> U = 1 - 10.5/72 = 0.854167
     *   shortage: allocated 0 of 50 -> short 50/50 -> S = 1.0
     *   delay: 2 / (10.5 + 24) = 2/34.5 = 0.057971
     *   priority: MEDIUM (3) -> (3-1)/4 = 0.50
     *   Risk = 100 * (0.35*0.854167 + 0.30*1.0 + 0.20*0.057971 + 0.15*0.50)
     *        = 100 * (0.298958 + 0.300000 + 0.011594 + 0.075000) = 68.56
     */
    expect(ord1042.risk_score).toBeCloseTo(51.67, 1);
    expect(ord1047.risk_score).toBeCloseTo(55.73, 1);
    expect(ord1051.risk_score).toBeCloseTo(68.56, 1);

    // Score range brackets the point score
    for (const ord of [ord1042, ord1047, ord1051]) {
      expect(ord.best_case_score).toBeLessThanOrEqual(ord.risk_score);
      expect(ord.worst_case_score).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(ord.risk_score);
    }
  });

  // Acceptance test 28: Risk bands and dynamic threshold re-banding
  it('acceptance test 28: risk bands match thresholds and re-band dynamically', async () => {
    const disruption = await Disruption.findOne({ shipment_id: (await Shipment.findOne({ code: 'SHP-204' }))?._id });
    expect(disruption).toBeDefined();

    // Default thresholds: RED >= 70, AMBER 40-69, GREEN < 40
    const risksRes1 = await request(app)
      .get(`/disruptions/${disruption!._id}/risks`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);

    expect(risksRes1.status).toBe(200);
    // All three scores (51.67, 55.73, 68.56) should be AMBER
    for (const r of risksRes1.body.risks) {
      expect(r.band).toBe('AMBER');
      expect(r.score_range).toBeDefined();
      expect(r.waterfall).toBeDefined();
    }

    // Now Manager lowers RED threshold to 50
    const putPolicyRes = await request(app)
      .put('/risk/policy')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        policies: [
          { band: 'RED', min_score: 50, max_score: 100 },
          { band: 'AMBER', min_score: 30, max_score: 49 },
          { band: 'GREEN', min_score: 0, max_score: 29 },
        ],
      });
    expect(putPolicyRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Immediately re-fetch risks: all three (51.67, 55.73, 68.56) should now be RED!
    const risksRes2 = await request(app)
      .get(`/disruptions/${disruption!._id}/risks`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);

    for (const r of risksRes2.body.risks) {
      expect(r.band).toBe('RED');
    }

    // Restore policies
    await request(app)
      .put('/risk/policy')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${managerToken}`)
      .send({
        policies: [
          { band: 'RED', min_score: 70, max_score: 100 },
          { band: 'AMBER', min_score: 40, max_score: 69 },
          { band: 'GREEN', min_score: 0, max_score: 39 },
        ],
      });
  });

  // Evidence endpoint resolves real documents
  it('evidence endpoint GET /evidence/:type/:id resolves source documents', async () => {
    const snapshot = await OrderRiskSnapshot.findOne({}).lean();
    expect(snapshot).toBeDefined();
    expect(snapshot?.evidence_ids.order_id).toBeDefined();

    const evRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/evidence/order/${snapshot!.evidence_ids.order_id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);

    expect(evRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(evRes.body.type).toBe('order');
    expect(evRes.body.document).toBeDefined();
    expect(evRes.body.document._id).toBe(snapshot!.evidence_ids.order_id);
  });

  // Heatgrid endpoint
  it('heatgrid endpoint returns factor grid', async () => {
    const disruption = await Disruption.findOne({});
    const hgRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/disruptions/${disruption!._id}/heatgrid`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${analystToken}`);

    expect(hgRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(Array.isArray(hgRes.body.heatgrid)).toBe(true);
    expect(hgRes.body.heatgrid.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(hgRes.body.heatgrid[0].urgency).toBeDefined();
    expect(hgRes.body.heatgrid[0].shortage).toBeDefined();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await mongoose.disconnect();
  });
});
````
