## File: apps/web/src/screens/TrackingScreen.tsx
````typescript
/**
 * apps/web/src/screens/TrackingScreen.tsx
 *
 * Screen 9: Leaflet Live Map & Vehicle Telemetry Radar.
 * Features:
 * - Real-time WebSocket connection to /ws on topic 'tracking'.
 * - Exponential backoff reconnection (1s -> 2s -> 4s -> ... -> 30s).
 * - "Live feed paused" indicator when disconnected; never shows stale data as live.
 * - MAP_TILE_URL fallback: plain SVG/CSS grid when unset (no tile requests, zero 404s).
 * - Trucks from WebSocket + initial API /tracking/trucks fetch.
 * - Warehouses, suppliers, and transfer lane polylines.
 * - STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE dashed markers with "Estimate, off road network".
 * - Click truck to open telemetry drawer: position, speed, last ping time, destination, active incident, proposal status.
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { MapContainer, Polyline, Marker, Popup, TileLayer } from 'react-leaflet';
import L from 'leaflet';
import {
  Navigation,
  Truck,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  X,
  Radio,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getStoredToken } from '../api/client.js';

const MAP_TILE_URL =
  (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_MAP_TILE_URL ||
  'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png';

export interface TruckTelemetry {
  truck_id: string;
  driver_id: string;
  driver_name?: string;
  position: {
    lat: number;
    lng: number;
    speed_kmh: number;
    lane_id: string | null;
    km_on_lane: number | null;
    method: 'ROAD_GRAPH' | 'STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE';
    ts: string;
    seq: number;
  } | null;
  destination_warehouse?: {
    id: string;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    lat: number;
    lng: number;
  } | null;
  active_incident?: {
    incident_id: string;
    kind: string;
    ts: string;
  } | null;
  pending_proposal?: {
    proposal_id: string;
    nearest_warehouse_id: string;
    road_km: number;
    status: string;
  } | null;
}

// Custom DivIcons for Leaflet
const createTruckIcon = (isEstimate: boolean) => {
  return L.divIcon({
    className: 'custom-truck-marker',
    html: `
      <div class="relative flex items-center justify-center">
        <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg transition-transform hover:scale-110 ${
          isEstimate
            ? 'bg-amber-100 border-2 border-dashed border-amber-600 text-amber-700 animate-pulse'
            : 'bg-indigo-600 border-2 border-white text-white'
        }">
          <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path d="M20 8h-3V4H3c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v11h2c0 1.66 1.34 3 3 3s3-1.34 3-3h6c0 1.66 1.34 3 3 3s3-1.34 3-3h2v-5l-3-4zM6 18.5c-.83 0-1.5-.67-1.5-1.5s.67-1.5 1.5-1.5 1.5.67 1.5 1.5-.67 1.5-1.5 1.5zm13.5-9l1.96 2.5H17V9.5h2.5zm-1.5 9c-.83 0-1.5-.67-1.5-1.5s.67-1.5 1.5-1.5 1.5.67 1.5 1.5-.67 1.5-1.5 1.5z"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        ${
          isEstimate
            ? '<span class="absolute -bottom-5 whitespace-nowrap bg-amber-600 text-[10px] text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded shadow">Estimate, off road network</span>'
            : ''
        }
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [32, 32],
    iconAnchor: [16, 16],
  });
};

const createNodeIcon = (label: string, isWh: boolean) => {
  return L.divIcon({
    className: 'custom-node-marker',
    html: `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded shadow-md border text-xs font-semibold ${
        isWh
          ? 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-700 text-white'
          : 'bg-blue-600 border-blue-700 text-white'
      }">
        <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white animate-ping"></span>
        <span>${label}</span>
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [80, 24],
    iconAnchor: [40, 12],
  });
};

export function TrackingScreen() {
  const [trucks, setTrucks] = useState<Map<string, TruckTelemetry>>(new Map());
  const [selectedTruck, setSelectedTruck] = useState<TruckTelemetry | null>(null);
  const [lanes, setLanes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
  const [lastUpdate, setLastUpdate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reconnectCountdown, setReconnectCountdown] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const socketRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);
  const backoffRef = useRef<number>(1);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  // Fetch initial master data
  useEffect(() => {
    const token = getStoredToken();
    const headers: Record<string, string> = token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};

    // Load initial trucks
    fetch('/api/v1/tracking/trucks', { headers })
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : { trucks: [] }))
      .then((data) => {
        const map = new Map<string, TruckTelemetry>();
        for (const t of data.trucks || []) {
          map.set(t.truck_id, t);
        }
        setTrucks(map);
        if (data.trucks && data.trucks.length > 0) {
          setLastUpdate(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    // Load route nodes & lanes
    fetch('/api/v1/warehouses', { headers })
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : []))
      .then((whs) => {
        fetch('/api/v1/suppliers', { headers })
          .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : []))
          .then((sups) => {
            const allNodes = [
              ...(whs || []).map((w: any) => ({ ...w, isWh: true })),
              ...(sups || []).map((s: any) => ({ ...s, isWh: false })),
            ];
            setNodes(allNodes);

            // Fetch transfer lanes
            fetch('/api/v1/transfer-lanes', { headers })
              .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : []))
              .then((laneData) => {
                setLanes(laneData || []);
              })
              .catch(() => {});
          });
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  // WebSocket live feed connection with exponential backoff (1, 2, 4, ... 30s)
  useEffect(() => {
    let unmounted = false;

    function connectWs() {
      if (unmounted) return;

      const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
      const wsUrl = `${protocol}//${window.location.host}/ws`;
      const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
      socketRef.current = ws;

      ws.onopen = () => {
        setIsConnected(true);
        setReconnectCountdown(null);
        backoffRef.current = 1; // Reset backoff on successful connect

        const token = getStoredToken();
        if (token) {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', token }));
        }
      };

      ws.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
          if (msg.type === 'auth_ok') {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'tracking' }));
          }

          if (msg.type === 'event' && msg.topic === 'tracking') {
            const data = msg.data;
            if (data && data.type === 'TRUCK_POSITION') {
              setTrucks((prev) => {
                const updated = new Map(prev);
                const existing = updated.get(data.truck_id) || {
                  truck_id: data.truck_id,
                  driver_id: data.driver_id,
                  position: null,
                };
                const newPos = {
                  lat: data.lat,
                  lng: data.lng,
                  speed_kmh: data.speed_kmh,
                  lane_id: data.lane_id,
                  km_on_lane: data.km_on_lane,
                  method: data.lane_id ? ('ROAD_GRAPH' as const) : ('STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE' as const),
                  ts: data.ts,
                  seq: data.seq,
                };
                const newTruck: TruckTelemetry = {
                  ...existing,
                  position: newPos,
                };
                updated.set(data.truck_id, newTruck);
                return updated;
              });
              setLastUpdate(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
            }

            if (data && data.type === 'REROUTE_EXECUTED') {
              setTrucks((prev) => {
                const updated = new Map(prev);
                const existing = updated.get(data.truck_id);
                if (existing) {
                  updated.set(data.truck_id, {
                    ...existing,
                    pending_proposal: undefined,
                  });
                }
                return updated;
              });
            }
          }
        } catch {}
      };

      ws.onclose = () => {
        setIsConnected(false);
        if (unmounted) return;

        const delay = backoffRef.current;
        backoffRef.current = Math.min(30, backoffRef.current * 2);
        setReconnectCountdown(delay);

        let remaining = delay;
        const countdownTimer = setInterval(() => {
          remaining -= 1;
          if (remaining <= 0) {
            clearInterval(countdownTimer);
            connectWs();
          } else {
            setReconnectCountdown(remaining);
          }
        }, 1000);
      };

      ws.onerror = () => {
        ws.close();
      };
    }

    connectWs();

    return () => {
      unmounted = true;
      if (socketRef.current) socketRef.current.close();
      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Compute lane polyline coordinates
  const lanePolylines = lanes
    .map((lane) => {
      const from = nodes.find((n) => n._id === lane.from_warehouse_id);
      const to = nodes.find((n) => n._id === lane.to_warehouse_id);
      if (from?.lat && from?.lng && to?.lat && to?.lng) {
        return {
          id: lane._id,
          coords: [
            [from.lat, from.lng] as [number, number],
            [to.lat, to.lng] as [number, number],
          ],
          distance_km: lane.distance_km,
        };
      }
      return null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean);

  const trucksList = Array.from(trucks.values());

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] flex flex-col bg-slate-100">
      {/* Top Telemetry Header */}
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between z-10 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-600">
            <Navigation className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">Live Driver Telemetry Radar</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Active Fleet: {trucksList.length} trucks | Corridor Network: Hosur, Chennai, Bengaluru
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status Indicator */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          {isConnected ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 text-xs font-medium rounded-full">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></span>
              <span>Live feed active</span>
              {lastUpdate && <span className="text-emerald-500 font-mono">({lastUpdate})</span>}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 text-xs font-medium rounded-full">
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
              <span>
                Live feed paused {lastUpdate ? `(last: ${lastUpdate})` : ''}
                {reconnectCountdown !== null && ` • Reconnecting in ${reconnectCountdown}s`}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Map Container */}
      <div className="relative flex-1 w-full h-full">
        <MapContainer
          center={[12.95, 78.5]}
          zoom={8}
          scrollWheelZoom={true}
          className="w-full h-full"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
            backgroundImage: MAP_TILE_URL
              ? 'none'
              : 'radial-gradient(#cbd5e1 1px, transparent 1px)',
            backgroundSize: '24px 24px',
          }}
        >
          {/* Tile Layer: ONLY if MAP_TILE_URL is set; otherwise plain background grid */}
          {MAP_TILE_URL && <TileLayer url={MAP_TILE_URL} />}

          {/* Lane Polylines */}
          {lanePolylines.map((l) => (
            <Polyline
              key={l!.id}
              positions={l!.coords}
              color="#6366f1"
              weight={3}
              opacity={0.7}
              dashArray="4, 4"
            />
          ))}

          {/* Warehouse & Supplier Nodes */}
          {nodes.map((node) => {
            if (!node.lat || !node.lng) return null;
            return (
              <Marker
                key={node._id}
                position={[node.lat, node.lng]}
                icon={createNodeIcon(node.code, node.isWh)}
              >
                <Popup>
                  <div className="p-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">{node.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-slate-500">{node.code}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-slate-600">
                      Coordinates: {node.lat.toFixed(4)}, {node.lng.toFixed(4)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Popup>
              </Marker>
            );
          })}

          {/* Live Trucks */}
          {trucksList.map((truck) => {
            if (!truck.position?.lat || !truck.position?.lng) return null;
            const isEstimate = truck.position.method === 'STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE';

            return (
              <Marker
                key={truck.truck_id}
                position={[truck.position.lat, truck.position.lng]}
                icon={createTruckIcon(isEstimate)}
                eventHandlers={{
                  click: () => setSelectedTruck(truck),
                }}
              >
                <Popup>
                  <div className="p-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">Truck {truck.truck_id}</div>
                    <div className="text-slate-500">Driver: {truck.driver_id}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 font-mono text-indigo-600">
                      Speed: {truck.position.speed_kmh} km/h
                    </div>
                    {isEstimate && (
                      <div className="mt-1 text-amber-600 font-medium">
                        ⚠️ Estimate, off road network
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </Popup>
              </Marker>
            );
          })}
        </MapContainer>

        {/* Selected Truck Detail Drawer */}
        {selectedTruck && (
          <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 w-96 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl z-[1000] p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3 mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Truck className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900">Truck {selectedTruck.truck_id}</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedTruck(null)}
                className="p-1 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-slate-50">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Driver ID:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{selectedTruck.driver_id}</span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-slate-50">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Current Speed:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  {selectedTruck.position?.speed_kmh ?? 0} km/h
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-slate-50">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Telemetry Method:</span>
                <span
                  className={`font-semibold ${
                    selectedTruck.position?.method === 'STRAIGHT_LINE_ESTIMATE'
                      ? 'text-amber-600'
                      : 'text-emerald-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  {selectedTruck.position?.method || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-slate-50">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Coordinates:</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-800">
                  {selectedTruck.position?.lat.toFixed(4)}, {selectedTruck.position?.lng.toFixed(4)}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-slate-50">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Last Ping Time:</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-600">
                  {selectedTruck.position?.ts
                    ? new Date(selectedTruck.position.ts).toLocaleTimeString()
                    : 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-slate-50">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Assigned Destination:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  {selectedTruck.destination_warehouse?.name || 'In-transit'} (
                  {selectedTruck.destination_warehouse?.code || 'WH'})
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Active Incident */}
              {selectedTruck.active_incident && (
                <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-red-700 font-bold">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Active Incident: {selectedTruck.active_incident.kind}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-red-600">
                    Reported at {new Date(selectedTruck.active_incident.ts).toLocaleTimeString()}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pending Proposal */}
              {selectedTruck.pending_proposal && (
                <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-800 font-bold">
                    <Radio className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                    <span>Reroute Proposal Pending</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-slate-700">
                    Recommended Hub:{' '}
                    <span className="font-bold">
                      {selectedTruck.pending_proposal.nearest_warehouse_id}
                    </span>{' '}
                    ({selectedTruck.pending_proposal.road_km} km)
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-amber-700">
                    Awaiting Supply Chain Manager approval
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/web/src/screens/WarehouseLayoutScreen.tsx
 *
 * Screen 11: Warehouse Zone Capacity Mapper (Leaflet CRS.Simple 0-1000 Space).
 *
 * Features:
 * - Leaflet map with CRS.Simple on 0-1000 coordinate space (no tile layer).
 * - Warehouse boundaries (0 to 1000 coordinate box).
 * - Zones rendered as coloured polygons with labels (GREEN, AMBER, RED).
 * - RED zones rendered with thick red outline (pulsing effect).
 * - Tooltip & Click Drawer: zone name, type, capacity_slots, occupied_slots,
 *   reserved_inbound_slots, projected_utilisation %, and verbatim explanation sentence.
 * - Editing (Manager and Admin only): vertex editing controls. Save calls PATCH /zones/:id.
 * - Side panel: quick-assign SKU units; "Check incoming shipment" simulates arrivals without writing.
 * - Inbound plan reservation: POST /capacity/inbound-plans with governed plan_over_capacity for Managers.
 * - Keyboard accessible: alternative List View with identical numbers and actions.
 * - Real-time WebSocket: listens to 'capacity' and 'zones' topics to update colours live.
 * - Presence banner: shows "Operator X is also viewing this zone" when viewing same zone.
 * - Mobile 390px responsive compatibility.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { MapContainer, Polygon, Tooltip as LeafletTooltip, useMap } from 'react-leaflet';
import L from 'leaflet';
import '@geoman-io/leaflet-geoman-free';
import '@geoman-io/leaflet-geoman-free/dist/leaflet-geoman.css';
import { api, getStoredUser, getStoredToken } from '../api/client.js';
import { resolveWarehouseCode } from '../utils/normalize.js';
import { WarehouseSiteMap } from '../ui/WarehouseSiteMap.js';
import {
  Button,
  Drawer,
  ErrorState,
  Skeleton,
} from '../ui/components.js';
import {
  Warehouse as WarehouseIcon,
  AlertTriangle,
  RefreshCw,
  Eye,
  Sliders,
  Trash2,
  Users,
  Search,
  List,
  Map as MapIcon,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface ZoneData {
  zone_id: string;
  name: string;
  warehouse_id: string;
  zone_type: string;
  capacity_slots: number;
  occupied_slots: number;
  reserved_inbound_slots: number;
  projected_slots: number;
  utilization_pct: number;
  colour: 'GREEN' | 'AMBER' | 'RED';
  explanation: string;
  polygon: Array<[number, number]>;
  assignments: Array<{ sku_id: string; units: number; slots: number }>;
  inbound_plans: Array<{ plan_id: string; shipment_id: string; slots: number; status: string }>;
}

const clamp1000 = (n: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1000, Math.round(n)));

/** Adds the geoman toolbar (draw polygon/rectangle + edit vertices) to the Leaflet map. */
function ZoneDrawControls({ onCreated }: { onCreated: (pts: [number, number][]) => void }) {
  const map = useMap();
  const cbRef = useRef(onCreated);
  cbRef.current = onCreated;

  useEffect(() => {
    const pm = (map as any).pm;
    if (!pm) return;
    pm.addControls({
      position: 'topleft',
      drawPolygon: true,
      drawRectangle: true,
      editMode: true,
      drawMarker: false,
      drawCircleMarker: false,
      drawPolyline: false,
      drawCircle: false,
      drawText: false,
      dragMode: false,
      cutPolygon: false,
      removalMode: false,
      rotateMode: false,
    });
    pm.setGlobalOptions({ allowSelfIntersection: false, snappable: true });

    const handleCreate = (e: any) => {
      const ring: L.LatLng[] = e.layer.getLatLngs()[0];
      // Leaflet is [lat, lng] = [y, x]; the DB stores [x, y]
      const pts = ring.map((ll) => [clamp1000(ll.lng), clamp1000(ll.lat)] as [number, number]);
      map.removeLayer(e.layer); // real polygon is re-rendered from the API after save
      cbRef.current(pts);
    };

    map.on('pm:create', handleCreate);
    return () => {
      map.off('pm:create', handleCreate);
      pm.removeControls();
    };
  }, [map]);

  return null;
}

export function WarehouseLayoutScreen() {
  const currentUser = getStoredUser();
  const isManagerOrAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'Manager' || currentUser?.role === 'Administrator';

  const [warehouseId, setWarehouseId] = useState<string>(resolveWarehouseCode(currentUser));
  const [zones, setZones] = useState<ZoneData[]>([]);
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Selected Zone Drawer
  const [selectedZone, setSelectedZone] = useState<ZoneData | null>(null);
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Accessible View Toggle (Site Map vs Zone Grid vs List)
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'site' | 'map' | 'list'>('site');

  // Quick Assign State
  const [assignSku, setAssignSku] = useState('SKU-101');
  const [assignUnits, setAssignUnits] = useState('10');
  const [assignSubmitting, setAssignSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [assignError, setAssignError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Check Inbound State
  const [checkModalOpen, setCheckModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [checkShipmentId, setCheckShipmentId] = useState('SHP-HOS-001');
  const [checkZoneId, setCheckZoneId] = useState('');
  const [checkSlots, setCheckSlots] = useState('5');
  const [checkResult, setCheckResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [planOverCapacity, setPlanOverCapacity] = useState(false);
  const [planSubmitting, setPlanSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Vertex Editing State
  const [editingZoneId, setEditingZoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editPoints, setEditPoints] = useState<string>('');
  const [editSubmitting, setEditSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Presence State
  const [presenceUser, setPresenceUser] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);

  // New-zone form (opens after the user finishes drawing a polygon)
  const [pendingPolygon, setPendingPolygon] = useState<[number, number][] | null>(null);
  const [newZone, setNewZone] = useState({ name: '', zone_type: 'STORAGE', capacity_slots: '50' });
  const [newZoneSaving, setNewZoneSaving] = useState(false);

  const fetchCapacity = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const [overviewData, zonesData] = await Promise.all([
        api.capacity.getOverview(warehouseId).catch(() => null),
        api.capacity.getZones(warehouseId), // errors now reach the catch below
      ]);

      setOverview(overviewData);
      setZones(Array.isArray(zonesData) ? zonesData : []);

      if (selectedZone) {
        const refreshed = (Array.isArray(zonesData) ? zonesData : []).find(
          (z: ZoneData) => z.zone_id === selectedZone.zone_id,
        );
        if (refreshed) setSelectedZone(refreshed);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to load warehouse zones');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchCapacity();
  }, [warehouseId]);

  // WebSocket for Real-time Capacity Updates & Presence
  useEffect(() => {
    const token = getStoredToken();
    if (!token) return;

    const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    const wsUrl = `${protocol}//${window.location.host}/ws`;
    const socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
    wsRef.current = socket;

    socket.onopen = () => {
      socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', token }));
      socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'capacity' }));
      socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', topic: 'presence' }));
    };

    socket.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
        if (msg.topic === 'capacity' || msg.topic === 'zones') {
          // Re-fetch zones on live updates
          api.capacity.getZones(warehouseId).then((res) => {
            if (res) setZones(res);
          }).catch(() => {});
          api.capacity.getOverview(warehouseId).then((res) => {
            if (res) setOverview(res);
          }).catch(() => {});
        } else if (msg.topic === 'presence') {
          const data = msg.data;
          if (
            data.kind === 'zone' &&
            selectedZone &&
            data.id === selectedZone.zone_id &&
            data.username !== currentUser?.username
          ) {
            setPresenceUser(data.username || data.role || 'Another operator');
            setTimeout(() => setPresenceUser(null), 5000);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore message error
      }
    };

    return () => {
      if (socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN || socket.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING) {
        socket.close();
      }
    };
  }, [warehouseId, selectedZone?.zone_id]);

  // Emit presence when a zone is opened
  const handleOpenZone = (zone: ZoneData) => {
    setSelectedZone(zone);
    setDrawerOpen(true);
    setAssignError(null);
    setCheckZoneId(zone.zone_id);

    if (wsRef.current && wsRef.current.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      wsRef.current.send(
        JSON.stringify({
          type: 'viewing',
          kind: 'zone',
          id: zone.zone_id,
        })
      );
    }
  };

  const handleStockAssign = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedZone) return;
    try {
      setAssignSubmitting(true);

      if (isNaN(units) || units < 0) {

        return;

      await api.capacity.assignStock(selectedZone.zone_id, assignSku, units);
      await fetchCapacity();
      const updated = await api.capacity.getZone(selectedZone.zone_id);

  const handleCheckInbound = async () => {

          >
            <MapContainer
              crs={L.CRS.Simple}
              bounds={[[0, 0], [1000, 1000]]}
              maxBounds={[[-100, -100], [1100, 1100]]}
              zoom={-1}
              minZoom={-2}
              maxZoom={2}
              zoomSnap={0.1}
              zoomDelta={0.5}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', background: 'transparent' }}
            >
              {isManagerOrAdmin && <ZoneDrawControls onCreated={setPendingPolygon} />}

              {/* Outer Warehouse Boundary (0,0 to 1000,1000) */}
              <Polygon
                positions={[
                  [0, 0],
                  [0, 1000],
                  [1000, 1000],
                  [1000, 0],
                ]}
                pathOptions={{
                  color: '#94a3b8',
                  weight: 2,
                  dashArray: '8, 8',
                  fill: false,
                  pmIgnore: true,
                } as any}
              />

              {/* Zones */}
              {zones
                .filter((z) => Array.isArray(z.polygon) && z.polygon.length >= 3)
                .map((zone) => {
                // DB polygon is [[x, y], ...]. In CRS.Simple, Leaflet maps [lat, lng] as [y, x]
                const positions: [number, number][] = zone.polygon.map(([x, y]) => [y, x]);
                const style = getPolygonStyle(zone.colour);

                return (
                  <Polygon
                    key={zone.zone_id}
                    positions={positions}
                    pathOptions={style}
                    eventHandlers={{
                      click: () => handleOpenZone(zone),
                      'pm:edit': (e: any) => handleZoneEdited(zone.zone_id, e.layer),
                    }}
                  >
                    <LeafletTooltip sticky direction="top" opacity={0.95}>
                      <div className="p-1 space-y-0.5 text-xs">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">{zone.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-slate-600">Type: {zone.zone_type} | ID: {zone.zone_id}</div>
                        <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                          Occupancy: {zone.occupied_slots} / {zone.capacity_slots} slots ({zone.utilization_pct}%)
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-slate-500">Reserved Inbound: {zone.reserved_inbound_slots} slots</div>
                        <div className={`font-semibold ${zone.colour === 'RED' ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                          {zone.explanation}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </LeafletTooltip>
                  </Polygon>
                );
              })}
            </MapContainer>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* ACCESSIBLE KEYBOARD-FRIENDLY LIST VIEW */
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
            Warehouse Zones Breakdown ({zones.length} Zones)
          </div>
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {zones.map((zone) => (
              <div
                key={zone.zone_id}
                className="p-4 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4"
              >
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{zone.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 font-mono">
                      {zone.zone_id}
                    </span>
                    <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold border ${getColourClass(zone.colour)}`}>
                      {zone.colour} ({zone.utilization_pct}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
                    {zone.explanation}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Capacity: {zone.capacity_slots} slots | Occupied: {zone.occupied_slots} slots | Planned Inbound: {zone.reserved_inbound_slots} slots
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => handleOpenZone(zone)}>
                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                    Details & Stock
                  </Button>
                  {isManagerOrAdmin && (
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => handleStartEdit(zone)}
                    >
                      <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                      Edit Vertices
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Zone Detail & Quick Assign Drawer */}
      <Drawer
        open={drawerOpen}
        onClose={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
        title={selectedZone ? `${selectedZone.name} (${selectedZone.zone_id})` : 'Zone Details'}
      >
        {selectedZone && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* Occupancy Card */}
            <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border ${getColourClass(selectedZone.colour)} space-y-2`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Occupancy Status</span>
                <span className="font-black text-sm">{selectedZone.colour}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold">{selectedZone.explanation}</div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2 text-xs border-t border-slate-200">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Total Capacity:</span>{' '}
                  <span className="font-bold">{selectedZone.capacity_slots} slots</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Occupied:</span>{' '}
                  <span className="font-bold">{selectedZone.occupied_slots} slots</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Reserved Inbound:</span>{' '}
                  <span className="font-bold">{selectedZone.reserved_inbound_slots} slots</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Projected:</span>{' '}
                  <span className="font-bold">{selectedZone.projected_slots} slots ({selectedZone.utilization_pct}%)</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Current Stock Assignments */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>Stock in Zone ({selectedZone.assignments?.length || 0} SKUs)</span>
              </div>

              {selectedZone.assignments && selectedZone.assignments.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="bg-slate-50 rounded-lg p-2 border border-slate-200 divide-y divide-slate-200 text-xs">
                  {selectedZone.assignments.map((a, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="py-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{a.sku_id}</span>
                        <div className="text-slate-500">{a.units} physical units</div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-white border border-slate-200 font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        {a.slots} discrete slots
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 italic p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-center">
                  No inventory currently assigned to this zone.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Quick Assign Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleStockAssign} className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">

              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">

                    onChange={(e) => setAssignSku(e.target.value)}

                    <option value="SKU-205">SKU-205 (10 units/slot)</option>
                    <option value="SKU-310">SKU-310 (10 units/slot)</option>
                    <option value="SKU-402">SKU-402 (10 units/slot)</option>
                    <option value="SKU-615">SKU-615 (10 units/slot)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-600 block mb-1 font-medium">Units</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"

                    className="w-full text-xs p-2 rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <Button type="submit" size="sm" className="w-full" disabled={assignSubmitting}>
                {assignSubmitting ? 'Assigning...' : 'Assign Stock to Zone'}
              </Button>
            </form>

            {/* Planned Inbound Reservations */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                Planned Inbound Slots ({selectedZone.inbound_plans?.length || 0})
              </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">

                      key={p.plan_id}
                      className="p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-between text-xs"

                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">{p.shipment_id}</div>
                        <div className="text-slate-500">{p.slots} slots reserved</div>

                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => handleReleasePlan(p.plan_id)}
                        className="text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 hover:bg-rose-50 text-xs py-0.5 px-2"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                        Release

                    </div>
                  ))}

                <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 italic p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-center">

                </div>

                <Button

                >
                  <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                  Edit Zone Boundary Coordinates
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Drawer>

      {/* Inbound Shipment Check & Plan Modal */}

        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4 border border-slate-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                Check Incoming Shipment Capacity
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => setCheckModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 text-lg font-bold"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Simulate an inbound shipment arrival against warehouse zones without writing any database records.
            </p>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Target Zone</label>
                <select
                  value={checkZoneId}
                  onChange={(e) => setCheckZoneId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full text-xs p-2 rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white"
                >
                  {zones.map((z) => (
                    <option key={z.zone_id} value={z.zone_id}>
                      {z.name} ({z.zone_id}) — {z.occupied_slots + z.reserved_inbound_slots}/{z.capacity_slots} slots
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Shipment Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={checkShipmentId}
                    onChange={(e) => setCheckShipmentId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full text-xs p-2 rounded border border-slate-300"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Required Slots</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    value={checkSlots}
                    onChange={(e) => setCheckSlots(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full text-xs p-2 rounded border border-slate-300"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                className="w-full"
                onClick={handleCheckInbound}
                disabled={checking}
              >
                {checking ? 'Evaluating Capacity...' : 'Simulate Arrival (Read-Only)'}
              </Button>

              {/* Simulation Result */}
              {checkResult && (
                <div
                  className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-xs space-y-1.5 ${
                    checkResult.error
                      ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-700'
                      : checkResult.would_exceed
                      ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-900'
                      : 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  {checkResult.error ? (
                    <div>{checkResult.error}</div>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <div className="font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>Projected: {checkResult.colour}</span>
                        <span>{checkResult.projected?.utilization_pct}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-medium">{checkResult.explanation}</div>

                      {checkResult.would_exceed && (
                        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-rose-200 space-y-2">
                          <div className="text-rose-700 font-semibold">
                            ⚠️ This inbound arrival would exceed available zone capacity.
                          </div>
                          {isManagerOrAdmin && (
                            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer font-medium text-slate-800">
                              <input
                                type="checkbox"
                                checked={planOverCapacity}
                                onChange={(e) => setPlanOverCapacity(e.target.checked)}
                                className="rounded text-indigo-600"
                              />
                              <span>Manager Override (plan_over_capacity: true)</span>
                            </label>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <div className="pt-2">
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          className="w-full"
                          disabled={
                            planSubmitting ||
                            (checkResult.would_exceed && !planOverCapacity)
                          }
                          onClick={handleConfirmInboundPlan}
                        >
                          {planSubmitting ? 'Reserving...' : 'Commit Inbound Plan'}
                        </Button>
                        {checkResult.commitError && (
                          <div className="text-rose-600 font-bold mt-1 text-center">
                            {checkResult.commitError}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Vertex Editor Modal */}
      {editingZoneId && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 border border-slate-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sliders className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                Edit Polygon Vertices ({editingZoneId})
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => setEditingZoneId(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 text-lg font-bold"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Coordinates must be bounded in 0 to 1000 space, contain $\ge 3$ vertices, and must not self-intersect.
            </p>

            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
                JSON Polygon Points [[x, y], ...]
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={5}
                value={editPoints}
                onChange={(e) => setEditPoints(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full text-xs font-mono p-2 rounded border border-slate-300"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditingZoneId(null)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                disabled={editSubmitting}
                onClick={() => handleSavePolygon(editingZoneId)}
              >
                {editSubmitting ? 'Validating & Saving...' : 'Save Boundary (PATCH)'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {pendingPolygon && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] bg-slate-900/40 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 w-full max-w-md p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900">New zone in {warehouseId}</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{pendingPolygon.length} vertices drawn</p>

            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Zone name
              <input
                value={newZone.name}
                onChange={(e) => setNewZone({ ...newZone, name: e.target.value })}
                className="mt-1 w-full border border-slate-300 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-sm"
                placeholder="e.g. Cold Storage B"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Type
              <select
                value={newZone.zone_type}
                onChange={(e) => setNewZone({ ...newZone, zone_type: e.target.value })}
                className="mt-1 w-full border border-slate-300 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-sm"
              >
                {['RECEIVING', 'STORAGE', 'DISPATCH', 'QUARANTINE'].map((t) => (
                  <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Capacity (slots)
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                value={newZone.capacity_slots}
                onChange={(e) => setNewZone({ ...newZone, capacity_slots: e.target.value })}
                className="mt-1 w-full border border-slate-300 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-sm"
              />
            </label>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setPendingPolygon(null)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleSaveNewZone}
                loading={newZoneSaving}
                disabled={!newZone.name.trim()}
              >
                Save zone
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/web/src/services/offlineQueue.ts
 *
 * Driver offline queue using native browser IndexedDB (strictly no localStorage).
 * Monotonic sequence tracking, batching up to 100 pings, and removing items
 * only after server confirmation or DUPLICATE response.
 */

const DB_NAME = 'disruptioniq_driver_db';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'pending_pings';

export interface QueuedPing {
  seq: number;
  ts: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  speed_kmh: number;
  truck_id?: string;
  driver_id?: string;
  created_at?: number;
}

function openDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') {
      return reject(new Error('IndexedDB not supported in this environment'));
    }

    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

    request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
      const db = (event.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'seq' });
      }
    };

    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  });
}

/**
 * Enqueues a ping into IndexedDB.
 */
export async function enqueuePing(ping: QueuedPing): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.put({ ...ping, created_at: Date.now() });
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/**
 * Retrieves all pending pings ordered by sequence number ascending.
 */
export async function getPendingPings(): Promise<QueuedPing[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const items: QueuedPing[] = req.result || [];
      items.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
      resolve(items);
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/**
 * Gets count of currently pending pings.
 */
export async function getPendingCount(): Promise<number> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.count();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/**
 * Removes confirmed or duplicate pings from IndexedDB by sequence numbers.
 */
export async function removePings(seqs: number[]): Promise<void> {
  if (seqs.length === 0) return;
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    for (const seq of seqs) {
      store.delete(seq);
    }
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

/**
 * Flushes pending pings in batches of up to 100 in sequence order.
 * Pings are removed ONLY after the server confirms receipt or reports DUPLICATE.
 */
export async function flushQueue(
  sendBatchFn: (batch: QueuedPing[]) => Promise<{ accepted: number; duplicates: number }>,
): Promise<{ flushed: number; remaining: number }> {
  const allPending = await getPendingPings();
  if (allPending.length === 0) {
    return { flushed: 0, remaining: 0 };
  }

  let totalFlushed = 0;

  // Process in batches of 100
  for (let i = 0; i < allPending.length; i += 100) {
    const batch = allPending.slice(i, i + 100);
    try {
      const res = await sendBatchFn(batch);
      if (res && (res.accepted > 0 || res.duplicates > 0)) {
        const seqsToRemove = batch.map((p) => p.seq);
        await removePings(seqsToRemove);
        totalFlushed += batch.length;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Network failure or offline: keep in queue for next flush attempt
      break;
    }
  }

  const remaining = await getPendingCount();
  return { flushed: totalFlushed, remaining };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/web/test/offlineQueue.test.ts
 *
 * Acceptance test for Driver Screen Offline Queue:
 * - Go offline, move truck for 10 pings.
 * - Queue holds exactly 10 in monotonic sequence order.
 * - Go online: queue flushes in order in batches of up to 100.
 * - Pings removed only upon server confirmation.
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  enqueuePing,
  getPendingPings,
  getPendingCount,
  flushQueue,
  QueuedPing,
} from '../src/services/offlineQueue.js';

// Clean in-memory IndexedDB mock for Node.js Vitest environment
class MockIDBDatabase {
  public data = new Map<number, QueuedPing>();

  transaction(_store: string, _mode: string) {
    const self = this;
    return {
      objectStore(_name: string) {
        return {
          put(item: QueuedPing) {
            self.data.set(item.seq, item);
            const req = { onsuccess: () => {}, onerror: () => {} };
            setTimeout(() => req.onsuccess(), 0);
            return req;
          },
          getAll() {
            const items = Array.from(self.data.values());
            const req = { result: items, onsuccess: () => {}, onerror: () => {} };
            setTimeout(() => req.onsuccess(), 0);
            return req;
          },
          count() {
            const req = { result: self.data.size, onsuccess: () => {}, onerror: () => {} };
            setTimeout(() => req.onsuccess(), 0);
            return req;
          },
          delete(seq: number) {
            self.data.delete(seq);
          },
        };
      },
      set oncomplete(fn: () => void) {
        setTimeout(fn, 0);
      },
      set onerror(fn: () => void) {},
    };
  }
}

describe('Driver Screen Offline Queue Acceptance', () => {
  let mockDb: MockIDBDatabase;

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockDb = new MockIDBDatabase();
    (globalThis as any).indexedDB = {
      open: () => {
        const req = {
          result: mockDb,
          onsuccess: () => {},
          onerror: () => {},
          onupgradeneeded: () => {},
        };
        setTimeout(() => req.onsuccess(), 0);
        return req;
      },
    };
  });

  it('enqueues 10 pings offline, flushes them online in seq order, and retains none after confirmation', async () => {
    // 1. Truck moves while offline: 10 pings generated
    for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
      await enqueuePing({
        seq: i,
        ts: new Date(1700000000000 + i * 1000).toISOString(),
        lat: 12.7409 + i * 0.001,
        lng: 77.8253 + i * 0.001,
        speed_kmh: 60,
        truck_id: 'SHP-204',
        driver_id: 'DRV-1',
      });
    }

    // Verify 10 pending in queue
    const countBefore = await getPendingCount();
    expect(countBefore).toBe(10);

    const pending = await getPendingPings();
    expect(pending).toHaveLength(10);
    // Verified strictly monotonic seq order
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      expect(pending[i].seq).toBe(i + 1);
    }

    // 2. Network reconnects: flushQueue sends batch to server
    const serverReceived: QueuedPing[] = [];
    const flushResult = await flushQueue(async (batch) => {
      serverReceived.push(...batch);
      return { accepted: batch.length, duplicates: 0 };
    });

    // Verify flush result
    expect(flushResult.flushed).toBe(10);
    expect(flushResult.remaining).toBe(0);

    // Verify server holds exactly ten in order
    expect(serverReceived).toHaveLength(10);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      expect(serverReceived[i].seq).toBe(i + 1);
    }

    // Verify queue is now empty
    const countAfter = await getPendingCount();
    expect(countAfter).toBe(0);
  });
});
````
