````typescript
import mongoose, { Schema, Document } from 'mongoose';

export interface IZone extends Document {
  zone_id: string;
  warehouse_id: string;
  name: string;
  zone_type: 'RECEIVING' | 'STORAGE' | 'DISPATCH' | 'QUARANTINE';
  polygon: Array<[number, number]>;
  capacity_slots: number;
  reserved_inbound_slots: number;
  version: number;
  is_active: boolean;
  deleted_at: Date | null;
  created_at: Date;
}

const zoneSchema = new Schema<IZone>({
  zone_id: { type: String, required: true, unique: true },
  warehouse_id: { type: String, required: true, index: true },
  name: { type: String, required: true },
  zone_type: {
    type: String,
    required: true,
    enum: ['RECEIVING', 'STORAGE', 'DISPATCH', 'QUARANTINE'],
  },
  polygon: { type: Schema.Types.Mixed, required: true },
  capacity_slots: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 },
  reserved_inbound_slots: {
    type: Number,
    required: true,
    default: 0,
    min: 0,
    validate: {
      validator: function (this: IZone, val: number) {
        if ((this as any).allow_over_capacity) return true;
        if (this.capacity_slots !== undefined && this.capacity_slots !== null) {
          return val <= this.capacity_slots;
        }
        return true;
      },
      message: 'reserved_inbound_slots must be <= capacity_slots',
    },
  },
  version: { type: Number, default: 1, min: 1 },
  is_active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  deleted_at: { type: Date, default: null },
  created_at: { type: Date, default: Date.now },
}, { collection: 'zones' });

zoneSchema.index({ warehouse_id: 1, name: 1 }, { unique: true });

export const Zone = mongoose.model<IZone>('Zone', zoneSchema);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/adminOps.ts
 *
 * Step 12 Part B – Admin Stress-Test & Red-Team endpoints (A11, S3).
 * POST /admin/stress/run
 * POST /admin/stress/cleanup
 * POST /admin/red-team/run
 * GET  /admin/red-team/report
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { runStressTest } from '../services/stressTest.js';
import { runRedTeamSuite } from '../services/redTeam.js';
import { StressRun } from '../models/stress-runs.js';

export const adminOpsRouter = Router();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /admin/stress/run (Admin, DEMO_MODE) — Step 12, A11
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
adminOpsRouter.post(
  '/stress/run',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('run_stress_test'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const options = req.body || {};
      const result = await runStressTest(options, req.user!._id);
      res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /admin/stress/cleanup — Clean up stress test synthetic artifacts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
adminOpsRouter.post(
  '/stress/cleanup',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('run_stress_test'),
  async (_req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await StressRun.deleteMany({});
      res.status(200).json({ ok: true, message: 'Stress test artifacts cleaned up successfully' });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /admin/red-team/run (Admin) — Step 12, S3
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
adminOpsRouter.post(
  '/red-team/run',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('manage_users_redteam'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const report = await runRedTeamSuite(req.user!._id);
      res.status(200).json(report);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /admin/red-team/report (Admin)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
adminOpsRouter.get(
  '/red-team/report',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('manage_users_redteam'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const report = await runRedTeamSuite(req.user!._id);
      res.status(200).json(report);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/approvals.ts
 *
 * Approvals queue and delegations endpoints (Step 8 Part B, Step 11 Part B, B9).
 * GET    /approvals/queue
 * POST   /approvals/delegations
 * GET    /approvals/delegations
 * DELETE /approvals/delegations/:id
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission, requireAnyPermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { Approval } from '../models/approvals.js';
import { RecoveryPlan } from '../models/recovery-plans.js';
import { ApprovalDelegation } from '../models/approval-delegations.js';
import { User } from '../models/users.js';
import { createDelegation, revokeDelegation } from '../services/delegations.js';
import { simClock } from '../services/simClock.js';

export const approvalsRouter = Router();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /approvals/queue — pending items matching caller's role (including active delegations)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
approvalsRouter.get(
  '/queue',
  authenticateToken,
  requireAnyPermission(['approve_reallocate_split', 'approve_expedite_alt_supplier']),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      if (!['Manager', 'Procurement_Approver'].includes(user.role)) {
        res.status(200).json({ queue: [], total: 0 });
        return;
      }

      const now = await simClock.now();

      // Find all active delegations where user is delegate
      const delegationsReceived = await ApprovalDelegation.find({
        delegate_id: user._id,
        is_active: true,
        valid_from: { $lte: now },
        valid_until: { $gte: now },
      })
        .populate('delegator_id', 'username display_name role')
        .lean();

      // Roles user can approve for (their own, plus any delegated roles)
      const allowedRoles = [user.role, ...delegationsReceived.map((d: any) => d.role || d.delegator_id?.role)];

      // Find all PENDING approvals matching caller's role or delegated roles
      const pendingApprovals = await Approval.find({
        required_role: { $in: allowedRoles },
        status: 'PENDING',
      })
        .populate('plan_id')
        .sort({ plan_version: -1 })
        .lean();

      const items = pendingApprovals
        .filter((a) => a.plan_id)
        .map((a) => {
          const plan = a.plan_id as any;
          const saving = (plan.baseline_value || 0) - (plan.objective_value || plan.total_cost || 0);

          // Find if there's a delegation matching this plan/role
          const matchingDelegation = delegationsReceived.find((d: any) => {
            if (d.role && d.role !== a.required_role) return false;
            if (d.plan_id && !d.plan_id.equals(plan._id)) return false;
            return true;
          });

          let delegationChip = null;
          if (matchingDelegation) {
            delegationChip = {
              delegated_from: (matchingDelegation.delegator_id as any)?.display_name || 'Delegator',
              role: a.required_role,
              valid_until: matchingDelegation.valid_until,
            };
          }

          return {
            approval_id: a._id,
            plan_id: plan._id,
            disruption_id: plan.disruption_id,
            plan_version: a.plan_version,
            required_role: a.required_role,
            contract_hash: a.contract_hash,
            status: a.status,
            strategy: plan.strategy,
            total_cost: plan.total_cost,
            objective: plan.objective_value || plan.total_cost,
            baseline: plan.baseline_value || 0,
            saving,
            created_by: plan.created_by,
            escalation_flag: Boolean(plan.decision_contract?.escalation_approvals_required),
            delegation_chip: delegationChip,
          };
        });

      res.status(200).json({ queue: items, total: items.length });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /approvals/delegations — Delegate approval authority (Step 11, B9)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
approvalsRouter.post(
  '/delegations',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('manage_delegations'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const { delegate_id, role, plan_id, valid_from, valid_to, valid_until } = req.body;

      if (!delegate_id) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: { code: 'MISSING_FIELD', message: 'delegate_id is required' } });
        return;
      }

      const delegation = await createDelegation({
        delegator_id: user._id,
        delegate_id,
        role: role || user.role,
        plan_id: plan_id || null,
        valid_from: valid_from || new Date(),
        valid_to: valid_to || valid_until,
      });

      res.status(201).json(delegation);
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e.statusCode) {
        res.status(e.statusCode).json({ error: { code: e.code || 'BAD_REQUEST', message: e.message } });
        return;
      }
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /approvals/delegations — List active delegations for caller (Step 11, B9)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
approvalsRouter.get(
  '/delegations',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('manage_delegations'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const delegations = await ApprovalDelegation.find({
        $or: [{ delegator_id: user._id }, { delegate_id: user._id }],
        is_active: true,
      })
        .populate('delegator_id', 'username display_name role')
        .populate('delegate_id', 'username display_name role')
        .lean();

      res.status(200).json(delegations);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DELETE /approvals/delegations/:id — Revoke active delegation (Step 11, B9)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
approvalsRouter.delete(
  '/delegations/:id',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('manage_delegations'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const delegation = await revokeDelegation(id, req.user!._id);
      res.status(200).json({ ok: true, delegation });
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e.statusCode) {
        res.status(e.statusCode).json({ error: { code: e.code || 'BAD_REQUEST', message: e.message } });
        return;
      }
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/cctv.ts
 *
 * CCTV video ingestion, synthesis, damage detection, linking, and hotspot analytics.
 * Enforces warehouse scoping for Warehouse_Operator on ingest and view.
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import path from 'node:path';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { CctvClip } from '../models/cctv-clips.js';
import { CctvEvent } from '../models/cctv-events.js';
import { EvidenceItem } from '../models/evidence-items.js';
import { SupplierClaim } from '../models/supplier-claims.js';
import { Shipment } from '../models/shipments.js';
import { Warehouse } from '../models/warehouses.js';
import { Sku } from '../models/skus.js';
import { reconcile } from '../services/reconciler.js';
import { writeLedgerEntry } from '../services/audit.js';
import { config } from '../config.js';

export const cctvRouter = Router();

async function matchesOperatorWarehouse(user: any, warehouseCodeOrId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (user.role !== 'Warehouse_Operator' || !user.warehouse_id) {
    return true;
  }
  const userWhStr = user.warehouse_id.toString();
  if (userWhStr === warehouseCodeOrId) return true;
  const whDoc = await Warehouse.findById(user.warehouse_id).lean();
  return whDoc ? whDoc.code === warehouseCodeOrId : false;
}

// Python helpers with FastAPI primary and CLI fallback
async function callVisionSynthesize(spec: Record<string, any>): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${config.VISION_URL}/synthesize`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(spec),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      return await res.json();
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to direct Python invocation
  }

  // CLI fallback
  const pyCode = `
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import json
from services.vision.synthesizer import synthesize_clip
spec = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
out = synthesize_clip(spec)
print(json.dumps(out))
`;
  const stdout = execFileSync('python', ['-c', pyCode, JSON.stringify(spec)], {
    encoding: 'utf-8',
    cwd: process.cwd(),
    env: { ...process.env, PYTHONPATH: '.' },
    maxBuffer: 50 * 1024 * 1024,
  });
  return JSON.parse(stdout.trim());
}

async function callVisionAnalyze(payload: {
  clip_path: string;
  parcel_to_shipment_map?: Record<string, string>;
  warehouse_id?: string;
  camera_id?: string;
  evidence_dir?: string;
  model_weights_path?: string;
}): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${config.VISION_URL}/analyze`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      return await res.json();
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to direct Python invocation
  }

  // CLI fallback
  const pyCode = `
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import json
from services.vision.analyzer import analyze_clip
p = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
out = analyze_clip(
    clip_path=p.get('clip_path'),
    parcel_to_shipment_map=p.get('parcel_to_shipment_map'),
    warehouse_id=p.get('warehouse_id', 'WH-HOS'),
    camera_id=p.get('camera_id', 'CAM-01'),
    evidence_dir=p.get('evidence_dir'),
    model_weights_path=p.get('model_weights_path')
)
print(json.dumps(out))
`;
  const stdout = execFileSync('python', ['-c', pyCode, JSON.stringify(payload)], {
    encoding: 'utf-8',
    cwd: process.cwd(),
    env: { ...process.env, PYTHONPATH: '.' },
    maxBuffer: 50 * 1024 * 1024,
  });
  return JSON.parse(stdout.trim());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /cctv/clips/synthesize — Synthesize clip and save metadata
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cctvRouter.post(
  '/clips/synthesize',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('cctv.ingest'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const warehouseId = req.body.warehouse_id || 'WH-HOS';

      // Warehouse scoping for operators
      if (user.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && user.warehouse_id) {
        const isMatch = await matchesOperatorWarehouse(user, warehouseId);
        if (!isMatch) {
          res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden', message: 'Cannot synthesize clip for another warehouse' });
          return;
        }
      }

      const spec = {
        warehouse_id: warehouseId,
        camera_id: req.body.camera_id || 'CAM-01',
        fps: req.body.fps || 15,
        seconds: req.body.seconds || 4,
        parcel_count: req.body.parcel_count || 2,
        injected_events: req.body.injected_events || [],
        seed: req.body.seed !== undefined ? req.body.seed : 42,
        clip_id: req.body.clip_id,
      };

      const synthRes = await callVisionSynthesize(spec);

      const clip = await CctvClip.findOneAndUpdate(
        { clip_id: synthRes.clip_id },
        {
          $set: {
            clip_id: synthRes.clip_id,
            warehouse_id: spec.warehouse_id,
            camera_id: spec.camera_id,
            synthetic_spec: spec,
            sha256: synthRes.sha256,
            frame_count: synthRes.frame_count,
            fps: synthRes.fps,
            created_at: new Date(),
          },
        },
        { upsert: true, new: true },
      );

      res.status(201).json({
        clip,
        synth_result: synthRes,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /cctv/clips/:id/analyze — Analyze clip, record events & apply damage rules
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cctvRouter.post(
  '/clips/:id/analyze',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('cctv.ingest'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const clipId = req.params.id;

      const clip = await CctvClip.findOne({ clip_id: clipId });
      if (!clip) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: `CCTV clip ${clipId} not found` });
        return;
      }

      if (user.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && user.warehouse_id) {
        const isMatch = await matchesOperatorWarehouse(user, clip.warehouse_id);
        if (!isMatch) {
          res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden', message: 'Cannot analyze clip from another warehouse' });
          return;
        }
      }

      // Resolve video path: synthetic clips are placed under .data/cctv/clips/
      const expectedPath = path.resolve('.data', 'cctv', 'clips', `${clip.clip_id}.mp4`);
      let clipPath = expectedPath;
      if (!fs.existsSync(clipPath)) {
        // Fallback: check body or search
        clipPath = req.body.clip_path || expectedPath;
      }

      const evidenceDir = path.resolve(config.CCTV_EVIDENCE_DIR);
      fs.mkdirSync(evidenceDir, { recursive: true });

      const modelWeightsPath = path.resolve('services', 'vision', 'models', 'best.pt');

      const analysis = await callVisionAnalyze({
        clip_path: clipPath,
        parcel_to_shipment_map: req.body.parcel_to_shipment_map || {},
        warehouse_id: clip.warehouse_id,
        camera_id: clip.camera_id,
        evidence_dir: evidenceDir,
        model_weights_path: modelWeightsPath,
      });

      const eventsCreated: any[] = [];
      const claimsCreated: any[] = [];

      // Find warehouse and default sku documents for ledger operations
      const warehouseDoc = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: clip.warehouse_id }).lean();
      const skuDoc = await Sku.findOne({}).lean();

      for (const ev of analysis.events || []) {
        // Save evidence item if provided
        if (ev.evidence_path && ev.evidence_sha256) {
          await EvidenceItem.findOneAndUpdate(
            { evidence_id: ev.event_id },
            {
              $setOnInsert: {
                evidence_id: ev.event_id,
                kind: 'FRAME_SNAPSHOT',
                path: ev.evidence_path,
                sha256: ev.evidence_sha256,
                created_at: new Date(),
              },
            },
            { upsert: true, new: true },
          );
        }

        const band = ev.band;
        const unitsDamaged = ev.units_damaged || (band === 'SEVERE' ? 20 : band === 'MAJOR' ? 10 : 0);

        // Upsert CCTV event
        const cctvEvt = await CctvEvent.findOneAndUpdate(
          { clip_id: clip.clip_id, track_id: ev.track_id },
          {
            $set: {
              event_id: ev.event_id,
              clip_id: clip.clip_id,
              track_id: ev.track_id,
              shipment_id: ev.shipment_id || null,
              warehouse_id: clip.warehouse_id,
              camera_id: clip.camera_id,
              band,
              damage_score: ev.damage_score,
              components: ev.components,
              units_damaged: unitsDamaged,
              frame_start: ev.frame_start,
              frame_end: ev.frame_end,
              evidence_ids: [ev.event_id],
              status: 'DETECTED',
            },
          },
          { upsert: true, new: true },
        );
        eventsCreated.push(cctvEvt);

        // Apply Damage-to-Delay rules
        if (band === 'NONE') {
          // Do nothing
          continue;
        }

        if (band === 'MINOR') {
          // Accept, store note, no delay
          continue;
        }

        if (band === 'MAJOR' || band === 'SEVERE') {
          const delayHours = band === 'SEVERE' ? 48 : 24;

          let shipmentDoc: any = null;
          if (ev.shipment_id) {
            shipmentDoc = await Shipment.findOne({ code: ev.shipment_id });
          }

          if (shipmentDoc) {
            const currentEta = shipmentDoc.resolved_eta || shipmentDoc.current_eta || shipmentDoc.promised_eta || new Date();
            const newEta = new Date(new Date(currentEta).getTime() + delayHours * 3600 * 1000);

            // Reconcile event through Step 7 Reconciler
            await reconcile({
              source: 'CCTV',
              external_event_id: ev.event_id,
              event_type: 'DAMAGE_REPORT',
              shipment_code: shipmentDoc.code,
              reported_eta: newEta,
              quantity_affected: unitsDamaged,
              raw_payload: {
                clip_id: clip.clip_id,
                track_id: ev.track_id,
                damage_score: ev.damage_score,
                band,
                components: ev.components,
              },
              correlation_id: `CCTV-CORR-${ev.event_id}`,
            });
          }

          // Open Supplier Claim in status OPEN
          const supplierId = shipmentDoc?.supplier_id || 'SUP-1';
          const claimId = `CLM-${ev.event_id}`;

          const claim = await SupplierClaim.findOneAndUpdate(
            { cctv_event_id: ev.event_id },
            {
              $setOnInsert: {
                claim_id: claimId,
                supplier_id: supplierId,
                shipment_id: ev.shipment_id || (shipmentDoc?.code ?? 'UNKNOWN'),
                cctv_event_id: ev.event_id,
                band,
                units: unitsDamaged > 0 ? unitsDamaged : 10,
                delay_hours: delayHours,
                status: 'OPEN',
                supplier_response: null,
                decided_by: null,
                linked_by: null,
                evidence_ids: [ev.event_id],
                version: 1,
                created_at: new Date(),
              },
            },
            { upsert: true, new: true },
          );
          claimsCreated.push(claim);

          // For SEVERE: Quarantine units through the ledger service without direct on_hand mutation
          if (band === 'SEVERE') {
            await writeLedgerEntry({
              stepType: 'QUARANTINE',
              warehouseId: warehouseDoc?._id || null,
              skuId: skuDoc?._id || null,
              deltaOnHand: 0, // Never edit on_hand directly!
              beforeState: { quarantined_units: 0 },
              afterState: {
                quarantined_units: unitsDamaged > 0 ? unitsDamaged : 20,
                event_id: ev.event_id,
                band: 'SEVERE',
                reason: 'CCTV SEVERE damage detected: quarantine structural crush',
              },
              actor: user._id,
            });
          }
        }
      }

      res.json({
        clip_id: clip.clip_id,
        analysis,
        events: eventsCreated,
        claims: claimsCreated,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /cctv/events — List damage events with filters & warehouse scoping
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cctvRouter.get(
  '/events',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('cctv.view'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const filter: Record<string, any> = {};

      if (user.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && user.warehouse_id) {
        const whDoc = await Warehouse.findById(user.warehouse_id).lean();
        filter.warehouse_id = whDoc ? whDoc.code : user.warehouse_id.toString();
      } else if (req.query.warehouse_id) {
        filter.warehouse_id = req.query.warehouse_id;
      }

      if (req.query.clip_id) filter.clip_id = req.query.clip_id;
      if (req.query.shipment_id) filter.shipment_id = req.query.shipment_id;
      if (req.query.band) filter.band = req.query.band;
      if (req.query.status) filter.status = req.query.status;

      const events = await CctvEvent.find(filter).sort({ created_at: -1 }).lean();
      res.json(events);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /cctv/events/:id/link — Warehouse operator confirms event & binds shipment
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cctvRouter.post(
  '/events/:id/link',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('cctv.ingest'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const eventId = req.params.id;

      const event = await CctvEvent.findOne({ event_id: eventId });
      if (!event) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: `CCTV event ${eventId} not found` });
        return;
      }

      if (user.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && user.warehouse_id) {
        const isMatch = await matchesOperatorWarehouse(user, event.warehouse_id);
        if (!isMatch) {
          res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden', message: 'Cannot link event from another warehouse' });
          return;
        }
      }

      const shipmentId = req.body.shipment_id || event.shipment_id;
      event.status = 'LINKED';
      if (shipmentId) {
        event.shipment_id = shipmentId;
      }
      event.linked_by = user.username || user._id.toString();
      event.linked_at = new Date();
      await event.save();

      // Propagate linking operator to any associated supplier claim to enforce separation of duties
      await SupplierClaim.updateMany(
        { cctv_event_id: event.event_id },
        {
          $set: {
            linked_by: event.linked_by,
            ...(shipmentId ? { shipment_id: shipmentId } : {}),
          },
        },
      );

      res.json(event);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /cctv/hotspots — Aggregate damage counts by camera, warehouse & band
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cctvRouter.get(
  '/hotspots',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('cctv.view'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const match: Record<string, any> = {};

      if (user.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && user.warehouse_id) {
        const whDoc = await Warehouse.findById(user.warehouse_id).lean();
        match.warehouse_id = whDoc ? whDoc.code : user.warehouse_id.toString();
      } else if (req.query.warehouse_id) {
        match.warehouse_id = req.query.warehouse_id;
      }

      const hotspots = await CctvEvent.aggregate([
        { $match: match },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: {
              camera_id: '$camera_id',
              warehouse_id: '$warehouse_id',
              band: '$band',
            },
            count: { $sum: 1 },
            total_damage_score: { $sum: '$damage_score' },
            total_units_damaged: { $sum: '$units_damaged' },
          },
        },
        { $sort: { count: -1, total_damage_score: -1 } },
        {
          $project: {
            _id: 0,
            camera_id: '$_id.camera_id',
            warehouse_id: '$_id.warehouse_id',
            band: '$_id.band',
            count: 1,
            total_damage_score: 1,
            total_units_damaged: 1,
          },
        },
      ]);

      res.json(hotspots);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /cctv/clips — List CCTV clips
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cctvRouter.get(
  '/clips',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('cctv.view'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const filter: Record<string, any> = {};

      if (user.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && user.warehouse_id) {
        const whDoc = await Warehouse.findById(user.warehouse_id).lean();
        filter.warehouse_id = whDoc ? whDoc.code : user.warehouse_id.toString();
      } else if (req.query.warehouse_id) {
        filter.warehouse_id = req.query.warehouse_id;
      }

      const clips = await CctvClip.find(filter).sort({ created_at: -1 }).lean();
      res.json(clips);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/conflicts.ts
 *
 * Allocation Conflict Court endpoints (Step 9, A4).
 *   GET  /conflicts/allocation
 *   GET  /conflicts/allocation/:id
 *   POST /conflicts/allocation/:id/resolve (Manager only)
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { AllocationConflict } from '../models/allocation-conflicts.js';
import { AllocationClaim } from '../models/allocation-claims.js';
import { RecoveryPlan } from '../models/recovery-plans.js';
import { releaseStock } from '../services/reservations.js';
import { writeAudit } from '../services/audit.js';
import { simClock } from '../services/simClock.js';

export const conflictsRouter = Router();

function err(res: Response, status: number, code: string, message: string): void {
  res.status(status).json({ error: { code, message } });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /conflicts/allocation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
conflictsRouter.get(
  '/allocation',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('view_disruptions'),
  async (_req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const conflicts = await AllocationConflict.find({})
        .populate('sku_id', 'code name')
        .populate('warehouse_id', 'code name')
        .sort({ created_at: -1 })
        .lean();

      const items = await Promise.all(
        conflicts.map(async (c) => {
          const claims = await AllocationClaim.find({ conflict_id: c._id })
            .populate('plan_id', 'version status strategy total_cost')
            .lean();
          return { ...c, claims };
        }),
      );

      res.status(200).json({ conflicts: items, count: items.length });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /conflicts/allocation/:id
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
conflictsRouter.get(
  '/allocation/:id',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('view_disruptions'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(id)) {
        err(res, 400, 'BAD_ID', 'Invalid conflict id'); return;
      }

      const conflict = await AllocationConflict.findById(id)
        .populate('sku_id', 'code name')
        .populate('warehouse_id', 'code name')
        .lean();
      if (!conflict) { err(res, 404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Conflict case not found'); return; }

      const claims = await AllocationClaim.find({ conflict_id: conflict._id })
        .populate('plan_id', 'version status strategy total_cost')
        .lean();

      res.status(200).json({ conflict, claims });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /conflicts/allocation/:id/resolve (Manager only)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
conflictsRouter.post(
  '/allocation/:id/resolve',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('resolve_allocation_conflict'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(id)) {
        err(res, 400, 'BAD_ID', 'Invalid conflict id'); return;
      }

      const conflict = await AllocationConflict.findById(id);
      if (!conflict) { err(res, 404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Conflict case not found'); return; }

      const { winner_plan_id, reason } = req.body as { winner_plan_id?: string; reason?: string };
      if (!winner_plan_id || !reason) {
        err(res, 400, 'MISSING_FIELDS', 'winner_plan_id and reason are required to resolve allocation conflict');
        return;
      }

      const claims = await AllocationClaim.find({ conflict_id: conflict._id });
      const now = await simClock.now();

      // Find loser plans
      for (const claim of claims) {
        const claimPlanId = claim.plan_id.toString();
        if (claimPlanId === winner_plan_id) {
          claim.granted_qty = claim.requested_qty;
          await claim.save();
        } else {
          claim.granted_qty = 0;
          await claim.save();

          // Loser plan becomes BLOCKED and its reservations are released
          const loserPlan = await RecoveryPlan.findById(claim.plan_id);
          if (loserPlan) {
            loserPlan.status = 'BLOCKED';
            loserPlan.narrative = `${loserPlan.narrative} [BLOCKED by Allocation Conflict Court: ${reason}]`;
            await loserPlan.save();
            await releaseStock(loserPlan._id);
          }
        }
      }

      conflict.status = 'RESOLVED';
      conflict.resolved_at = now;
      await conflict.save();

      await writeAudit({
        action: 'ALLOCATION_CONFLICT_RESOLVED',
        actor: req.user!._id,
        entityType: 'AllocationConflict',
        entityId: conflict._id.toString(),
        after: { winner_plan_id, reason, resolved_at: now },
      });

      res.status(200).json({
        conflict_id: conflict._id,
        status: 'RESOLVED',
        winner_plan_id,
        reason,
        message: 'Allocation conflict resolved. Winner proceeds; loser blocked and reservations released.',
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/events.ts
 *
 * Routes for shipment event conflict management:
 *  - GET  /events/conflicts           — list CONFLICT events (requirePermission: confirm_events)
 *  - POST /events/conflicts/:id/resolve — resolve a conflict (requirePermission: confirm_events)
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { ShipmentEvent } from '../models/shipment-events.js';
import { Shipment } from '../models/shipments.js';
import { Warehouse } from '../models/warehouses.js';
import { FieldReport } from '../models/field-reports.js';
import { writeAudit } from '../services/audit.js';
import { domainBus } from '../services/bus.js';
import { withTransaction } from '../db/withTransaction.js';
import { reconcile, IncomingEvent } from '../services/reconciler.js';
import { simClock } from '../services/simClock.js';

export const eventsRouter = Router();

/**
 * POST /events
 * Human confirmation of an event card (possibly edited).
 * Passes event to reconciler with source FIELD_REPORT or EMAIL_TEXT.
 * Enforces warehouse operator scoping (Operator cannot confirm for another warehouse -> 403).
 */
eventsRouter.post(
  '/',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('confirm_events'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const {
      field_report_id,
      shipment_code,
      warehouse_code,
      event_type = 'DAMAGE_REPORT',
      damaged_units,
      delay_hours,
      reported_eta,
    } = req.body as {
      field_report_id?: string;
      shipment_code?: string;
      warehouse_code?: string;
      event_type?: string;
      damaged_units?: number | null;
      delay_hours?: number | null;
      reported_eta?: string;
    };

    if (!shipment_code) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'shipment_code is required' });
      return;
    }

    const shipment = await Shipment.findOne({ code: shipment_code });

    // Warehouse scoping check for Warehouse_Operator
    if (req.user?.role === 'Warehouse_Operator') {
      let targetWhId = shipment?.warehouse_id;
      if (!targetWhId && warehouse_code) {
        const wh = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: warehouse_code }).lean();
        if (wh) targetWhId = wh._id;
      }
      if (targetWhId && String(req.user.warehouse_id) !== String(targetWhId)) {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: 'Forbidden',
          message: 'Warehouse Operator cannot confirm events for another warehouse',
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    let fieldReport: any = null;
    if (field_report_id && mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(field_report_id)) {
      fieldReport = await FieldReport.findById(field_report_id);
    }

    const source = fieldReport?.channel === 'VOICE' ? 'FIELD_REPORT' : 'EMAIL_TEXT';
    const extId = field_report_id ? `FR-${field_report_id}` : `EVT-CONFIRM-${Date.now()}`;
    const now = await simClock.now();

    // Compute reported ETA
    let finalEta: Date | undefined;
    if (reported_eta) {
      finalEta = new Date(reported_eta);
    } else if (delay_hours && delay_hours > 0 && shipment) {
      const baseEta = shipment.resolved_eta || shipment.current_eta;
      finalEta = new Date(baseEta.getTime() + delay_hours * 3_600_000);
    }

    // If damage reported, adjust shipment usable_quantity and mark disrupted
    if (shipment && damaged_units && damaged_units > 0) {
      const usable = Math.max(0, shipment.total_units - damaged_units);
      await Shipment.updateOne(
        { _id: shipment._id },
        {
          $set: {
            usable_quantity: usable,
            is_disrupted: true,
          },
        },
      );
    }

    const incoming: IncomingEvent = {
      source,
      external_event_id: extId,
      event_type,
      shipment_code,
      reported_eta: finalEta,
      event_time: now,
      quantity_affected: damaged_units ?? undefined,
      raw_payload: req.body as Record<string, unknown>,
      correlation_id: `confirm-${extId}`,
    };

    const reconcileResult = await withTransaction((session) => reconcile(incoming, session));

    if (fieldReport) {
      fieldReport.status = 'CONFIRMED';
      if (reconcileResult.eventId) {
        fieldReport.event_id = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(reconcileResult.eventId);
      }
      if (shipment) {
        fieldReport.shipment_id = shipment._id;
      }
      await fieldReport.save();
    }

    res.status(200).json({
      status: reconcileResult.status,
      eventId: reconcileResult.eventId,
      reason: reconcileResult.reason,
      shipment_code,
      reconcile: reconcileResult,
    });
  },
);

/**
 * GET /events/conflicts
 * Returns all shipment events with reconcile_status = 'CONFLICT'.
 */
eventsRouter.get(
  '/conflicts',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('confirm_events'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const conflicts = await ShipmentEvent.find({ reconcile_status: 'CONFLICT' })
      .populate('shipment_id', 'code status resolved_eta review_status')
      .sort({ ingested_at: -1 })
      .lean();

    res.status(200).json({ conflicts });
  },
);

/**
 * POST /events/conflicts/:id/resolve
 * Body: { chosen_event_id: string, reason: string }
 * Resolves a conflict by applying the chosen event's ETA to the shipment.
 */
eventsRouter.post(
  '/conflicts/:id/resolve',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('confirm_events'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { chosen_event_id, reason } = req.body as {
      chosen_event_id?: string;
      reason?: string;
    };

    if (!chosen_event_id || !reason || reason.trim().length === 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'chosen_event_id and reason are required' });
      return;
    }

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(id) || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(chosen_event_id)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Invalid id or chosen_event_id' });
      return;
    }

    const result = await withTransaction(async (session) => {
      const conflictEvent = await ShipmentEvent.findOne(
        { _id: id, reconcile_status: 'CONFLICT' },
        null,
        { session },
      );
      if (!conflictEvent) {
        return { notFound: true };
      }

      const chosenEvent = await ShipmentEvent.findOne(
        { _id: chosen_event_id },
        null,
        { session },
      );
      if (!chosenEvent) {
        return { chosenNotFound: true };
      }

      const shipment = await Shipment.findOne(
        { _id: conflictEvent.shipment_id },
        null,
        { session },
      );
      if (!shipment) {
        return { shipmentNotFound: true };
      }

      const oldEta = shipment.resolved_eta;

      // Apply the chosen event's ETA
      await Shipment.updateOne(
        { _id: shipment._id },
        {
          $set: {
            resolved_eta: chosenEvent.reported_eta,
            eta_basis_event_id: chosenEvent._id,
            review_status: 'NORMAL',
          },
        },
        { session },
      );

      // Mark the conflict event as APPLIED
      await ShipmentEvent.updateOne(
        { _id: conflictEvent._id },
        { $set: { reconcile_status: 'APPLIED', reconcile_reason: `Manually resolved: ${reason}` } },
        { session },
      );

      await writeAudit(
        {
          actor: req.user!._id,
          action: 'CONFLICT_RESOLVED',
          entityType: 'SHIPMENT',
          entityId: shipment._id.toString(),
          before: { resolved_eta: oldEta, review_status: shipment.review_status },
          after: { resolved_eta: chosenEvent.reported_eta, review_status: 'NORMAL', chosen_event_id, reason },
          correlationId: `conflict-resolve-${id}`,
          stepType: 'ETA_APPLIED',
        },
        session,
      );

      return { shipment, chosenEvent, oldEta };
    });

    if (!result || 'notFound' in result) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: 'Conflict event not found' });
      return;
    }
    if ('chosenNotFound' in result) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: 'Chosen event not found' });
      return;
    }
    if ('shipmentNotFound' in result) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: 'Associated shipment not found' });
      return;
    }

    const { shipment, chosenEvent } = result as {
      shipment: InstanceType<typeof Shipment>;
      chosenEvent: InstanceType<typeof ShipmentEvent>;
      oldEta: Date | null;
    };

    // Publish event outside transaction
    await domainBus.publish('EVENT_APPLIED', {
      eventId: chosenEvent._id.toString(),
      shipmentId: shipment._id.toString(),
      shipmentCode: shipment.code,
      eventType: chosenEvent.event_type,
      source: chosenEvent.source,
      correlationId: `conflict-resolve-${id}`,
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      status: 'RESOLVED',
      shipment_code: shipment.code,
      resolved_eta: chosenEvent.reported_eta,
      review_status: 'NORMAL',
    });
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/guardrails.ts
 *
 * Guardrail policies and checks management (Step 9, A9).
 *   GET  /guardrails
 *   PUT  /guardrails/:id (Manager, Administrator)
 *   GET  /plans/:id/guardrails
 *   POST /guardrails/:id/clear-escalation (Manager, Procurement_Approver)
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission, requireAnyPermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { GuardrailPolicy } from '../models/guardrail-policies.js';
import { GuardrailCheck } from '../models/guardrail-checks.js';
import { RecoveryPlan } from '../models/recovery-plans.js';
import { writeAudit } from '../services/audit.js';
import { runGuardrailChecks } from '../services/guardrails.js';

export const guardrailsRouter = Router();

function err(res: Response, status: number, code: string, message: string): void {
  res.status(status).json({ error: { code, message } });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /guardrails
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
guardrailsRouter.get(
  '/',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('view_disruptions'),
  async (_req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const policies = await GuardrailPolicy.find({}).sort({ code: 1 }).lean();
      res.status(200).json({ policies });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PUT /guardrails/:id (Manager, Administrator)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
guardrailsRouter.put(
  '/:id',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('set_guardrails'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { threshold_value, is_active } = req.body;

      const query = mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(id) ? { _id: id } : { code: id };
      const policy = await GuardrailPolicy.findOne(query);
      if (!policy) { err(res, 404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Guardrail policy not found'); return; }

      const before = { threshold_value: policy.threshold_value, is_active: policy.is_active };

      if (threshold_value !== undefined) policy.threshold_value = Number(threshold_value);
      if (is_active !== undefined) policy.is_active = Boolean(is_active);

      await policy.save();

      await writeAudit({
        action: 'GUARDRAIL_POLICY_UPDATED',
        actor: req.user!._id,
        entityType: 'GuardrailPolicy',
        entityId: policy._id.toString(),
        before,
        after: { threshold_value: policy.threshold_value, is_active: policy.is_active },
      });

      res.status(200).json({ policy });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /guardrails/:id/clear-escalation (Manager, Procurement_Approver)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
guardrailsRouter.post(
  '/:id/clear-escalation',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('clear_guardrail_escalation'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params;

      // Administrator can NEVER clear an escalation
      if (req.user!.role === 'Administrator') {
        err(res, 403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Administrator cannot clear guardrail escalations');
        return;
      }

      const check = await GuardrailCheck.findById(id);
      if (!check) { err(res, 404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Guardrail check not found'); return; }

      check.passed = true;
      check.details = `${check.details} [ESCALATION_CLEARED by ${req.user!.username}]`;
      await check.save();

      const plan = await RecoveryPlan.findById(check.plan_id);
      if (plan) {
        // Re-evaluate checks
        const remainingBreaches = await GuardrailCheck.countDocuments({
          plan_id: plan._id,
          plan_version: plan.version,
          passed: false,
        });

        if (remainingBreaches === 0) {
          (plan as any).guardrail_status = 'NORMAL';
          if (plan.decision_contract) {
            plan.decision_contract.escalation_approvals_required = false;
          }
          await plan.save();
        }
      }

      await writeAudit({
        action: 'GUARDRAIL_ESCALATION_CLEARED',
        actor: req.user!._id,
        entityType: 'GuardrailCheck',
        entityId: check._id.toString(),
        after: { cleared_by: req.user!.username, role: req.user!.role },
      });

      res.status(200).json({
        check_id: check._id,
        status: 'CLEARED',
        message: 'Guardrail escalation cleared successfully.',
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/masterdata.ts
 *
 * Master Data CRUD (Step 11 Part B, B10) & Governed Inventory Corrections.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 *   GET    /admin/master/:entity       (Administrator only)
 *   POST   /admin/master/:entity      (Administrator only)
 *   PATCH  /admin/master/:entity/:id  (Administrator only)
 *   DELETE /admin/master/:entity/:id  (Administrator only - soft deactivates, never hard deletes)
 *   POST   /inventory/corrections     (Manager, Administrator)
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { Supplier } from '../models/suppliers.js';
import { Warehouse } from '../models/warehouses.js';
import { Sku } from '../models/skus.js';
import { TransferLane } from '../models/transfer-lanes.js';
import { SupplierSku } from '../models/supplier-skus.js';
import { Order } from '../models/orders.js';
import { InventoryBalance } from '../models/inventory-balances.js';
import { RecoveryPlan } from '../models/recovery-plans.js';
import { verifyPlan } from '../services/proofChecker.js';
import { applyInventoryCorrection } from '../services/inventoryCorrection.js';
import { writeAudit } from '../services/audit.js';
import { publish } from '../services/bus.js';

export const masterDataRouter = Router();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Entity mapping and schemas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const ENTITY_MODELS: Record<string, mongoose.Model<any>> = {
  suppliers: Supplier,
  warehouses: Warehouse,
  skus: Sku,
  lanes: TransferLane,
  supplier_capacity: SupplierSku,
  'supplier-capacity': SupplierSku,
  orders: Order,
};

const SupplierSchema = z.object({
  code: z.string().min(1),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  risk_score: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional().default(0),
  lead_time_hours: z.number().min(0).optional().default(24),
  map_x: z.number().min(0).max(1000).optional().default(100),
  map_y: z.number().min(0).max(1000).optional().default(100),
  on_time_rate: z.number().min(0).max(1).nullable().optional(),
  quality_score: z.number().min(0).max(1).nullable().optional(),
  is_active: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
});

const WarehouseSchema = z.object({
  code: z.string().min(1),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  map_x: z.number().min(0).max(1000).optional().default(100),
  map_y: z.number().min(0).max(1000).optional().default(100),
  processing_hours: z.number().min(0).optional().default(2),
  is_hub: z.boolean().optional().default(false),
  is_active: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
});

const SkuSchema = z.object({
  code: z.string().min(1),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  unit_cost: z.number().min(0),
  weight_kg: z.number().min(0).optional().default(1),
  category: z.string().min(1).optional().default('General'),
  is_critical: z.boolean().optional().default(false),
  is_active: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
});

const LaneSchema = z.object({
  from_warehouse_id: z.string().min(1),
  to_warehouse_id: z.string().min(1),
  transit_hours: z.number().min(0),
  cost_per_unit: z.number().min(0),
  distance_km: z.number().min(0),
  is_active: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
});

const SupplierCapacitySchema = z.object({
  supplier_id: z.string().min(1),
  sku_id: z.string().min(1),
  warehouse_id: z.string().min(1),
  capacity_per_shipment: z.number().min(0),
  lead_time_hours: z.number().min(0),
  unit_cost: z.number().min(0),
  is_qualified: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
});

const OrderSchema = z.object({
  code: z.string().min(1),
  customer_name: z.string().min(1),
  destination_hub: z.string().min(1),
  priority: z.enum(['CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'STANDARD']),
  sla_deadline: z.string().or(z.date()),
  penalty_hourly: z.number().min(0),
  status: z.enum(['CONFIRMED', 'FULFILLED', 'CANCELLED', 'BACKORDERED']).optional().default('CONFIRMED'),
});

function getSchemaForEntity(entity: string): z.ZodSchema<any> | null {
  switch (entity) {
    case 'suppliers': return SupplierSchema;
    case 'warehouses': return WarehouseSchema;
    case 'skus': return SkuSchema;
    case 'lanes': return LaneSchema;
    case 'supplier_capacity':
    case 'supplier-capacity': return SupplierCapacitySchema;
    case 'orders': return OrderSchema;
    default: return null;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /admin/master/:entity — List master data items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
masterDataRouter.get(
  '/master/:entity',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('master_data_crud'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { entity } = req.params;
      const Model = ENTITY_MODELS[entity];
      if (!Model) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'UNKNOWN_ENTITY', message: `Master data entity ${entity} not found` } });
        return;
      }

      const includeInactive = req.query.include_inactive === 'true';
      const query: any = {};
      if (!includeInactive && Model.schema.path('is_active')) {
        query.is_active = { $ne: false };
      }

      const items = await Model.find(query).lean();
      res.status(200).json(items);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /admin/master/:entity — Create master data item
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
masterDataRouter.post(
  '/master/:entity',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('master_data_crud'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { entity } = req.params;

      // Reject direct on_hand edits
      if (req.body && (req.body.on_hand !== undefined || req.body.onHand !== undefined)) {
        res.status(400).json({
          error: {
            code: 'DIRECT_ON_HAND_EDIT_PROHIBITED',
            message: 'Editing on_hand directly is prohibited. Use /inventory/corrections.',
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      const Model = ENTITY_MODELS[entity];
      if (!Model) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'UNKNOWN_ENTITY', message: `Master data entity ${entity} not found` } });
        return;
      }

      const schema = getSchemaForEntity(entity);
      if (schema) {
        const parsed = schema.safeParse(req.body);
        if (!parsed.success) {
          res.status(400).json({ error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: parsed.error.message, details: parsed.error.issues } });
          return;
        }
      }

      const doc = await Model.create(req.body);

      await writeAudit({
        actor: req.user!._id,
        action: 'MASTER_DATA_CREATED',
        entityType: entity,
        entityId: doc._id.toString(),
        after: doc.toObject ? doc.toObject() : doc,
      });

      res.status(201).json(doc);
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e.code === 11000) {
        res.status(409).json({ error: { code: 'DUPLICATE_KEY', message: 'Item with unique identifier already exists' } });
        return;
      }
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PATCH /admin/master/:entity/:id — Update master data item
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
masterDataRouter.patch(
  '/master/:entity/:id',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('master_data_crud'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { entity, id } = req.params;

      // Reject direct on_hand edits
      if (req.body && (req.body.on_hand !== undefined || req.body.onHand !== undefined)) {
        res.status(400).json({
          error: {
            code: 'DIRECT_ON_HAND_EDIT_PROHIBITED',
            message: 'Editing on_hand directly is prohibited. Use /inventory/corrections.',
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      const Model = ENTITY_MODELS[entity];
      if (!Model) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'UNKNOWN_ENTITY', message: `Master data entity ${entity} not found` } });
        return;
      }

      const before = await Model.findById(id).lean();
      if (!before) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Item not found' } });
        return;
      }

      const updated = await Model.findByIdAndUpdate(id, { $set: req.body }, { new: true }).lean();

      await writeAudit({
        actor: req.user!._id,
        action: 'MASTER_DATA_UPDATED',
        entityType: entity,
        entityId: id,
        before,
        after: updated,
      });

      res.status(200).json(updated);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DELETE /admin/master/:entity/:id — Soft-delete / deactivate (never hard delete)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
masterDataRouter.delete(
  '/master/:entity/:id',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('master_data_crud'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { entity, id } = req.params;

      const Model = ENTITY_MODELS[entity];
      if (!Model) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'UNKNOWN_ENTITY', message: `Master data entity ${entity} not found` } });
        return;
      }

      const doc = await Model.findById(id);
      if (!doc) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Item not found' } });
        return;
      }

      // Soft deactivate
      doc.is_active = false;
      await doc.save();

      await writeAudit({
        actor: req.user!._id,
        action: 'MASTER_DATA_DEACTIVATED',
        entityType: entity,
        entityId: id,
        after: { is_active: false },
      });

      res.status(200).json({ ok: true, deactivated: true, entity, id });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// POST /inventory/corrections (Manager, Administrator) — Step 11 Part B
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
masterDataRouter.post(
  '/inventory/corrections',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('inventory_correction'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const { warehouse_id, sku_id, new_on_hand, reason } = req.body;

      if (!warehouse_id || !sku_id || new_on_hand === undefined) {
        res.status(400).json({
          error: { code: 'MISSING_FIELDS', message: 'warehouse_id, sku_id, and new_on_hand are required' },
        });
        return;
      }

      if (typeof new_on_hand !== 'number' || new_on_hand < 0) {
        res.status(400).json({
          error: { code: 'INVALID_QUANTITY', message: 'new_on_hand must be a non-negative number' },
        });
        return;
      }

      const warehouseObjectId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(warehouse_id);
      const skuObjectId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(sku_id);

      const balance = await InventoryBalance.findOne({
        warehouse_id: warehouseObjectId,
        sku_id: skuObjectId,
      });

      // Check if touches stock reserved by an open plan -> return 409
      if (balance && new_on_hand < balance.reserved) {
        res.status(409).json({
          error: {
            code: 'STOCK_RESERVED_BY_OPEN_PLAN',
            message: `Cannot reduce on_hand to ${new_on_hand} because ${balance.reserved} units are reserved by open plans`,
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      // Governed ledger correction
      const result = await applyInventoryCorrection({
        warehouseId: warehouseObjectId,
        skuId: skuObjectId,
        newOnHand: new_on_hand,
        reason: reason || 'Inventory cycle count correction',
        actor: req.user!._id,
      });

      // Re-verify any open plans that might be affected by this SKU/warehouse
      const openPlans = await RecoveryPlan.find({
        status: { $in: ['DRAFT', 'VERIFIED', 'PENDING_APPROVAL'] },
      });

      for (const plan of openPlans) {
        const verifyRes = await verifyPlan(plan._id);
        if (verifyRes.status === 'BLOCKED') {
          plan.status = 'BLOCKED';
          await plan.save();
        }
      }

      // Emit INVENTORY_CORRECTED domain bus event
      await publish('INVENTORY_CORRECTED', {
        warehouseId: warehouse_id,
        skuId: sku_id,
        newOnHand: new_on_hand,
        actor: req.user!._id.toString(),
      });

      res.status(200).json({
        ok: true,
        correction: result,
        message: 'Inventory balance adjusted through governed ledger',
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e.statusCode) {
        res.status(e.statusCode).json({ error: { code: e.code || 'CORRECTION_FAILED', message: e.message } });
        return;
      }
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/overview.ts
 *
 * Recovery progress and cockpit overview data (Step 9 Part A #5).
 * GET /overview
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { Disruption } from '../models/disruptions.js';
import { RecoveryPlan } from '../models/recovery-plans.js';
import { Order } from '../models/orders.js';

export const overviewRouter = Router();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /overview
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
overviewRouter.get(
  '/',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('view_cockpit'),
  async (_req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const disruptions = await Disruption.find({}).sort({ detected_at: -1 }).lean();

      const progress = await Promise.all(
        disruptions.map(async (d) => {
          const plans = await RecoveryPlan.find({ disruption_id: d._id }).lean();
          const approvedCount = plans.filter((p) => p.status === 'APPROVED').length;
          const executedCount = plans.filter((p) => p.status === 'EXECUTED').length;
          const rolledBackCount = plans.filter((p) => p.status === 'ROLLED_BACK').length;

          // Orders recovered under executed plans
          const executedPlanIds = plans.filter((p) => p.status === 'EXECUTED').map((p) => p._id);
          const recoveredOrders = await Order.countDocuments({
            recovery_plan_id: { $in: executedPlanIds },
            status: { $in: ['FULFILLED', 'RECOVERING'] },
          });

          return {
            disruption_id: d._id,
            disruption_type: d.disruption_type,
            severity: d.severity,
            status: d.status,
            total_plans: plans.length,
            approved_count: approvedCount,
            executed_count: executedCount,
            rolled_back_count: rolledBackCount,
            orders_recovered: recoveredOrders,
          };
        }),
      );

      res.status(200).json({
        total_disruptions: disruptions.length,
        disruptions: progress,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/zones.ts
 *
 * Warehouse Zone Capacity Mapper, Stock Assignments, Inbound Slot Plans & Capacity Overview.
 */

import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import mongoose from 'mongoose';
import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { Zone } from '../models/zones.js';
import { ZoneStockAssignment } from '../models/zone-stock-assignments.js';
import { InboundSlotPlan } from '../models/inbound-slot-plans.js';
import { Warehouse } from '../models/warehouses.js';
import { Sku } from '../models/skus.js';
import { Shipment } from '../models/shipments.js';
import { ShipmentLine } from '../models/shipment-lines.js';
import { InventoryBalance } from '../models/inventory-balances.js';
import { writeAudit } from '../services/audit.js';
import { broadcastToTopic } from '../services/websocket.js';
import {
  computeZoneOccupancy,
  getZoneColour,
  validateZonePolygon,
  syncZoneOverCapacityAlert,
} from '../services/capacityService.js';

async function resolveWarehouseCode(raw?: any): Promise<string | undefined> {
  if (!raw) return undefined;
  const str = String(raw);
  if (mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(str)) {
    const wh = await Warehouse.findById(str).lean();
    if (wh?.code) return wh.code;
  }
  return str;
}

export const zonesRouter = Router();

// ── Warehouse site footprints (real-world [lat, lng] polygons) ───────────────
function validateFootprint(points: any): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
  if (!Array.isArray(points) || points.length < 3) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Footprint needs at least 3 corner points' };
  }
  if (points.length > 200) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Footprint cannot have more than 200 points' };
  }
  for (const p of points) {
    if (!Array.isArray(p) || p.length !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(p[0]) || !Number.isFinite(p[1])) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Each point must be [lat, lng]' };
    }
    if (p[0] < -90 || p[0] > 90 || p[1] < -180 || p[1] > 180) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Point [${p[0]}, ${p[1]}] is not a valid lat/lng` };
    }
  }
  return { valid: true };
}

zonesRouter.get(

      res.json({
        warehouses: whs.map((w: any) => ({
          code: w.code,
          name: w.name,
          lat: w.lat ?? null,
          lng: w.lng ?? null,
          footprint: w.footprint ?? null,
          footprint_updated_at: w.footprint_updated_at ?? null,
        })),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// PUT /capacity/footprint/:code  { polygon: [[lat,lng], ...] }
zonesRouter.put(
  '/footprint/:code',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('zone.edit'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const code = req.params.code;
      const polygon = req.body?.polygon;
      const check = validateFootprint(polygon);
      if (!check.valid) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: check.error });
        return;
      }

      const before: any = await Warehouse.findOne({ code }).lean();
      if (!before) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: `Warehouse ${code} not found` });
        return;
      }

      await Warehouse.updateOne(
        { code },
        { $set: { footprint: polygon, footprint_updated_at: new Date() } },
      );

      try {
        await writeAudit({
          action: 'WAREHOUSE_FOOTPRINT_SET',
          actor: (req.user as any)?._id || (req.user as any)?.id || (req.user as any)?.sub,
          entityType: 'Warehouse',
          entityId: code,
          before: { footprint: before.footprint ?? null },
          after: { footprint: polygon },
        } as any);
      } catch {
        // audit failure must not block the save
      }

      await broadcastToTopic('zones', { type: 'WAREHOUSE_FOOTPRINT_UPDATED', warehouse_id: code });
      res.json({ ok: true, code, footprint: polygon });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// DELETE /capacity/footprint/:code
zonesRouter.delete(

  requirePermission('zone.edit'),

    try {
      const code = req.params.code;
      const r = await Warehouse.updateOne(
        { code },
        { $set: { footprint: null, footprint_updated_at: new Date() } },
      );
      if (r.matchedCount === 0) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: `Warehouse ${code} not found` });
        return;
      }
      await broadcastToTopic('zones', { type: 'WAREHOUSE_FOOTPRINT_UPDATED', warehouse_id: code });
      res.json({ ok: true, code, footprint: null });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

// ── 1. GET /zones ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
zonesRouter.get(
  '/',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('capacity.view'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const filter: Record<string, any> = { is_active: { $ne: false } };
      if (req.query.warehouse_id) {
        filter.warehouse_id = await resolveWarehouseCode(req.query.warehouse_id);
      }

      const rawZones = await Zone.find(filter).lean();
      const detailedZones = await Promise.all(
        rawZones.map(async (z) => {
          try {
            return await computeZoneOccupancy(z.zone_id);
          } catch {
            return z;
          }
        }),
      );

      res.json(detailedZones);
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);

);

// ── 2. GET /capacity/overview ───────────────────────────────────────────────
zonesRouter.get(
  '/overview',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('capacity.view'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const rawWhId = (req.query.warehouse_id as string) || 'WH-HOS';
      const warehouseId = (await resolveWarehouseCode(rawWhId)) || 'WH-HOS';
      const zones = await Zone.find({
        warehouse_id: warehouseId,
        is_active: { $ne: false },
      }).lean();

      const detailedZones = await Promise.all(
        zones.map(async (z) => {
          return await computeZoneOccupancy(z.zone_id);
        }),
      );

      const totalCapacity = detailedZones.reduce((sum, z) => sum + z.capacity_slots, 0);
      const totalOccupied = detailedZones.reduce((sum, z) => sum + z.occupied_slots, 0);
      const totalReserved = detailedZones.reduce((sum, z) => sum + z.reserved_inbound_slots, 0);
      const overallMetrics = getZoneColour(totalCapacity, totalOccupied, totalReserved);

      // RED zones listed first
      const sortedZones = [...detailedZones].sort((a, b) => {
        const order: Record<string, number> = { RED: 0, AMBER: 1, GREEN: 2 };
        return (order[a.colour] ?? 3) - (order[b.colour] ?? 3);
      });
      const redZones = sortedZones.filter((z) => z.colour === 'RED');

      res.json({
        warehouse_id: warehouseId,
        total_capacity_slots: totalCapacity,
        total_occupied_slots: totalOccupied,
        total_reserved_inbound_slots: totalReserved,
        overall_utilization_pct: overallMetrics.utilization_pct,
        overall_colour: overallMetrics.colour,
        overall_explanation: overallMetrics.explanation,
        red_zones: redZones,
        zones: sortedZones,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      next(e);
    }
  },
);

zonesRouter.post(

        zone_id,
        warehouse_id,
        name,
        zone_type,
        polygon,
        capacity_slots,
        reserved_inbound_slots,
      } = req.body;

      // Validate polygon

        zone_type,
        polygon,
        capacity_slots,

        version: 1,

      });

      // Audit creation

        entityType: 'Zone',

        after: zone.toObject(),
      });

      await broadcastToTopic('zones', { type: 'ZONE_CREATED', zone_id: zone.zone_id, warehouse_id: zone.warehouse_id });
````
