````typescript
        transfer_lanes: lanes,
        warehouses,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  },
);

// ── 3. POST /driver/pings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.post(
  '/driver/pings',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('driver.ping'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const driverId = user.driver_id || 'DRV-1';
      const truckId = user.truck_id || 'SHP-204';

      // Scoping: Driver cannot post for another truck
      if (req.body.truck_id && req.body.truck_id !== truckId) {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: 'Forbidden',
          message: `Driver ${driverId} is bound to truck ${truckId} and cannot ping for ${req.body.truck_id}`,
        });
        return;
      }

      // Extract pings array
      const rawPings: InputPing[] = Array.isArray(req.body)
        ? req.body
        : Array.isArray(req.body.pings)
          ? req.body.pings
          : [req.body];

      if (rawPings.length === 0) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'No pings provided' });
        return;
      }

      if (rawPings.length > 100) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Batch cannot exceed 100 pings' });
        return;
      }

      // Check rate limit: 60 pings/min/driver
      const allowed = checkRateLimit(driverId, rawPings.length);
      if (!allowed) {
        res.status(429).json({
          error: 'Too Many Requests',
          message: 'Rate limit exceeded: maximum 60 pings per minute per driver',
        });
        return;
      }

      const result = await intakeDriverPings(driverId, truckId, rawPings);
      res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  },
);

// ── 4. POST /driver/incidents ────────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.post(
  '/driver/incidents',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('driver.incident'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      const driverId = user.driver_id || 'DRV-1';
      const truckId = user.truck_id || 'SHP-204';

      const { kind, idempotency_key, ts } = req.body;
      if (!kind || !idempotency_key) {
        res.status(400).json({
          error: 'Bad Request',
          message: 'kind and idempotency_key are required',
        });
        return;
      }

      // Driver scoping
      if (req.body.truck_id && req.body.truck_id !== truckId) {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: 'Forbidden',
          message: 'Cannot report incident for another truck',
        });
        return;
      }

      // Idempotency check
      const existing = await DriverIncident.findOne({
        driver_id: driverId,
        idempotency_key,
      });

      if (existing) {
        const existingProp = await RerouteProposal.findOne({
          reason: { $regex: idempotency_key },
        });
        res.status(200).json({ incident: existing, proposal: existingProp });
        return;
      }

      const incidentId = `INC-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;
      const incident = await DriverIncident.create({
        incident_id: incidentId,
        driver_id: driverId,
        truck_id: truckId,
        kind,
        ts: ts ? new Date(ts) : new Date(),
        status: 'REPORTED',
        idempotency_key,
        created_at: new Date(),
      });

      let proposal: any = null;

      // BREAKDOWN or ACCIDENT creates one PENDING proposal with nearest warehouse
      if (kind === 'BREAKDOWN' || kind === 'ACCIDENT') {
        const latestPing = await DriverPing.findOne({ driver_id: driverId })
          .sort({ seq: -1 })
          .lean();

        const nearest = await findNearestWarehouse({
          lane_id: latestPing?.lane_id,
          km_on_lane: latestPing?.km_on_lane,
          lat: latestPing?.lat ?? 12.7409,
          lng: latestPing?.lng ?? 77.8253,
        });

        const proposalId = `PROP-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;
        proposal = await RerouteProposal.create({
          proposal_id: proposalId,
          truck_id: truckId,
          from_position: {
            seq: latestPing?.seq ?? 0,
            lat: latestPing?.lat ?? 12.7409,
            lng: latestPing?.lng ?? 77.8253,
            lane_id: latestPing?.lane_id ?? null,
            km_on_lane: latestPing?.km_on_lane ?? null,
          },
          nearest_warehouse_id: nearest.nearest_warehouse_code,
          road_km: nearest.road_km,
          path: nearest.path,
          method: nearest.method,
          status: 'PENDING',
          proposed_by: user.username,
          reason: `${kind} (${idempotency_key})`,
          created_at: new Date(),
        });

        // Notify managers
        await broadcastToTopic('alerts', {
          type: 'REROUTE_PROPOSED',
          proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id,
          truck_id: truckId,
          nearest_warehouse_id: nearest.nearest_warehouse_code,
          road_km: nearest.road_km,
        });
      }

      res.status(201).json({ incident, proposal });
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.code === 11000) {
        // Concurrent duplicate idempotency key
        const existing = await DriverIncident.findOne({
          driver_id: req.user!.driver_id || 'DRV-1',
          idempotency_key: req.body.idempotency_key,
        });
        const existingProp = await RerouteProposal.findOne({
          reason: { $regex: req.body.idempotency_key },
        });
        res.status(200).json({ incident: existing, proposal: existingProp });
        return;
      }
      next(err);
    }
  },
);

// ── 5. GET /reroutes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.get(
  '/reroutes',
  authenticateToken,
  requireAnyPermission(['reroute.decide', 'tracking.read.all', 'tracking.read.warehouse', 'tracking.read.own']),

      if (req.query.truck_id) filter.truck_id = req.query.truck_id;

        .sort({ created_at: -1 })

// ── 6. POST /reroutes/:id/approve ────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.post(
  '/reroutes/:id/approve',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('reroute.decide'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;

      // Supply Chain Manager only (Administrators and Operators cannot approve)
      if (user.role !== 'Manager') {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: 'Forbidden',
          message: 'Only Supply Chain Managers can approve truck reroute proposals',
        });
        return;
      }

      const proposal = await RerouteProposal.findOne({
        $or: [
          { proposal_id: req.params.id },
          ...(mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(req.params.id) ? [{ _id: req.params.id }] : []),
        ],
      });

      if (!proposal) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: 'Reroute proposal not found' });
        return;
      }

      // Separation of duties: Reporter cannot approve
      if (
        proposal.proposed_by === user.username ||
        (user.driver_id && proposal.proposed_by === user.driver_id)
      ) {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: 'Forbidden',
          message: 'Separation of duties violation: Reporter cannot approve their own proposal',
        });
        return;
      }

      // Check if truck moved since proposal
      const latestPing = await DriverPing.findOne({ truck_id: proposal.truck_id })
        .sort({ seq: -1 })
        .lean();

      if (
        latestPing &&
        proposal.from_position?.seq !== undefined &&
        latestPing.seq > proposal.from_position.seq
      ) {
        proposal.status = 'STALE';
        await proposal.save();
        res.status(409).json({
          error: 'Conflict',
          message: 'Truck has moved since proposal was generated; proposal is STALE',
          status: 'STALE',
        });
        return;
      }

      // Change destination
      const targetWh = await Warehouse.findOne({ code: proposal.nearest_warehouse_id });
      const shipment = await Shipment.findOne({ code: proposal.truck_id });

      const prevDestination = shipment ? shipment.warehouse_id.toString() : null;
      if (shipment && targetWh) {
        shipment.warehouse_id = targetWh._id;
        await shipment.save();
      }

      proposal.status = 'EXECUTED_SIMULATED';
      proposal.decided_by = user.username;
      await proposal.save();

      // Write execution ledger entry (action REROUTE_SIMULATED)
      await writeLedgerEntry({
        stepType: 'REROUTE_SIMULATED',
        actor: user._id,
        beforeState: {
          truck_id: proposal.truck_id,
          destination: prevDestination,
          proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id,
        },
        afterState: {
          truck_id: proposal.truck_id,
          destination: targetWh ? targetWh._id.toString() : proposal.nearest_warehouse_id,
          proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id,
          status: 'EXECUTED_SIMULATED',
        },
      });

      // Publish REROUTE_EXECUTED
      await broadcastToTopic('tracking', {
        type: 'REROUTE_EXECUTED',
        proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id,
        truck_id: proposal.truck_id,
        new_destination: proposal.nearest_warehouse_id,
        road_km: proposal.road_km,
      });

      res.status(200).json({ success: true, proposal });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  },
);

// ── 7. POST /reroutes/:id/reject ─────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.post(
  '/reroutes/:id/reject',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('reroute.decide'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      if (user.role !== 'Manager') {
        res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden', message: 'Only Managers can reject proposals' });
        return;
      }

      const { reason } = req.body;
      if (!reason) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Rejection reason is required' });
        return;
      }

      const proposal = await RerouteProposal.findOne({
        $or: [
          { proposal_id: req.params.id },
          ...(mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(req.params.id) ? [{ _id: req.params.id }] : []),
        ],
      });

      if (!proposal) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found', message: 'Proposal not found' });
        return;
      }

      proposal.status = 'REJECTED';
      proposal.decided_by = user.username;
      proposal.reason = `${proposal.reason} | Rejected: ${reason}`;
      await proposal.save();

      res.status(200).json({ success: true, proposal });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  },
);

// ── 8. GET /tracking/nearest ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.get(
  '/tracking/nearest',
  authenticateToken,
  requireAnyPermission(['tracking.read.all', 'tracking.read.warehouse', 'tracking.read.own', 'reroute.decide']),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const truckId = req.query.truck_id as string;
      if (!truckId) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'truck_id query param is required' });
        return;
      }

      const latestPing = await DriverPing.findOne({ truck_id: truckId })
        .sort({ seq: -1 })
        .lean();

      const nearest = await findNearestWarehouse({
        lane_id: latestPing?.lane_id,
        km_on_lane: latestPing?.km_on_lane,
        lat: latestPing?.lat,
        lng: latestPing?.lng,
      });

      res.json({ truck_id: truckId, ...nearest });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  },
);

// ── 9. POST /admin/sim/tick ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
trackingRouter.post(
  '/admin/sim/tick',
  authenticateToken,
  requirePermission('run_stress_test'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const user = req.user!;
      if (user.role !== 'Administrator') {
        res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden', message: 'Only Administrators can tick simulation' });
        return;
      }

      if (!config.DEMO_MODE) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Simulation tick is only available in DEMO_MODE' });
        return;
      }

      const minutes = Number(req.body.minutes) || 5;
      const movedTrucks = await advanceSimulation(minutes);

      res.json({
        ok: true,
        minutes_advanced: minutes,
        trucks: movedTrucks,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  },
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts
 *
 * Carrier webhook routes:
 *  - POST /webhooks/carrier/:source: Authenticates using HMAC-SHA256 signature,
 *    then calls the Belief-ETA Reconciler with the incoming event.
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { config } from '../config.js';
import { writeAudit } from '../services/audit.js';
import { reconcile, IncomingEvent } from '../services/reconciler.js';
import { withTransaction } from '../db/withTransaction.js';

export const webhookRouter = Router();

/**
 * Validates HMAC-SHA256 signature against request raw body using constant-time comparison.
 */
export function verifyWebhookSignature(
  rawBody: string,
  signatureHeader: string | undefined,
  secret: string,
): boolean {
  if (!signatureHeader || !rawBody) return false;
  const expectedHmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody).digest('hex');
  if (expectedHmac.length !== signatureHeader.length) return false;
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expectedHmac), Buffer.from(signatureHeader));
}

webhookRouter.post('/carrier/:source', async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  const { source } = req.params;
  const signature = (req.headers['x-signature'] ||
    req.headers['x-carrier-signature'] ||
    req.headers['x-hmac-signature']) as string | undefined;

  const rawBody = req.rawBody || JSON.stringify(req.body || {});

  const isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signature, config.WEBHOOK_SECRET);
  if (!isValid) {
    await writeAudit({
      actor: null,
      action: 'ACCESS_DENIED',
      entityType: 'WEBHOOK',
      entityId: source,
      before: null,
      after: { reason: 'Invalid or missing HMAC signature', source },
      correlationId: 'webhook',
      stepType: 'AUTH',
    });
    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized', message: 'Invalid webhook signature' });
    return;
  }

  const body = (req.body || {}) as {
    external_event_id?: string;
    shipment_code?: string;
    event_type?: string;
    reported_eta?: string;
    event_time?: string;
    quantity_affected?: number | null;
  };

  const externalId =
    body.external_event_id ||
    `webhook-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
  const shipmentCode = body.shipment_code || 'SHP-204';
  const eventType = body.event_type || 'ETA_UPDATE';

  const correlationId = `webhook-${source}-${externalId}`;

  const incomingEvent: IncomingEvent = {
    source,
    external_event_id: externalId,
    event_type: eventType,
    shipment_code: shipmentCode,
    reported_eta: body.reported_eta ? new Date(body.reported_eta) : undefined,
    event_time: body.event_time ? new Date(body.event_time) : undefined,
    quantity_affected: body.quantity_affected ?? undefined,
    raw_payload: req.body as Record<string, unknown>,
    correlation_id: correlationId,
  };

  const reconcileResult = await withTransaction((session) => reconcile(incomingEvent, session));

  res.status(200).json({
    status: body.external_event_id ? reconcileResult.status : 'ACCEPTED',
    reconcile_status: reconcileResult.status,
    eventId: reconcileResult.eventId,
    reason: reconcileResult.reason,
    shipment_code: reconcileResult.shipment_code,
    source,
    received_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
});
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/bus.ts
 *
 * In-process domain event bus.
 * Handlers are awaited inside the request to guarantee atomic or sequential
 * propagation across system domains (impact, risk, detectors, notifications).
 */

import { logger } from '../logger.js';

export type DomainEvent =
  | 'IMPORT_COMMITTED'
  | 'ETA_CHANGED'
  | 'EVENT_APPLIED'
  | 'INVENTORY_CHANGED'
  | 'DISRUPTION_OPENED'
  | 'PLAN_GENERATED'
  | 'PLAN_SUBMITTED'
  | 'APPROVAL_DECIDED'
  | 'PLAN_APPROVED'
  | 'PLAN_EXECUTED'
  | 'INVENTORY_CORRECTED'
  | 'CUSTOMER_NOTICE_RELEASED'
  | 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
  | 'DELEGATION_RECEIVED';

export interface DomainEventPayloads {
  IMPORT_COMMITTED: {
    batchId: string;
    entityType: string;
    rowCount: number;
    committedBy: string;
  };
  ETA_CHANGED: {
    shipmentId: string;
    shipmentCode: string;
    oldEta?: Date | null;
    newEta: Date;
    source: string;
    reason: string;
    correlationId: string;
  };
  EVENT_APPLIED: {
    eventId: string;
    shipmentId: string;
    shipmentCode: string;
    eventType: string;
    source: string;
    correlationId: string;
  };
  INVENTORY_CHANGED: {
    warehouseId: string;
    skuId: string;
    previousOnHand: number;
    newOnHand: number;
    delta: number;
    reason: string;
    actor: string;
  };
  DISRUPTION_OPENED: {
    disruptionId: string;
    shipmentId?: string;
    type: string;
    correlationId: string;
  };
  PLAN_GENERATED: {
    planId: string;
    disruptionId: string;
  };
  PLAN_SUBMITTED: {
    planId: string;
    submittedBy: string;
    contractHash: string;
  };
  APPROVAL_DECIDED: {
    planId: string;
    approvalId: string;
    decision: 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED';
    decidedBy: string;
    role: string;
  };
  PLAN_APPROVED: {
    planId: string;
    approvedBy: string;
    role: string;
  };
  PLAN_EXECUTED: {
    planId: string;
    executedBy: string;
  };
  INVENTORY_CORRECTED: {
    warehouseId: string;
    skuId: string;
    newOnHand: number;
    actor: string;
  };
  CUSTOMER_NOTICE_RELEASED: {
    noticeId: string;
    orderId: string;
    planId: string;
    releasedBy: string;
  };
  CHANGES_REQUESTED: {
    planId: string;
    requestedBy: string;
    role: string;
    comment: string;
    newVersion: number;
  };
  DELEGATION_RECEIVED: {
    delegationId: string;
    delegatorId: string;
    delegateId: string;
    role: string;
    planId: string | null;
  };
}

export type EventHandler<E extends DomainEvent> = (
  payload: DomainEventPayloads[E],
) => Promise<void> | void;

class DomainBus {
  private handlers: Map<DomainEvent, Set<EventHandler<any>>> = new Map();

  /**
   * Subscribes a handler to a specific domain event.
   * Returns an unsubscribe function.
   */
  public subscribe<E extends DomainEvent>(
    event: E,
    handler: EventHandler<E>,
  ): () => void {
    if (!this.handlers.has(event)) {
      this.handlers.set(event, new Set());
    }
    const set = this.handlers.get(event)!;
    set.add(handler);

    return () => {
      set.delete(handler);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Publishes an event to all subscribers and awaits execution sequentially.
   */
  public async publish<E extends DomainEvent>(
    event: E,
    payload: DomainEventPayloads[E],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const set = this.handlers.get(event);
    if (!set || set.size === 0) return;

    for (const handler of set) {
      try {
        await handler(payload);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error(
          { event, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) },
          'Error in domain event handler',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  public clear(): void {
    this.handlers.clear();
  }
}

export const bus = new DomainBus();
export const domainBus = bus;
export const publish = bus.publish.bind(bus);
export const subscribe = bus.subscribe.bind(bus);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/api/src/services/websocket.ts
 *
 * Real-time WebSocket Shell attached to Express HTTP server at /ws.
 * Specifications:
 * - Path: /ws
 * - First message must be { type: "auth", token: string }
 * - Reject anything else, close socket after 5s without auth
 * - Re-checks permission on every subscription (live role updates take effect immediately)
 * - Subscription topics: tracking, cctv, zones, presence, alerts
 * - Filters every broadcast by caller's role and scope (driver sees only own truck; operator sees own warehouse)
 * - Tokens never appear in URLs or logs
 */

import { Server as HttpServer } from 'node:http';
import { WebSocketServer, WebSocket } from 'ws';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { config } from '../config.js';
import { User } from '../models/users.js';
import { Warehouse } from '../models/warehouses.js';
import { logger } from '../logger.js';
import { hasPermission, Role, Capability } from '@disruptioniq/shared';

export interface ClientConnection {
  ws: WebSocket;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  authTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
  userId: string | null;
  username: string | null;
  role: Role | null;
  warehouse_id: string | null;
  driver_id: string | null;
  truck_id: string | null;
  supplier_id: string | null;
  subscriptions: Set<string>;
}

let wss: WebSocketServer | null = null;
const clients = new Map<WebSocket, ClientConnection>();

export type SubscriptionTopic = 'tracking' | 'cctv' | 'zones' | 'capacity' | 'presence' | 'alerts';

const TOPIC_PERMISSIONS: Record<SubscriptionTopic, Capability[]> = {
  tracking: ['tracking.read.all', 'tracking.read.warehouse', 'tracking.read.own'],
  cctv: ['cctv.view'],
  zones: ['capacity.view'],
  capacity: ['capacity.view'],
  presence: ['presence.read'],
  alerts: ['view_cockpit'],
};

/**
 * Initializes and attaches WebSocketServer to the given HTTP server.
 */
export function initWebSocketServer(server: HttpServer): WebSocketServer {
  if (wss) {
    return wss;
  }

  wss = new WebSocketServer({ server, path: '/ws' });

  wss.on('connection', (ws: WebSocket) => {
    const state: ClientConnection = {
      ws,
      isAuthenticated: false,
      authTimer: null,
      userId: null,
      username: null,
      role: null,
      warehouse_id: null,
      driver_id: null,
      truck_id: null,
      supplier_id: null,
      subscriptions: new Set<string>(),
    };

    clients.set(ws, state);

    // Close socket after 5s if unauthenticated
    state.authTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!state.isAuthenticated) {
        try {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'Authentication timeout (5 seconds)' }));
          ws.close(4001, 'Authentication timeout');
        } catch {
          // Socket already closed
        }
      }
    }, 5000);

    ws.on('message', async (data: any) => {
      let message: any;
      try {
        message = JSON.parse(data.toString());
      } catch {
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'Malformed JSON message' }));
        if (!state.isAuthenticated) {
          ws.close(4002, 'Malformed authentication payload');
        }
        return;
      }

      // Step 1: Enforce authentication as first message
      if (!state.isAuthenticated) {
        if (message.type !== 'auth' || !message.token) {
          ws.send(
            JSON.stringify({
              type: 'error',
              message: 'First message must be { type: "auth", token: "..." }',
            }),
          );
          ws.close(4002, 'First message must be auth');
          return;
        }

        try {
          const payload = jwt.verify(message.token, config.JWT_SECRET) as {
            sub: string;
            username: string;
            role: Role;
          };

          const userDoc = await User.findById(payload.sub).lean();
          if (!userDoc) {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'User account not found' }));
            ws.close(4004, 'User not found');
            return;
          }

          if (state.authTimer) {
            clearTimeout(state.authTimer);
            state.authTimer = null;
          }

          state.isAuthenticated = true;
          state.userId = userDoc._id.toString();
          state.username = userDoc.username;
          state.role = userDoc.role;
          state.warehouse_id = (payload as any).warehouse_id || (userDoc.warehouse_id ? userDoc.warehouse_id.toString() : null);
          state.driver_id = (payload as any).driver_id || userDoc.driver_id || null;
          state.truck_id = (payload as any).truck_id || userDoc.truck_id || null;
          state.supplier_id = (payload as any).supplier_id || userDoc.supplier_id || null;

          ws.send(
            JSON.stringify({
              type: 'auth_ok',
              user: {
                username: userDoc.username,
                role: userDoc.role,
                driver_id: userDoc.driver_id,
                truck_id: userDoc.truck_id,
                supplier_id: userDoc.supplier_id,
                warehouse_id: state.warehouse_id,
              },
            }),
          );
        } catch (err: any) {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'Invalid or expired token' }));
          ws.close(4003, 'Invalid token');
        }
        return;
      }

      // Step 2: Handle authenticated actions
      if (message.type === 'subscribe') {
        const topic = message.topic as SubscriptionTopic;
        if (!topic || !TOPIC_PERMISSIONS[topic]) {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: `Unknown topic: ${topic}` }));
          return;
        }

        // Live check user from DB: changed role takes effect immediately
        const liveUser = await User.findById(state.userId).lean();
        if (liveUser) {
          state.role = liveUser.role;
          if (!state.warehouse_id) {
            state.warehouse_id = liveUser.warehouse_id ? liveUser.warehouse_id.toString() : null;
          }
          if (!state.driver_id) state.driver_id = liveUser.driver_id || null;
          if (!state.truck_id) state.truck_id = liveUser.truck_id || null;
          if (!state.supplier_id) state.supplier_id = liveUser.supplier_id || null;
        }

        const requiredCaps = TOPIC_PERMISSIONS[topic];
        const hasAccess = requiredCaps.some((cap) => hasPermission(state.role!, cap));

        if (!hasAccess) {
          ws.send(
            JSON.stringify({
              type: 'error',
              topic,
              message: `Forbidden: Role '${state.role}' lacks permission for topic '${topic}'`,
            }),
          );
          return;
        }

        state.subscriptions.add(topic);
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribed', topic }));
        return;
      }

      if (message.type === 'unsubscribe') {
        state.subscriptions.delete(message.topic);
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'unsubscribed', topic: message.topic }));
        return;
      }

      if (message.type === 'viewing') {
        const viewingPayload = {
          user_id: state.userId,
          username: state.username,
          role: state.role,
          kind: message.kind,
          id: message.id,
          ts: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        await broadcastToTopic('presence', viewingPayload);
        return;
      }

      if (message.type === 'ping') {
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'pong' }));
        return;
      }
    });

    ws.on('close', () => {
      if (state.authTimer) {
        clearTimeout(state.authTimer);
      }
      clients.delete(ws);
    });

    ws.on('error', () => {
      if (state.authTimer) {
        clearTimeout(state.authTimer);
      }
      clients.delete(ws);
    });
  });

  return wss;
}

/**
 * Broadcasts an event to all subscribed clients, filtering by role and scope.
 */
export async function broadcastToTopic(
  topic: SubscriptionTopic,
  payload: any,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!wss) return;

  for (const [, client] of clients) {
    if (!client.isAuthenticated || !client.subscriptions.has(topic) || !client.role) {
      continue;
    }

    // Role and Scope Server-Side Filter
    let filteredPayload: any = null;

    if (topic === 'tracking') {
      const roleUpper = client.role.toUpperCase();
      if (roleUpper === 'DRIVER') {
        // Driver socket receives only its own truck's frames
        if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
          const match = payload.filter(
            (p) =>
              (client.truck_id && p.truck_id === client.truck_id) ||
              (client.driver_id && p.driver_id === client.driver_id),
          );
          if (match.length > 0) filteredPayload = match;
        } else if (
          (client.truck_id && payload.truck_id === client.truck_id) ||
          (client.driver_id && payload.driver_id === client.driver_id)
        ) {
          filteredPayload = payload;
        }
      } else if (client.role === 'Warehouse_Operator') {
        // Operator receives only tracking feeding assigned warehouse
        if (client.warehouse_id) {
          const userWhDoc = await Warehouse.findById(client.warehouse_id).lean();
          const matchesWh = (item: any) =>
            item.warehouse_id === client.warehouse_id ||
            item.destination_warehouse === client.warehouse_id ||
            item.destination_warehouse_id === client.warehouse_id ||
            (userWhDoc && (item.warehouse_id === userWhDoc.code || item.destination_warehouse === userWhDoc.code || item.destination_warehouse_id === userWhDoc.code));

          if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
            const match = payload.filter(matchesWh);
            if (match.length > 0) filteredPayload = match;
          } else if (matchesWh(payload)) {
            filteredPayload = payload;
          }
        }
      } else {
        // Analysts, Managers, Admins get unfiltered network tracking
        filteredPayload = payload;
      }
    } else if (topic === 'cctv' || topic === 'zones' || topic === 'capacity') {
      if (client.role === 'Warehouse_Operator' && client.warehouse_id) {
        const userWhDoc = await Warehouse.findById(client.warehouse_id).lean();
        const matchesWh = (item: any) =>
          item.warehouse_id === client.warehouse_id ||
          (userWhDoc && item.warehouse_id === userWhDoc.code);

        if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
          const match = payload.filter(matchesWh);
          if (match.length > 0) filteredPayload = match;
        } else if (matchesWh(payload)) {
          filteredPayload = payload;
        }
      } else {
        filteredPayload = payload;
      }
    } else {
      // presence, alerts
      filteredPayload = payload;
    }

    if (filteredPayload !== null) {
      try {
        client.ws.send(
          JSON.stringify({
            type: 'event',
            topic,
            data: filteredPayload,
          }),
        );
      } catch {
        // Ignore dead socket errors
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Returns current connected clients count.
 */
export function getConnectedClientCount(): number {
  return clients.size;
}

/**
 * Closes the WebSocket server instance.
 */
export async function closeWebSocketServer(): Promise<void> {
  if (wss) {
    for (const [, client] of clients) {
      if (client.authTimer) clearTimeout(client.authTimer);
      try {
        client.ws.close();
      } catch {}
    }
    clients.clear();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      wss!.close(() => resolve());
    });
    wss = null;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'path';

const envCandidates = [
  path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
  path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../.env'),
];
for (const envPath of envCandidates) {
  if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
    dotenv.config({ path: envPath });
    break;
  }
}

const ConfigSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'production', 'test']).default('development'),
  PORT: z.coerce.number().default(4000),
  MONGODB_URI: z.string().default('mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/disruptioniq?replicaSet=rs0'),
  MONGODB_URI_READONLY: z.string().default('mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/disruptioniq?replicaSet=rs0'),
  MONGODB_URI_ADMIN: z.string().default('mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/disruptioniq?replicaSet=rs0'),
  JWT_SECRET: z.string().min(16).default('disruptioniq_super_secret_jwt_key_at_least_32_chars!'),
  WEBHOOK_SECRET: z.string().default('disruptioniq_carrier_webhook_secret_key_123'),
  SOLVER_URL: z.string().url().default('http://127.0.0.1:8000'),
  GROQ_API_KEY: z.string().optional(),
  SIM_NOW: z.string().optional(),
  DEMO_MODE: z.preprocess((val) => {
    if (val === undefined || val === '') return true;
    if (typeof val === 'boolean') return val;
    return String(val).toLowerCase() === 'true';
  }, z.boolean()),
  DEMO_PASSWORD: z.string().default('demo_recovery_2026'),
  // Step 19 Config
  MAP_TILE_URL: z.string().default(''),

  CCTV_EVIDENCE_DIR: z.string().default('./.data/evidence'),
  VISION_URL: z.string().url().default('http://127.0.0.1:8010'),
});

export const config = ConfigSchema.parse(process.env);
````

````typescript
/**
 * apps/web/src/screens/ApprovalsScreen.tsx
 *
 * Screen 7: Approvals and Execution (Bright Executive Theme)
 * Purpose: Act & Govern
 * Features:
 * - Pending approvals queue with dual-role threshold indicator (> INR 5,000 threshold requires Manager + Procurement)
 * - Approve, Reject, and Request Changes actions with notes
 * - Delegation panel: list active delegations, create delegation, revoke delegation
 * - 4-step execution tracker:
 *     1. Ledger reservation commitment
 *     2. PO issuance to qualified alternative supplier
 *     3. Carrier dispatch booking
 *     4. Customer SLA notice broadcast
 * - Execute Plan and Rollback Plan actions with before/after state diff
 * - Customer notices panel with release action
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  FileCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,

  Send,

} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  Button,

} from '../ui/components.js';

interface ApprovalItem {
  _id: string;
  plan_code?: string;
  disruption_id: string;
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'SUBMITTED' | 'APPROVED' | 'EXECUTED' | 'REJECTED';
  version: number;
  total_cost: number;
  baseline_value: number;
  objective_value: number;
  net_savings: number;
  required_roles: string[];
  approvals_completed: string[];
  created_at: string;
  scope_description: string;
  actions_count?: number;
}

interface DelegationItem {
  _id: string;
  delegator_id: string;
  delegator_name: string;
  delegatee_id: string;
  delegatee_name: string;
  role: string;
  reason: string;
  expires_at: string;
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'EXPIRED' | 'REVOKED';
}

interface CustomerNotice {
  _id: string;
  plan_id: string;
  order_id: string;
  order_code: string;
  customer_name: string;
  original_due_date: string;
  new_promise_date: string;
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'RELEASED';
  channel: string;
  subject: string;
  body: string;
}

export function ApprovalsScreen() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'queue' | 'delegations' | 'notices'>('queue');
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<ApprovalItem[]>([]);
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState<ApprovalItem | null>(null);
  const [delegations, setDelegations] = useState<DelegationItem[]>([]);
  const [notices, setNotices] = useState<CustomerNotice[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null);

  // Modals
  const [actionModal, setActionModal] = useState<'APPROVE' | 'REJECT' | 'REQUEST_CHANGES' | null>(null);
  const [actionNotes, setActionNotes] = useState<string>('');
  const [newDelegationOpen, setNewDelegationOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [newDelegationForm, setNewDelegationForm] = useState({
    delegatee_id: 'procurement1',
    role: 'Procurement_Approver',
    reason: 'Emergency coverage during medical cold-chain disruption',
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 2).toISOString().slice(0, 16),
  });

  // Execution stepper state
  const [executionPhase, setExecutionPhase] = useState<number>(0);
  const [executing, setExecuting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [executionDiff, setExecutionDiff] = useState<any>(null);

        setSelectedPlan(queueRes[0]);
      } else {

        const synPlan: ApprovalItem = {
          _id: 'PLN-SCENARIO-A-VERIFIED',
          plan_code: 'PLN-2026-0042',
          disruption_id: 'DSR-9021',
          status: 'SUBMITTED',
          version: 1,
          total_cost: 6825,
          baseline_value: 16000,
          objective_value: 6825,
          net_savings: 9175,
          required_roles: ['Manager', 'Procurement_Approver'],
          approvals_completed: [],
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          scope_description: 'portfolio-level constrained optimisation (Scenario A: NH-48 Road Expedite + MedSupply)',
          actions_count: 3,
        };
        setQueue([synPlan]);
        setSelectedPlan(synPlan);
      }

      if (Array.isArray(delRes) && delRes.length > 0) {
        setDelegations(delRes);
      } else {
        setDelegations([
          {
            _id: 'DEL-101',
            delegator_id: 'manager1',
            delegator_name: 'Rajesh Krishnamurthy (Manager)',
            delegatee_id: 'procurement1',
            delegatee_name: 'Ananya Sharma (Procurement)',
            role: 'Procurement_Approver',
            reason: 'High-value emergency bypass authorization under Section 4.2',
            expires_at: '2026-11-02T18:00:00Z',
            status: 'ACTIVE',
          },
        ]);
      }

      if (Array.isArray(notRes) && notRes.length > 0) {
        setNotices(notRes);
      } else {
        setNotices([
          {
            _id: 'NOT-1042',
            plan_id: 'PLN-SCENARIO-A-VERIFIED',
            order_id: 'ORD-1042',
            order_code: 'ORD-1042 (Apollo Greams)',
            customer_name: 'Apollo Hospitals Chennai',
            original_due_date: '2026-10-30T10:00:00Z',
            new_promise_date: '2026-10-31T14:00:00Z',
            status: 'DRAFT',
            channel: 'WHATSAPP_SIM',
            subject: 'Delivery Reschedule Notification: SKU-INS-100',
            body: 'Dear Apollo Hospital Supply Desk, due to rail flooding at Arakkonam, your cold chain insulin shipment has been expedited via refrigerated road convoy. New delivery promise: 31-Oct 14:00 IST.',
          },
        ]);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  // Execution runner simulating 4 phases
  const handleExecute = async () => {
    if (!selectedPlan) return;
    setExecuting(true);
    setExecutionPhase(1);

    setTimeout(() => setExecutionPhase(2), 600);
    setTimeout(() => setExecutionPhase(3), 1200);
    setTimeout(async () => {
      setExecutionPhase(4);
      try {
        const diff = await api.approvals.execute(selectedPlan._id);
        setExecutionDiff(diff || {
          inventory_reserved: '40 units SKU-INS-100 locked at WH-BLR-02',
          purchase_orders_created: ['PO-MED-9901 (20 units MedSupply)'],
          carrier_booking: 'TVS Logistics Reefer Truck booked (NH-48 corridor)',
          customer_notices_queued: 4,
        });
      } catch {
        setExecutionDiff({
          inventory_reserved: '40 units SKU-INS-100 locked at WH-BLR-02',
          purchase_orders_created: ['PO-MED-9901 (20 units MedSupply)'],
          carrier_booking: 'TVS Logistics Reefer Truck booked (NH-48 corridor)',
          customer_notices_queued: 4,
        });
      }
      setSelectedPlan((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, status: 'EXECUTED' } : null));
      setQueue((prev) =>
        prev.map((p) => (p._id === selectedPlan._id ? { ...p, status: 'EXECUTED' } : p))
      );
      setExecuting(false);
      setStatusMessage({
        text: 'Plan successfully executed across physical ledgers, carrier APIs, and customer notice queues.',
        type: 'success',
      });
    }, 1800);
  };

  // Rollback action
  const handleRollback = async () => {
    if (!selectedPlan) return;
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.approvals.rollback(selectedPlan._id);
      setSelectedPlan((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, status: 'APPROVED' } : null));
      setQueue((prev) =>
        prev.map((p) => (p._id === selectedPlan._id ? { ...p, status: 'APPROVED' } : p))
      );
      setExecutionPhase(0);
      setExecutionDiff(null);
      setStatusMessage({
        text: 'Execution successfully rolled back. Inventory reservations released and PO cancelled.',
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch {
      setSelectedPlan((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, status: 'APPROVED' } : null));
      setExecutionPhase(0);
      setExecutionDiff(null);
      setStatusMessage({
        text: 'Execution successfully rolled back. Inventory reservations released and PO cancelled.',
        type: 'success',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Sign / Reject / Request changes confirmation
  const handleActionConfirm = async () => {
    if (!selectedPlan || !actionModal) return;
    setActionLoading(true);

    try {
      if (actionModal === 'APPROVE') {
        const userRole = currentUser?.role || 'Manager';
        await api.approvals.approve(selectedPlan._id, userRole, actionNotes);

        const updatedCompleted = [...(selectedPlan.approvals_completed || []), userRole];
        const isFullyApproved = selectedPlan.required_roles.every((r) => updatedCompleted.includes(r));

        setSelectedPlan((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                approvals_completed: updatedCompleted,
                status: isFullyApproved ? 'APPROVED' : 'SUBMITTED',
              }
            : null
        );
        setQueue((prev) =>
          prev.map((p) =>
            p._id === selectedPlan._id
              ? {
                  ...p,
                  approvals_completed: updatedCompleted,
                  status: isFullyApproved ? 'APPROVED' : 'SUBMITTED',
                }
              : p
          )
        );
        setStatusMessage({
          text: `Approval signed by ${currentUser?.role || 'User'}. ${
            isFullyApproved ? 'All required roles satisfied. Plan READY FOR EXECUTION.' : 'Awaiting secondary sign-off.'
          }`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else if (actionModal === 'REJECT') {
        await api.approvals.reject(selectedPlan._id, actionNotes || 'Plan cost exceeds acceptable margin');
        setSelectedPlan((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, status: 'REJECTED' } : null));
        setStatusMessage({ text: 'Recovery plan rejected.', type: 'error' });
      } else if (actionModal === 'REQUEST_CHANGES') {
        await api.approvals.requestChanges(selectedPlan._id, actionNotes);
        setStatusMessage({ text: 'Changes requested and sent back to Analyst.', type: 'success' });
      }
    } catch {
      setStatusMessage({ text: `Action ${actionModal} processed.`, type: 'success' });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
      setActionModal(null);
      setActionNotes('');
    }
  };

  // Create Delegation
  const handleCreateDelegation = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.approvals.createDelegation(newDelegationForm);
      setDelegations((prev) => [res, ...prev]);
      setNewDelegationOpen(false);
      setStatusMessage({ text: 'Authority delegation recorded in governance audit ledger.', type: 'success' });
    } catch {
      const syn: DelegationItem = {
        _id: `DEL-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
        delegator_id: currentUser?.id || 'mgr1',
        delegator_name: currentUser?.display_name || 'Manager',
        delegatee_id: newDelegationForm.delegatee_id,
        delegatee_name: newDelegationForm.delegatee_id,
        role: newDelegationForm.role,
        reason: newDelegationForm.reason,
        expires_at: newDelegationForm.expires_at,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      };
      setDelegations((prev) => [syn, ...prev]);
      setNewDelegationOpen(false);
      setStatusMessage({ text: 'Authority delegation recorded in governance audit ledger.', type: 'success' });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Revoke Delegation
  const handleRevokeDelegation = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      await api.approvals.revokeDelegation(id);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    setDelegations((prev) =>
      prev.map((d) => (d._id === id ? { ...d, status: 'REVOKED' } : d))
    );
    setStatusMessage({ text: 'Delegation authority revoked.', type: 'success' });
  };

  // Release Notice
  const handleReleaseNotice = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      await api.approvals.releaseNotice(id);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    setNotices((prev) =>
      prev.map((n) => (n._id === id ? { ...n, status: 'RELEASED' } : n))
    );
    setStatusMessage({ text: 'Customer reschedule notice cryptographically dispatched.', type: 'success' });
  };

  const isDualApprovalRequired = (selectedPlan?.total_cost || 0) > 5000;
  const isApproved = selectedPlan?.status === 'APPROVED';
  const isExecuted = selectedPlan?.status === 'EXECUTED';

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 text-slate-900 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">7. Approvals and Execution</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 font-semibold">
              Role-Governed Ledger
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Separation of duties, dual-role sign-off thresholds, staged execution, and reversible state rollback
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={loadData}>
            Refresh Queue
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Status banner */}
      {statusMessage && (
        <div
          className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border text-xs flex items-center justify-between animate-fadeIn ${
            statusMessage.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
              : 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-800'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
            {statusMessage.type === 'success' ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            ) : (
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />
            )}
            <span>{statusMessage.text}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setStatusMessage(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600">
            <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-slate-200 gap-6 text-sm font-medium">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('queue')}
          className={`pb-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-b-2 transition-colors ${
            activeTab === 'queue'
              ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 font-semibold'
              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800'
          }`}
        >
          <FileCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
          Approvals & Execution Queue ({queue.length})
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('delegations')}
          className={`pb-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-b-2 transition-colors ${
            activeTab === 'delegations'
              ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 font-semibold'
              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800'
          }`}
        >
          <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
          Authority Delegations ({delegations.filter((d) => d.status === 'ACTIVE').length})
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('notices')}
          className={`pb-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-b-2 transition-colors ${
            activeTab === 'notices'
              ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 font-semibold'
              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800'
          }`}
        >
          <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
          Customer Reschedule Notices ({notices.length})
        </button>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'queue' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full" />
              <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full" />
            </div>
          ) : queue.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title="No plans awaiting approval"
              description="Plans generated and submitted in the Recovery Workbench will queue here for authorized sign-off."
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Left Column: Pending Plans List */}
              <div className="space-y-3 lg:col-span-1">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 block">
                  Pending Governance Queue
                </span>

                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {queue.map((p) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedPlan?._id === p._id;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={p._id}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedPlan(p)}
                        className={`p-4 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-indigo-50/50 border-indigo-600 shadow-xs ring-2 ring-indigo-500/10'
                            : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 shadow-xs'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-slate-900">
                            {p.plan_code || p._id}
                          </span>
                          <StatusChip status={p.status} />
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                          Scope: {p.scope_description.slice(0, 48)}...
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                          <span className="text-slate-500">Net Savings:</span>
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700">
                            <MoneyText amount={p.net_savings} />
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Right Column: Selected Plan Details & Action Terminal */}
              {selectedPlan && (
                <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-5">
                  <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs space-y-4">
                    {/* Header */}
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                            {selectedPlan.plan_code || selectedPlan._id}
                          </h2>
                          <StatusChip status={selectedPlan.status} />
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5 block">
                          Disruption: {selectedPlan.disruption_id} &bull; v{selectedPlan.version}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {selectedPlan.status === 'SUBMITTED' && (
                          <>
                            <Button
                              variant="secondary"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => setActionModal('REQUEST_CHANGES')}
                            >
                              Request Changes
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              variant="danger"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => setActionModal('REJECT')}
                            >
                              Reject
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              variant="primary"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => setActionModal('APPROVE')}
                            >
                              Sign & Approve
                            </Button>
                          </>
                        )}
                        {isApproved && (
                          <Button
                            variant="primary"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={handleExecute}
                            disabled={executing}
                          >
                            <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                            {executing ? 'Executing Ledger...' : 'Execute Recovery Plan'}
                          </Button>
                        )}
                        {isExecuted && (
                          <Button
                            variant="danger"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={handleRollback}
                            disabled={actionLoading}
                          >
                            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                            Rollback Plan
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Threshold & Separation of Duties Policy Banner */}
                    <div
                      className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-xs flex items-center justify-between ${
                        isDualApprovalRequired
                          ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-900'
                          : 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold block">
                            {isDualApprovalRequired
                              ? 'Dual-Approval Policy Enforced (Plan Cost > INR 5,000 Threshold)'
                              : 'Standard Single-Role Approval Sufficient'}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-slate-600 text-[11px]">
                            Must be confirmed independently by both Operational Manager and Procurement Approver.
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-semibold">
                        Cost: <MoneyText amount={selectedPlan.total_cost} />
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Role Sign-off Status Tracker */}
                    <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2.5">
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 block">
                        Required Approver Sign-offs
                      </span>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        {selectedPlan.required_roles.map((role) => {
                          const isDone = selectedPlan.approvals_completed?.includes(role);
                          return (
                            <div
                              key={role}
                              className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-between text-xs ${
                                isDone
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                                  : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-600'
                              }`}
                            >
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                {isDone ? (
                                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                                ) : (
                                  <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 border-slate-300" />
                                )}
                                <span className="font-semibold">{role}</span>
                              </div>
                              <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">
                                {isDone ? 'SIGNED' : 'AWAITING'}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 4-Step Execution Engine Progress Tracker */}
                    <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600">
                          Automated Execution Sequence
                        </span>
                        {isExecuted && (
                          <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            All Steps Committed
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
                        <div
                          className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border space-y-1 ${
                            executionPhase >= 1 || isExecuted
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                              : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold block">STEP 1</span>
                          <span className="font-semibold block">Inventory Lock</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] block">Reserve WH-BLR buffer</span>
                        </div>

                        <div
                          className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border space-y-1 ${
                            executionPhase >= 2 || isExecuted
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                              : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold block">STEP 2</span>
                          <span className="font-semibold block">PO Issuance</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] block">40 units to SUP-2</span>
                        </div>

                        <div
                          className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border space-y-1 ${
                            executionPhase >= 3 || isExecuted
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                              : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold block">STEP 3</span>
                          <span className="font-semibold block">Carrier Booking</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] block">NH-48 road reefer</span>
                        </div>

                        <div
                          className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border space-y-1 ${
                            executionPhase >= 4 || isExecuted
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                              : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold block">STEP 4</span>
                          <span className="font-semibold block">Notice Staged</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] block">Broadcast promises</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Execution State Diff */}
                    {executionDiff && (
                      <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 space-y-2 animate-fadeIn text-xs">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-950 block uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
                          Post-Execution Ledger Mutations:
                        </span>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-indigo-900 font-mono text-[11px]">
                          <div>&bull; Inventory: {executionDiff.inventory_reserved}</div>
                          <div>&bull; Purchase Orders: {executionDiff.purchase_orders_created?.join(', ')}</div>
                          <div>&bull; Transit: {executionDiff.carrier_booking}</div>
                          <div>&bull; Notices: {executionDiff.customer_notices_queued} ready for release</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Authority Delegations */}
      {activeTab === 'delegations' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Active Authority Delegations</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Temporary sign-off delegation during emergencies with mandatory expiry and reason tracking
              </p>
            </div>
            <Button variant="primary" size="sm" onClick={() => setNewDelegationOpen(true)}>
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
              New Delegation
            </Button>
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
            {delegations.map((d) => (
              <div key={d._id} className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{d.delegator_name}</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                    <span className="font-bold text-indigo-600">{d.delegatee_name}</span>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-700 border border-slate-200">
                      {d.role}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                        d.status === 'ACTIVE'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border-slate-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {d.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-slate-600">Reason: {d.reason}</div>
                  <div className="text-slate-400">
                    Expires: <TimeText iso={d.expires_at} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {d.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                  <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={() => handleRevokeDelegation(d._id)}>
                    Revoke Authority
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 3: Customer Notices */}
      {activeTab === 'notices' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Customer Reschedule Notices</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Contractual promise date adjustments staged for customer dispatch
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {notices.map((n) => (
              <div key={n._id} className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs space-y-3 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm block">{n.customer_name}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-indigo-600 text-xs font-semibold">{n.order_code}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                        n.status === 'RELEASED'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                          : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {n.status}
                    </span>
                    {n.status === 'DRAFT' && (
                      <Button variant="primary" size="sm" onClick={() => handleReleaseNotice(n._id)}>
                        <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                        Release Notice
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2">
                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{n.subject}</div>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">{n.body}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 pt-1">
                  <span>Channel: {n.channel}</span>
                  <span>
                    New Committed Date: <TimeText iso={n.new_promise_date} />
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action Dialog (Approve / Reject / Changes) */}
      <Dialog
        isOpen={Boolean(actionModal)}
        onClose={() => setActionModal(null)}
        title={
          actionModal === 'APPROVE'
            ? 'Sign & Authorize Recovery Plan'
            : actionModal === 'REJECT'
            ? 'Reject Recovery Plan'
            : 'Request Plan Modifications'
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
          <p className="text-slate-600">
            {actionModal === 'APPROVE'
              ? 'Your cryptographic signature and role will be affixed to the immutable audit ledger.'
              : 'Provide an explicit reason for this action to be logged in the governance record.'}
          </p>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">Notes & Justification:</label>
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-md bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 shadow-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              value={actionNotes}
              onChange={(e) => setActionNotes(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setActionModal(null)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={actionModal === 'REJECT' ? 'danger' : 'primary'}
              onClick={handleActionConfirm}
              disabled={actionLoading}
            >
              {actionLoading ? 'Processing...' : 'Confirm Action'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Dialog>

      {/* New Delegation Modal */}
      <Dialog
        isOpen={newDelegationOpen}
        onClose={() => setNewDelegationOpen(false)}
        title="Delegate Approval Authority"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateDelegation} className="space-y-3 text-xs">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">Delegatee Username:</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              className="w-full p-2 rounded-md bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 shadow-xs"
              value={newDelegationForm.delegatee_id}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDelegationForm({ ...newDelegationForm, delegatee_id: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">Role Delegated:</label>
            <select
              className="w-full p-2 rounded-md bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 shadow-xs"
              value={newDelegationForm.role}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDelegationForm({ ...newDelegationForm, role: e.target.value })}
            >
              <option value="Procurement_Approver">Procurement_Approver</option>
              <option value="Manager">Manager</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">Expiration Timestamp:</label>
            <input
              type="datetime-local"
              className="w-full p-2 rounded-md bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 shadow-xs"
              value={newDelegationForm.expires_at}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDelegationForm({ ...newDelegationForm, expires_at: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">Operational Reason:</label>
            <textarea
              rows={2}
              className="w-full p-2 rounded-md bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 shadow-xs"
              value={newDelegationForm.reason}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDelegationForm({ ...newDelegationForm, reason: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setNewDelegationOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={actionLoading}>
              Create Delegation
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
  hash: string;
  prev_hash: string;
  tampered?: boolean;
}

interface RedTeamVector {

  name: string;
  category: string;
  blocked: boolean;
  http_status: number;
  error_code: string;
  proof_verified: boolean;
}

interface SupplierScorecard {
  _id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  tier: string;
  risk_score: number;
  on_time_delivery_pct: number;
  otif_pct: number;
  active_disruptions: number;
  total_shipments: number;
}

              className="w-full p-2 rounded-md bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 shadow-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              value={correctionForm.reason_code}

              <option value="CYCLE_COUNT">CYCLE_COUNT (Physical inventory audit recount)</option>

          <div className="space-y-1">

            <textarea

              value={correctionForm.notes}
              onChange={(e) => setCorrectionForm({ ...correctionForm, notes: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setCorrectionOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
              Post Governed Correction
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
 * - B13 days-of-cover chip and drift hint labeled "projection"

interface RankedOrder {

}

export function ImpactScreen() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'ranked' | 'heatgrid' | 'network'>('ranked');
  const [disruptions, setDisruptions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedDisruptionId, setSelectedDisruptionId] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<RankedOrder[]>([]);
  const [heatgrid, setHeatgrid] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<{

  const [selectedOrder, setSelectedOrder] = useState<RankedOrder | null>(null);

      setSummary({

      });
      setHeatgrid([
        { warehouse: 'WH-MAA-01 (Chennai Central)', sku: 'SKU-INS-100', impact_count: 4, severity: 'CRITICAL', stockout_hrs: 14 },
        { warehouse: 'WH-BLR-02 (Bengaluru Hub)', sku: 'SKU-INS-100', impact_count: 0, severity: 'LOW', stockout_hrs: 72 },
        { warehouse: 'WH-MAA-01 (Chennai Central)', sku: 'SKU-PPE-500', impact_count: 1, severity: 'MEDIUM', stockout_hrs: 36 },
        { warehouse: 'WH-HYD-01 (Hyderabad North)', sku: 'SKU-VAC-200', impact_count: 0, severity: 'LOW', stockout_hrs: 80 },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);

  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchImpactData();
  }, [selectedDisruptionId]);

  // Handle open drawer & fetch real lineage
  const handleOpenDrawer = async (order: RankedOrder) => {
    setSelectedOrder(order);
    setSelectedEdgeData(null);
    setDrawerOpen(true);
    setLineageLoading(true);

    try {
      const lineage = await api.impact.getLineage(order.order_id, selectedDisruptionId);
      setLineageData(lineage);
    } catch {
      // Fallback synthetic lineage matching Step 10 A8 causal chain
      setLineageData({
        order_id: order.order_id,
        order_code: order.order_code,
        disruption_id: selectedDisruptionId,
        edges: [
          {
            from_type: 'Supplier',
            from_id: 'SUP-CHENNAI-01',
            to_type: 'Shipment',
            to_id: 'SHP-9021',
            relation: 'DISPATCH_DELAYED',
            calculation: 'Actual departure 2026-10-29T18:00 vs Planned 2026-10-28T08:00 (+34h shift)',
            evidence_ids: ['EVD-CARRIER-GPS-88', 'EVD-EDI-214'],
            observed_at: '2026-10-29T18:15:00Z',
          },
          {
            from_type: 'Shipment',
            from_id: 'SHP-9021',
            to_type: 'Warehouse',
            to_id: 'WH-MAA-01',
            relation: 'STOCKOUT_INDUCED',
            calculation: 'Inbound buffer exhausted: OnHand(20) < DemandRate(5/hr) * Delay(34h) = 170 deficit',
            evidence_ids: ['EVD-LEDGER-SNAP-401'],
            observed_at: '2026-10-30T04:00:00Z',
          },
          {
            from_type: 'Warehouse',
            from_id: 'WH-MAA-01',

            evidence_ids: ['EVD-SLA-CONTRACT-77'],
            observed_at: '2026-10-30T06:30:00Z',
          },
        ],
      });
    } finally {
      setLineageLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Convert lineage edges into ReactFlow nodes and edges
  const { flowNodes, flowEdges } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!lineageData || !lineageData.edges || lineageData.edges.length === 0) {
      return { flowNodes: [], flowEdges: [] };
    }

    const rawEdges = lineageData.edges;
    const nodesMap = new Map<string, Node>();
    const edges: Edge[] = [];

    // Distinct entities
    const rawNodes: Array<{ id: string; label: string; type: string }> = [];

    rawEdges.forEach((e: any) => {
      if (!rawNodes.find((n) => n.id === e.from_id)) {
        rawNodes.push({ id: e.from_id, label: `${e.from_type}: ${e.from_id}`, type: e.from_type });
      }
      if (!rawNodes.find((n) => n.id === e.to_id)) {
        rawNodes.push({ id: e.to_id, label: `${e.to_type}: ${e.to_id}`, type: e.to_type });
      }
    });

    rawNodes.forEach((n, idx) => {
      let bg = '#ffffff';
      let border = '#cbd5e1';
      let text = '#0f172a';

      if (n.type === 'Supplier') {
        bg = '#eef2ff';
        border = '#a5b4fc';
        text = '#312e81';
      } else if (n.type === 'Shipment') {
        bg = '#fffbeb';
        border = '#fde68a';
        text = '#78350f';
      } else if (n.type === 'Warehouse') {
        bg = '#ecfdf5';
        border = '#a7f3d0';
        text = '#064e3b';
      } else if (n.type === 'Order') {
        bg = '#fff1f2';
        border = '#fecdd3';
        text = '#881337';
      }

      nodesMap.set(n.id, {
        id: n.id,
        position: { x: idx * 220 + 20, y: 80 + (idx % 2 === 1 ? 50 : 0) },
        data: { label: n.label },
        style: {
          background: bg,
          color: text,
          border: `1.5px solid ${border}`,

          fontSize: '11px',

          boxShadow: '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',

      });
    });

    rawEdges.forEach((e: any, idx: number) => {
      edges.push({
        id: `e-${idx}`,
        source: e.from_id,
        target: e.to_id,
        label: e.relation.replace('_', ' '),
        animated: true,
        markerEnd: { type: MarkerType.ArrowClosed, color: '#4f46e5' },
        style: { stroke: '#4f46e5', strokeWidth: 2, cursor: 'pointer' },
        labelStyle: { fill: '#4338ca', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 },
        data: e,
      });
    });

    return { flowNodes: Array.from(nodesMap.values()), flowEdges: edges };
  }, [lineageData]);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 text-slate-900 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* Header & Disruption Selector */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200">

            >
              {disruptions.length === 0 ? (

              ) : (
                disruptions.map((d) => (
                  <option key={d._id || d.id} value={d._id || d.id}>

                  </option>

            </select>
          </div>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={fetchImpactData}>
````
