/**
 * apps/web/src/api/client.ts
 *
 * Typed API Client for DisruptionIQ Control Tower.
 * Handles JWT authentication, demo role switching, error toast formatting.
 */

export interface UserProfile {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  display_name: string;
  role:
    | 'Analyst'
    | 'Manager'
    | 'Warehouse_Operator'
    | 'Procurement_Approver'
    | 'Administrator'
    | 'DRIVER'
    | 'SUPPLIER';
  warehouse_id: string | null;
  driver_id?: string | null;
  truck_id?: string | null;
  supplier_id?: string | null;
  permissions: string[];
  demo_mode?: boolean;
}

const TOKEN_KEY = 'disruptioniq_token';
const USER_KEY = 'disruptioniq_user';

export function getStoredToken(): string | null {
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function setStoredToken(token: string): void {
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

export function getStoredUser(): UserProfile | null {
  const u = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
  return u ? JSON.parse(u) : null;
}

export function setStoredUser(user: UserProfile): void {
  localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}

export function clearAuth(): void {
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
}

export async function apiRequest<T = any>(
  endpoint: string,
  options: RequestInit = {},
): Promise<T> {
  const token = getStoredToken();
  const headers = new Headers(options.headers || {});

  if (!headers.has('Content-Type') && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
    headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  }

  if (token && !headers.has('Authorization')) {
    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
  }

  // Prepend /api/v1 if not present
  const path = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;
  const url = path.startsWith('/api/v1') ? path : `/api/v1${path}`;

  const res = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers });

  if (!res.ok) {
    let errBody: any = null;
    try {
      errBody = await res.json();
    } catch {
      errBody = { message: res.statusText };
    }

    const message =
      errBody?.error?.message ||
      errBody?.message ||
      errBody?.error ||
      `Request failed with status ${res.status}`;

    const error: any = new Error(message);
    error.status = res.status;
    error.code = errBody?.error?.code || errBody?.code;
    error.details = errBody?.error?.details || errBody?.details;

    if (res.status === 401 && !path.includes('/auth/login') && !path.includes('/auth/demo-switch')) {
      clearAuth();
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:expired'));
    }

    throw error;
  }

  return res.json();
}

export function Layout({
  children,

        if (mounted) setNotifications(list);

        const outboxRes: any = await api.notifications.getOutbox();
        const ob = Array.isArray(outboxRes) ? outboxRes : outboxRes?.outbox ?? [];
        if (mounted) setOutbox(ob);
      } catch {
        // quiet fallback
      }

          {/* Prompt Chips */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 block">
              Suggested Operational Queries:
            </span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {ASK_PROMPT_CHIPS.map((chip, idx) => (

                  key={idx}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAskQuery(chip);
                    handleAskSubmit(undefined, chip);
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 hover:border-indigo-300 text-[11px] text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 transition-colors text-left"
                >
                  {chip}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Query Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleAskSubmit} className="space-y-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={askQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setAskQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500"
            />
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="sm" className="w-full" loading={askLoading}>
              Ask Operational Desk
            </Button>
          </form>

          {/* Answer Area */}
          {askAnswer && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs text-xs space-y-3">
              {askAnswer.refused ? (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                    <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                    Write Intent Refused
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-amber-800 text-xs">
                    Ask Desk operates in strict read-only intelligence mode. State mutations must be executed through governed Recovery Plans and Approvals.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                    Verified Desk Answer:
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-slate-800 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{askAnswer.answer}</p>

                  {/* Fact Claims Table */}
                  {askAnswer.facts && askAnswer.facts.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-500 block">
                        ANSWER_FACT Grounded Claims:
                      </span>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        {askAnswer.facts.map((f: any, idx: number) => (
                          <div
                            key={idx}
                            className="p-2 rounded bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]"
                          >
                            <span className="text-slate-800 font-mono">{f.entity || f.field}: {f.value}</span>
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-mono font-bold text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200">
                              VERIFIED
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {askAnswer.proof_summary && (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 text-[11px] text-emerald-700 font-mono">
                      ✓ {askAnswer.proof_summary.passing} of {askAnswer.proof_summary.total} facts verified against database rows.
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Drawer>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * apps/web/src/App.tsx
 *
 * Root Application Router with Impeccable Architecture:
 * - 8 Authoritative Screens
 * - Dynamic auth status & role hydration
 * - QueryClientProvider for live caching
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { UserProfile, getStoredUser, setStoredUser, api } from './api/client.js';
import { Layout } from './ui/Layout.js';
import { SignInScreen } from './screens/SignInScreen.js';
import { CockpitScreen } from './screens/CockpitScreen.js';
import { IntakeScreen } from './screens/IntakeScreen.js';
import { InvestigationScreen } from './screens/InvestigationScreen.js';
import { ImpactScreen } from './screens/ImpactScreen.js';
import { RecoveryScreen } from './screens/RecoveryScreen.js';
import { ApprovalsScreen } from './screens/ApprovalsScreen.js';
import { AuditScreen } from './screens/AuditScreen.js';
import { TrackingScreen } from './screens/TrackingScreen.js';
import { DriverScreen } from './screens/DriverScreen.js';
import { WarehouseLayoutScreen } from './screens/WarehouseLayoutScreen.js';
import { ClaimsScreen } from './screens/ClaimsScreen.js';
import { RoleHomeScreen } from './screens/RoleHomeScreen.js';

function RequireRole({
  user,
  roles,
  children,
}: {
  user: UserProfile;
  roles: string[];
  children: React.ReactElement;
}) {
  return roles.includes('*') || roles.includes(user.role) ? children : <Navigate to="/" replace />;
}

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      retry: 1,
    },
  },
});

export function App() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserProfile | null>(getStoredUser());

  const refreshUser = () => {
    setUser(getStoredUser());
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // If we have a token, verify and refresh user details from /auth/me
    const stored = getStoredUser();
    if (stored) {
      api.auth.getMe()
        .then((profile) => {
          setStoredUser(profile);
          setUser(profile);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          // Token expired or invalid
        });
    }

    const onExpired = () => {
      setUser(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('auth:expired', onExpired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth:expired', onExpired);
  }, []);

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <BrowserRouter>
        {!user ? (
          /* LOGGED OUT: only the sign-in page, no sidebar, no header */
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/login" element={<SignInScreen onLoginSuccess={refreshUser} />} />
            <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/login" replace />} />
          </Routes>
        ) : (
          /* LOGGED IN: full app shell */
          <Layout user={user} onUserChange={refreshUser}>
            <Routes>
              <Route path="/login" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
              <Route path="/" element={<RoleHomeScreen />} />
              <Route path="/cockpit" element={<CockpitScreen />} />
              <Route
                path="/intake"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Analyst', 'Administrator']}>
                    <IntakeScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route path="/investigation" element={<InvestigationScreen />} />
              <Route
                path="/impact"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Analyst', 'Manager', 'Administrator']}>
                    <ImpactScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/recovery"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Analyst', 'Manager']}>
                    <RecoveryScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/approvals"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Manager', 'Procurement_Approver']}>
                    <ApprovalsScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/audit"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Administrator', 'Manager', 'Analyst', 'Procurement_Approver']}>
                    <AuditScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route path="/tracking" element={<TrackingScreen />} />
              <Route
                path="/driver"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['DRIVER', 'Administrator', 'Manager']}>
                    <DriverScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/capacity"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Warehouse_Operator', 'Manager', 'Administrator', 'Analyst']}>
                    <WarehouseLayoutScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/claims"
                element={
                  <RequireRole user={user} roles={['Procurement_Approver', 'SUPPLIER', 'Administrator', 'Manager', 'Analyst']}>
                    <ClaimsScreen />
                  </RequireRole>
                }
              />
              <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
            </Routes>
          </Layout>
        )}
      </BrowserRouter>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}
````

# DisruptionIQ Verified Recovery Desk — Extensions

_Authoritative Extension Integration Guide — Updated 2026-10-30_

---

## 1. Impeccable (Installed & Active)

**Location:** `.agent/skills/impeccable/`  
**CLI Engine:** `.agent/skills/impeccable/scripts/bin/windows-x64/impeccable.exe`  
**Capabilities:**
- `impeccable detect [file-or-dir-or-url...]`: Scans for UI anti-patterns, design quality issues, and visual regressions.
- Antigravity Skill integration: Full skill suite with reference guides for audit, polish, clarify, distill, layout, and contrast.

**Our Step Routine:**
1. **Design-Brief Setup (Step 13):** Run Impeccable init/brief routine and create `docs/DESIGN.md`.
2. **Frontend Build (Steps 5, 22–26):** Execute UI design against the established design brief.
3. **Impeccable Audit Pass:** Run `& ".agent/skills/impeccable/scripts/bin/windows-x64/impeccable.exe" detect apps/web` before closing every UI step and fix all findings.

---

## 2. CodeRabbit (Installed & Active via npx)

**CLI:** `npx coderabbit review`  
**Capabilities:**
- Reviews working uncommitted diffs for security, race conditions, error handling gaps, and typing.
- Generates structured findings for agent triage (`--agent`).

**Our Step Routine:**
- At every Step Close Routine: execute `npx coderabbit review` on the working changes, resolve actionable items, and log any intentional exclusions in the commit message.

---

## 3. GSD Mission Control (Active)

**Role:** Systematic milestone tracking, sub-task execution control, and blocker management.
**Routine:** Every step establishes a checklist in `docs/STATE.md`, tracks sub-tasks, ensures `KNOWN ISSUES` is clean, and marks `STEP N: PASS` upon verification.

---

## 4. StitchMCP (Installed & Active)

**Role:** Design system generation and UI screen scaffolding MCP server.
**Routine:** Used for generating and refining UI layouts in Steps 22–26, connecting them directly to live API data.

/**
 * Checks whether a given role possesses a specific capability.
 */
export function hasPermission(role: Role | string, capability: Capability): boolean {
  const perm = ROLE_PERMISSIONS[capability];
  if (!perm) return false;
  return perm.roles.includes(role as Role);
}

/**
 * Returns all capabilities granted to a specific role.
 */
export function getPermissionsForRole(role: Role | string): Capability[] {
  return (Object.keys(ROLE_PERMISSIONS) as Capability[]).filter((cap) =>
    hasPermission(role, cap)
  );
}

import { authenticateToken, requirePermission } from './middleware/auth.js';
import { Capability, ROLE_PERMISSIONS } from '@disruptioniq/shared';

// Initialize domain bus event subscribers for notifications
initNotificationSubscribers();

export const app = express();

// ── Security hardening ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.use(helmet({
  contentSecurityPolicy: false, // served via Vite in dev; SPA sets its own
  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: false,
}));

// Rate-limit: 300 req / 15 min per IP (generous for demo multi-role switching)
const limiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  max: 300,
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: false,
  skip: (req) => req.path === '/health', // never limit health checks
  message: { error: { code: 'RATE_LIMITED', message: 'Too many requests, slow down.' } },
});
app.use(limiter);

app.use(cors());

// Capture rawBody for cryptographic HMAC verification on webhooks
app.use(
  express.json({
    verify: (req: Request, _res, buf) => {
      req.rawBody = buf.toString('utf-8');
    },
  }),
);

// Health route handler
async function handleHealth(_req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const isConnected = mongoose.connection.readyState === 1;
  const transactionsSupported = isConnected ? await checkTransactionsSupported() : false;

  let replicaSetName: string | null = null;
  if (isConnected && mongoose.connection.db) {
    try {
      const admin = mongoose.connection.db.admin();
      const status = await admin.command({ replSetGetStatus: 1 }).catch(() => null);
      if (status && status.set) {
        replicaSetName = status.set;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  }

  res.status(isConnected ? 200 : 503).json({
    status: isConnected ? 'ok' : 'degraded',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    uptime: process.uptime(),
    mongo: {
      connected: isConnected,
      transactionsSupported,
      replicaSet: replicaSetName,
    },
  });
}

// Health routes
app.get('/api/v1/health', handleHealth);
app.get('/health', handleHealth);

// Mount API routers under both /api/v1 and root prefixes for compatibility
app.use('/api/v1/auth', authRouter);
app.use('/auth', authRouter);

// Error handling middleware returning { error: { code, message, details } }
app.use((err: any, _req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction) => {
  const statusCode = err.statusCode || err.status || 500;
  res.status(statusCode).json({
    error: {
      code: err.code || 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
      message: err.message || 'An unexpected error occurred',
      details: err.details || null,
    },
  });
});

| `MONGODB_URI` | Yes | Default: `mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/disruptioniq?replicaSet=rs0` |
| `MONGODB_URI_READONLY` | Yes | For what-if simulator read-only connection |
| `MONGODB_URI_ADMIN` | Yes | For demo tamper action only |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | Min 32 chars |
| `WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Yes | For HMAC carrier webhook auth |
| `SOLVER_URL` | Yes | Default: `http://localhost:8000` |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | No | LLM optional — app works fully without it |
| `SIM_NOW` | No | Override simulation clock (ISO 8601 UTC) |
| `DEMO_MODE` | No | `true` enables demo role switcher and admin tamper |
| `DEMO_PASSWORD` | Yes | bcrypt-hashed password for seeded demo users |
````
